English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: Okay, I think I get it.
Chinese: 好的，我大概明白了。

English: Got it.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: Actually, I had other questions.
Chinese: 其实，我还有别的问题。

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想了解的就这些了。

English: <<The woman who approaches you is half-rotted. One eye is milk-white, and the other is missing. The pearly white of her jawbone is visible through ragged skin.>>
Chinese: <<朝你走来的女人已半身腐朽。她一只眼珠乳白浑浊，另一只不翼而飞。透过破碎的皮肉，能看到她珍珠白的颌骨。>>

English: Careful there, breather. That was a big one. You hurt?
Chinese: 小心点，呼吸者。刚才那下震得可不小。你受伤了吗？

English: What was that?
Chinese: 那是什么？

English: A little tremor, that's all. They've been getting more common recently.
Chinese: 一场小震而已。最近这种事越来越频繁了。

English: I'm fine.
Chinese: 我没事。

English: Good to hear.
Chinese: 那就好。

English: Just a little shaken, that's all.
Chinese: 只是被震得有点晕，没事。

English: Hahaha! Good one, breather.
Chinese: 哈哈哈！真逗，呼吸者。

English: You should watch your step, though - that quake will have riled up the catacomb wyrms something fierce.
Chinese: 不过你走路可得当心——那场地震准把地窟蠕虫搅得暴怒异常。

English: Catacomb wyrms?
Chinese: 地窟蠕虫？

English: Nasty buggers. They burrow, they fly, they eat people. Just stay away from them, that's my advice.
Chinese: 一群恶心的玩意儿。会打洞，会飞，还吃人。听我一句，离它们远点。

English: You appear to be... a bit worse for wear.
Chinese: 你看起来似乎……有点破破烂烂的。

English: What's wrong with your face?
Chinese: 你的脸怎么了？

English: I'm sure you've heard stories about the Endless, breather. Immortality comes at a price.
Chinese: 关于无尽者的传闻你肯定听过吧，呼吸者。永生是有代价的。

English: Do you know what's causing these tremors?
Chinese: 你知道这些震动是怎么回事吗？

English: Folks are saying it's the Entombed One, who's imprisoned below the Castle of Ribs. They say he's waking up. But people say a lot of things, and you'd go mad if you took it all seriously.
Chinese: 大家都说是被囚在肋骨城堡地下的墓中人干的，说他正在苏醒。可人们嘴上什么都说，你要全当了真，非疯不可。

English: Anyways, you're clearly new here, and I've got some time to kill. Is there anything you wanna know?
Chinese: 反正你显然是头一回来这儿，我也正好闲得发慌。有什么想了解的吗？

English: Hello again, breather.
Chinese: 又见面了，呼吸者。

English: Who is the Entombed One?
Chinese: 墓中人是谁？

English: No idea. He's been shaking the island for centuries, but recently, it's been happening more and more often. I've heard that if he keeps it up, the entire island could be shook to pieces.
Chinese: 我哪知道。几个世纪以来他一直在摇晃这座岛，但最近震得越来越勤。我听说他要是不消停，整座岛都会被震得粉碎。

English: What is the Castle of Ribs?
Chinese: 肋骨城堡是什么地方？

English: The palace where our Queen resides. If you keep heading west, you can't miss it.
Chinese: 我们女王居住的宫殿。一路往西走，你绝不会错过它。

English: Tell me about the Queen.
Chinese: 跟我说说女王吧。

English: Her full title is the Queen of Silver. She's a bit of a recluse. She's ruled over the Endless for three centuries, and for the last two she's never made an appearance in public.
Chinese: 她的全称是白银女王。她有点深居简出。她统治无尽者已经三个世纪了，而最近这两个世纪，她从未在公开场合露过面。

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: Who are you, again?
Chinese: 你叫什么来着？

English: My name's Chiasma. I'm just out here waiting to be granted admission to one of the Mausoleums.
Chinese: 我叫奇亚斯玛。我在这儿等着获批住进某座陵墓呢。

English: Told you before, breather - I'm Chiasma. I'm just out here waiting to be granted admission to one of the Mausoleums.
Chinese: 跟你说过啦，呼吸者——我叫奇亚斯玛。我在这儿等着获批住进某座陵墓呢。

English: What are the Mausoleums?
Chinese: 陵墓是什么？

English: See those big imposing tombs in the distance? Most of the Endless live in those Mausoleums, these days. They're waiting for the Ferryman to come and take them away.
Chinese: 看见远处那些气势逼人的大坟墓了吗？如今大多数无尽者都住在那些陵墓里，等着摆渡人前来把他们接走。

English: Why aren't you in a Mausoleum?
Chinese: 你怎么没住进陵墓？

English: They're overcrowded and the best tombs go to the highest bidder. So poor broke saps like me have to wait until a place becomes available. Usually after a Wyrm attack.
Chinese: 陵墓早就人满为患，最好的墓穴价高者得。所以像我这样穷困潦倒的可怜虫，只能等腾出空位来——通常得等蠕虫袭击之后。

English: See you later, Chiasma.
Chinese: 回头见，奇亚斯玛。

English: Good luck, breather. Watch your step out there.
Chinese: 祝你好运，呼吸者。在外面走路当心脚下。

English: Have you ever seen a talking crow in the kingdom?
Chinese: 你在这个王国里见过会说话的乌鸦吗？

English: Can't say that I have. It sounds like some kind of magic. If I were you, I'd go speak to Penitent Thaw - she knows everything there is to know about that kind of stuff.
Chinese: 我可没见过。听起来像是某种魔法。换成是我，我就去找忏悔者·索聊聊——这类事情她无所不知。

English: Who is Penitent Thaw?
Chinese: 忏悔者·索是谁？

English: A mage who lives in the sanctum overlooking the flesh-farm. You can see it up on that ridge, to the north. She's the youngest of the Endless. Only two centuries old - practically a whippersnapper.
Chinese: 一位住在俯瞰血肉农场的圣所里的法师。就在北边那道山脊上，你能看见。她是最年轻的无尽者，才两百岁——简直是个小毛孩。

English: Are you loyal to the Hooded King?
Chinese: 你效忠兜帽王吗？

English: Wow, what a question... No, I'm not loyal to a monarch who's been dead for three centuries. Obviously.
Chinese: 哇，这问题可真够……不，我可不效忠一位死了三百年的君主。这还用说。

English: Sure, breather. You wanna ask anything else?
Chinese: 好啊，呼吸者。还想问点什么？

English: Anythin' else you wanna know about this place?
Chinese: 关于这地方，你还想知道点什么？

English: Can you tell me about this place?
Chinese: 你能给我讲讲这地方吗？

English: Well, you're entering the lands of the Endless. Our island of tombs has been drifting around the skyrealms since before the World Rend; even before even those damned Emberians... ((ferryman rest their souls)), eheh.
Chinese: 嗯，你正踏入无尽者的领地。自世界撕裂之前——甚至在那些该死的余烬人之前——我们这座坟墓之岛就在天空领域间漂流了……((愿摆渡人安抚他们的灵魂))，嘿嘿。

English: You'll find the town of Sepulchre up ahead. But careful on your feet, breather - there's been a whole bunch of tremors, lately.
Chinese: 前面就是陵墓城。但脚下当心，呼吸者——最近震动可是一波接一波。

English: What's in Sepulchre?
Chinese: 陵墓城里有什么？

English: Honestly? Not much. Most of us Endless live in the mausoleums. But you can rent a room in the Rotten Coffin, and there's places to trade.
Chinese: 说实话？没多少东西。我们大多数无尽者都住在陵墓里。不过你可以在烂棺材租个房间，也有做买卖的地方。

English: Looming over Sepulchre is the Castle of Ribs, where the Queen resides. And just past town is the flesh-farm.
Chinese: 俯瞰着陵墓城的是肋骨城堡，女王就住在那里。镇子再过去就是血肉农场。

English: Wait, did you say flesh-farm?
Chinese: 等等，你是说血肉农场？

English: That's right, breather. Us Endless need to feast on living flesh, else we go all foggy. Years back we led the Cadaver Crusades, takin' the living by force - but Penitent Thaw came up with a much better idea.
Chinese: 没错，呼吸者。我们无尽者必须以活肉为食，否则脑子会越来越糊涂。多年前我们发动过尸骸十字军，用武力抢夺活人——但忏悔者·索想出了一个高明得多的主意。

English: The flesh-farm is a bunch of huge vats, growing mindless meat. Much more humane than eating raw human. Gets a bit tiring when your lunch is always screaming at you for mercy.
Chinese: 血肉农场就是一堆巨大的培养槽，里面长着没有意识的肉。比生吃活人仁慈多了。要是你的午餐总尖叫着求你饶命，吃久了也挺烦的。

English: <<The endless stands askew, slowly cleaning a mug with a rotten rag. He spits on the rag - apparently in an attempt at cleanliness - but a piece of his lip comes off in the attempt.>>
Chinese: <<那个无尽者歪斜地站着，正用一块烂布慢慢擦着杯子。他往布上啐了口唾沫——显然是想讲究一下卫生——结果一片嘴唇也跟着掉了下来。>>

English: Hmph, as I live n' rot - an honest to gods breather. We don't get many of you passing through Sepulchre, these days.
Chinese: 哼，真是活见鬼……哦不，活见"腐"——一个货真价实的呼吸者。这些天可没多少你们这样的人路过陵墓城。

English: Welcome to the Rotten Coffin. We've got a bed to rent - the only genuine mattress in all the tombs o' the Endless. We also got ghost booze.
Chinese: 欢迎光临烂棺材。我们出租床位——全无尽者坟墓间唯一一张真正的床垫。我们还有幽灵酒。

English: Hey look, the breather's back. How's that air taste?
Chinese: 嘿，瞧，呼吸者回来了。那空气尝起来如何？

English: I'll rent a bed.
Chinese: 我要租个床位。

English: Great! I've been told it's real comfy. But, seeing as you're the first to sleep in it for a good few years, the mattress might be a bit rotten. Just sweep off the maggots and you're good to go. ##Anyways, that'll be two coins.
Chinese: 好嘞！听说那床垫舒服得很。不过，你都算好几年里头一个睡它的人了，床垫可能会有点烂。把蛆虫扫掉就能睡。##总之，一共两个硬币。

English: Uh, here you are.
Chinese: 呃，给你。

English: Thanks breather. Just follow the stairs; it's up the top there.
Chinese: 谢了，呼吸者。顺着楼梯上去就是，就在最顶上。

English: Sorry breather, looks like you don't have enough.
Chinese: 抱歉，呼吸者，看来你的钱不够。

English: Ah, you've already paid for it, breather.
Chinese: 啊，你已经付过钱了，呼吸者。

English: Uh, I changed my mind.
Chinese: 呃，我改主意了。

English: Pfft. You breathers are always so squeamish.
Chinese: 切。你们呼吸者总是这么娇气。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: I reckon I've got the time. We've not been busy for a good century or so.
Chinese: 我估摸着有的是时间。这一百年左右我们都没忙过。

English: Do you know of any work going?
Chinese: 你知道有什么活儿可干吗？

English: Not much work going outside the mausoleums, breather. Still, you could try visiting the Queen's Senechal in the Castle of Ribs. Maybe she'd have use for someone with a working nervous system?
Chinese: 陵墓外头没什么活儿，呼吸者。不过你可以去肋骨城堡找女王的总管试试。说不定她用得上一个神经系统还正常运转的人？

English: Otherwise, there's the flesh farm, on the ridge north of here. As far as I know, it's just Penitent Thaw and that underling of hers, so perhaps they could use a hand.
Chinese: 要不然还有血肉农场，就在北边山脊上。据我所知，那边只有忏悔者·索和她那个手下，或许用得着帮手。

English: What was that about ghost booze?
Chinese: 刚才说的幽灵酒是怎么回事？

English: Well, we endless have different... constitutions from you breathers. Takes a different sorta beverage to really give us any kick.
Chinese: 这个嘛，我们无尽者的体质和你们呼吸者不太一样。得另一种酒才能让我们上头。

English: Ghost wine can be brewed like a potion, but the best vintages are ectoplasmic. When a ghost is created through trauma, sometimes nearby objects - or even ((drinks)) - pass over to the spirit realm too. That's the good stuff.
Chinese: 幽灵酒可以像药水那样酿造，但最好的年份酒都是灵外质的。当亡魂因创伤而生时，有时周围的物件——甚至是((酒))——也会一同渡入灵界。那才是好东西。

English: Or, for an Endless who's short of coin, there's always good ol' arsenic. I wouldn't recommend that for folk like you, though...
Chinese: 或者，手头紧的无尽者还有老一套——砒霜。不过我可不建议你们这种人碰那玩意儿……

English: What's the story with this town?
Chinese: 这座镇子有什么来历？

English: Well, this here town's called Sepulcher. <<He cocks his head.>> You want the long version, or the short?
Chinese: 嗯，这座镇子叫陵墓城。<<他歪了歪头。>>你想听长版本还是短版本？

English: The long.
Chinese: 长版本。

English: Years back - and I mean ((centuries)) ago, in the age of kings and castles - this used to be a peaceful kingdom called Verdant. Most folk still lived down on the world's surface,  before it got blown up - so we were pioneers of sorts.
Chinese: 很多年以前——我说是((几个世纪))之前，在国王与城堡的年代——这里曾是一个名为苍翠的和平王国。那时大多数子民还住在世界地表上，在地表被炸毁之前——所以我们算是某种先驱。

English: Our great wooden buildings rose above the pines an' our monarchs were just an' the air was sweet. ##Then, our Hooded King brought the curse upon Verdant. The living fought the dead; the bodies piled up, and the air weren't so sweet any more.
Chinese: 我们宏伟的木造建筑高耸于松林之上，我们的君主公正贤明，空气芬芳甜美。##后来，我们的兜帽王给苍翠带来了诅咒。活人与死者开战；尸体堆积如山，空气不再甜美。

English: Wracked with pain an' eternally cold, us Endless have no use for comfortable things... so those beautiful wooden buildings rotted away, replaced with hard stone. This town was Verdant no more, so we started calling it Sepulcher. The name stuck.
Chinese: 我们无尽者饱受痛苦折磨、永远冰冷，舒适的东西对我们毫无用处……于是那些美丽的木造建筑渐渐朽烂，被坚硬的石头取代。这座镇子不再是苍翠了，于是我们开始叫它陵墓城。这名字就这么留了下来。

English: The short.
Chinese: 短版本。

English: These days Sepulcher is little more than an outpost, for trading an' the like. Most of us Endless live in those great mausoleums over yonder. And that big tower that looms over us? That's the Castle of Ribs, where the Queen lives - but she's not left in years.
Chinese: 如今的陵墓城不过是个做买卖之类的前哨站。我们大多数无尽者都住在那边那些大陵墓里。至于那座俯瞰我们的高塔？那是肋骨城堡，女王住的地方——不过她已经好多年没出过门了。

English: Uh, exactly how ((long)) is long?
Chinese: 呃，这个"长"到底是((多长))？

English: <<He lets out a raspy chuckle, which unleashes a fleck of flesh.>> ##Don't worry, breather. I know us Endless can ((theoretically)) talk forever, but I won't kill you with boredom.
Chinese: <<他发出一阵沙哑的低笑，笑出一片碎肉来。>> ##别担心，呼吸者。我知道我们无尽者((理论上))能聊到永远，但我不会无聊死你的。

English: So, what'll it be?
Chinese: 那么，你想听哪个？

English: You know what, never mind.
Chinese: 算了，当我没问。

English: No problem breather. So, you wanna know anything else?
Chinese: 没关系，呼吸者。那么，你还想知道点什么？

English: Anythin' else you wanna know?
Chinese: 还想知道点什么？

English: That's all I wanted to ask.
Chinese: 我想问的就这些。

English: Alright. You want anythin' else?
Chinese: 好吧。还需要什么吗？

English: How's life in Sepulchre?
Chinese: 陵墓城的生活怎么样？

English: Hmph. How's ((death)) you mean?
Chinese: 哼。你是说((死亡))过得怎么样吧？

English: Well, the Queen's castle blew up. That's a pretty big thing
Chinese: 嗯，女王的城堡被炸上了天。这可是桩大事

English: Folk are saying the Entombed One has awakened. Others are saying the Ferryman is bringing the true death. All I know is, the island is crumbling, an' I sure as hell don't like it.
Chinese: 有人说墓中人已经苏醒。还有人说摆渡人正在带来真正的死亡。我只知道，这座岛正在分崩离析，我他妈可不喜欢这样。

English: Well, those awful tremors have stopped. Folk are saying the Entombed One was struck down in mortal combat, saving the kingdom - or somesuch nonsense.
Chinese: 嗯，那些可怕的震动停了。人们说墓中人已死于一场殊死之战，拯救了王国——诸如此类的鬼话。

English: What've you got to drink?
Chinese: 你们这儿有什么酒？

English: Should be no surprise we've got plenty o' [[Ghost Wine]]. ##Recently my punters 'ave been hankering for some good ol' fashioned mortal booze, though. If you come across any Riovan [[Fine Wine]] I'll give you a good price for it.
Chinese: 我们这儿有的是[[幽灵酒]]，你应该不会意外。##不过最近我的老主顾们开始惦记传统的凡人酒了。你要是碰上里奥瓦的[[上等葡萄酒]]，我出好价收。

English: I'll be going.
Chinese: 我先走了。

English: I'm looking for The Duchess, do you know her?
Chinese: 我在找女公爵，你认识她吗？

English: The Duchess? She's hard to pin down, that one. Few folk 'ave even ((seen)) her since she came back from galavantin' around with pirates and mercenaries a few years back.
Chinese: 女公爵？那位可不好找。自从几年前她跟海盗和佣兵们四处游荡回来后，就没几个人((见过))她了。

English: Rumour has it, she's holed up in her ol' family [[manor]] that sits on the [[southern edge]] of the Endless Realm...
Chinese: 据传闻，她藏在她家族的老[[庄园]]里，就在无尽领域的[[南缘]]……

English: But good luck arranging a visit. She's a powerful cipher wizard an' has a whole host of magical countermeasures to stop common plebs like us from wanderin' round her grounds.
Chinese: 不过你想登门拜访可没那么容易。她可是个强大的密文法师，布下了一大堆魔法防御，不让我们这种平头百姓在她的地界上乱逛。

English: I'm looking for The Duchess.
Chinese: 我在找女公爵。

English: Ah, yes - everyone's heard of the Duchess! Only, I don't think anyone's seen her in years. Last I heard, she was flyin' around with that crazy bunch o' breathers - what were they called? The Dull Stars? The ((Dim Lights))...?
Chinese: 啊，没错——女公爵的大名谁人不知！只是好些年没听说谁见过她了。上次听人说，她跟着那帮疯狂的呼吸者满天飞来着——他们叫什么来着？"钝星团"？((昏光团))……？

English: Anyway, her family [[manor]] is to the [[south]]. If y'er looking for her, I'd head there - but I hear the place is crawlin' with [[magical skeletons]], so be careful.
Chinese: 总之，她家的[[庄园]]在[[南边]]。你要找她，我建议去那儿——但我听说那地方爬满了[[魔法骷髅]]，可要当心。

English: I never entered a mausoleum. Back when I was breathing, so long ago, I knew I could never leave these trees. The air smelled so... so... ##Well, I can't recall how the air smelled anymore, but it must have been good.
Chinese: 我从未住进过陵墓。很久以前，我还在呼吸的时候，就知道自己离不开这片树林。那时的空气闻起来那么……那么……##唉，我已经想不起空气的味道了，但那一定很好闻。

English: So I dawdled, and the mausoleums filled up. And the thing about being Endless, see, is that the pain dulls everything. Anhedonia sets in, pleasure seeps away... and these old trees only mock me, now.
Chinese: 于是我磨磨蹭蹭，陵墓就住满了。无尽者的毛病你瞧，就是痛苦会磨钝一切。快感缺失悄悄袭来，愉悦慢慢流走……如今这些老树只会嘲笑我。

English: Hmm, what's this? A breather? Oh, marvellous! Please, stay there a second. Let me jot down some notes. Is your skin always that damp? Do you ever forget to breathe? What does it feel like, when your hair grows?
Chinese: 嗯，这是什么？一个呼吸者？哦，太妙了！请站在那儿别动。让我记点笔记。你的皮肤总是这么潮吗？你会忘记呼吸吗？头发长出来的时候是什么感觉？

English: Ah, apologies, this must be quite overwhelming. I'm a playwright down in a mausoleum, you see - but the scene has become so... stagnant!
Chinese: 啊，抱歉，这一下子肯定让你不知所措了。你看，我是陵墓里的一名剧作家——可如今的戏剧界变得太……死气沉沉了！

English: The past century or so, pre-Endless historical dramas have been in vogue. Except, us writers never leave our tombs, and I'm ((convinced)) our work is full of inaccuracies. ##It's funny, the things you forget. The history books never mention the little things...
Chinese: 过去这一个世纪左右，无尽者之前的历史剧大行其道。问题是，我们这些编剧从不离开自己的坟墓，我((确信))我们的作品里全是胡编乱造。##有趣的是人会忘记的东西。史书从不记载那些小事……

English: Ah, a breather! Welcome to the [[Mouldy Cauldron]]. ##You're my first living customer in months. Or has it been years? Time flies, when you're my age...
Chinese: 啊，一个呼吸者！欢迎光临[[霉锅店]]。##你是我几个月来的第一个活人顾客。还是已经好几年了？到我这个岁数，光阴似箭啊……

English: Ah, my favourite customer! ##Well, you're also my ((only)) customer, but deaders can't be choosers, eh? ##Welcome back to the [[Mouldy Cauldron]].
Chinese: 啊，我最喜欢的顾客！##嗯，你也是我((唯一))的顾客，不过死人没得挑，对吧？##欢迎回到[[霉锅店]]。

English: Let me see what you have for sale.
Chinese: 让我看看你卖什么。

English: How's business?
Chinese: 生意如何？

English: Ha! Business? I mostly just sit here and watch the rodents chew on my feet.
Chinese: 哈！生意？我基本上就是坐在这儿看耗子啃我的脚。

English: A while back, things used to be a bit more exciting. Every now and again, some folk from Hallowshire would come to trade. They'd always look petrified and would never tarry long, but breather goods fetch a good price down in the mausoleums.
Chinese: 前一阵子，日子还稍微有意思些。时不时会有哈洛郡的人来做买卖。他们总是吓得呆若木鸡，从不多待，但呼吸者的货在陵墓里能卖出好价钱。

English: But recently, breather business has dried up. I've been told it's because of something called an Aposhtatty Yoonun, but I have no idea what that is.
Chinese: 可最近，呼吸者的生意黄了。有人告诉我这是因为一个叫"阿泼斯泰蒂·尤弄"的玩意儿，可我压根不知道那是什么。

English: You mean since the castle blew up and the island started falling apart?
Chinese: 你是说自从城堡被炸、这座岛开始崩解以来？

English: ...much the same really. I mostly just sit here and watch the rodents chew on my feet.
Chinese: ……其实差不多还是老样子。我基本上就是坐在这儿看耗子啃我的脚。

English: Is there a house for sale in Sepulchre?
Chinese: 陵墓城有房子出售吗？

English: Lookin' to invest in a property market full o' undyin' old timers, eh breather? <<The shopkeep chuckles to herself.>> ##...Oh wait, y'er ((serious?))
Chinese: 想在一个住满不死老不死的房地产市场上投资，是吧呼吸者？<<店主自己咯咯直笑。>> ##……哦等等，你是((认真的？))

English: Ah, well, I think I had an old [[Sepulchre House Deed]] knockin' about in the ol' [[Shop Inventory]]. It's fer that ol' shack down by the [[western entry bridge]].
Chinese: 啊，这个嘛，我记得我的老[[店铺库存]]里搁着一份旧[[陵墓屋地契]]。是[[西侧入口桥]]边那座破棚子的。

English: Just next to me is the only [[Property Station]] in Sepulchre; you'd need to use that if you wanted to [[upgrade]], [[furnish]] or [[decorate]] the house.
Chinese: 我旁边就是陵墓城唯一的[[房产工作站]]；你要想[[升级]]、[[布置]]或[[装点]]那房子，就得用它。

English: How do I maintain the house?
Chinese: 我该怎么维护房子？

English: Just next to me is the only [[Property Station]] in Sepulchre; you'd need to use that if you wanted to [[upgrade]], [[furnish]] or [[decorate]] the house.
Chinese: 我旁边就是陵墓城唯一的[[房产工作站]]；你要想[[升级]]、[[布置]]或[[装点]]那房子，就得用它。

English: ...'an judgin' by the state of that ol' shack, I'm sure you'd be wantin' to.
Chinese: ……而且照那破棚子的样子看，我敢说你肯定想好好拾掇拾掇。

English: How do I upgrade a property?
Chinese: 房产怎么升级？

English: Use that [[Property Station]] right next to me. Upgrades cost both [[coin]] and [[resources]], but it's worth it if you don't wanna live in a mouldy ol' wreck.
Chinese: 用我旁边那个[[房产工作站]]就行。升级要花[[硬币]]和[[资源]]，但谁想住在一座发霉的破烂里呢，值当的。

English: First off, you wanna [[build]] an upgrade, like a Garden or an Annex or summin'. Might take a little time to construct, so you could get some shuteye while you wait.
Chinese: 首先，你得[[建造]]一个升级项目，比如花园或厢房什么的。建造可能要花点时间，等的时候你可以眯一会儿。

English: But a newly built upgrade won't have any furniture. So the next step is to [[furnish]] it for an additional cost. Then you'll 'ave fancy stuff to show yer friends. If ((yours)) are still alive, that is.
Chinese: 但新造好的升级项目里没有家具。所以下一步是花钱[[布置]]家具。然后你就有排面的东西可以向朋友炫耀了——前提是((你的))朋友还活着。

English: How do I decorate a property?
Chinese: 房产怎么装饰？

English: You can [[decorate]] a house in any [[style]] you've unlocked. ##But, you gotta buy a style first. Right here we 'ave [[Endless Furnishings]] for sale, for instance.
Chinese: 你可以用任何已解锁的[[风格]]来[[装饰]]房子。##不过，你得先购买风格。比如我们这儿就有[[无尽风格家具]]出售。

English: Only one [[decorative style]] can be applied to your house, and it will only take effect on parts that have been [[furnished]].
Chinese: 你的房子只能应用一种[[装饰风格]]，而且只对已[[布置]]过的部分生效。

English: How do I display trophies and artwork?
Chinese: 奖杯和艺术品怎么展示？

English: Once you've [[furnished]] a part of your house, a bunch o' [[trophy mounts]] will appear. Use 'em to toggle the trophies you want to show off.
Chinese: 一旦你[[布置]]了房子的某个部分，就会出现一批[[奖杯架]]。用它们来切换你想展示的奖杯。

English: Trophies 'ave to be [[unlocked]] before you can show 'em off, though. No idea how you do that, breather; you're on your own.
Chinese: 不过奖杯得先[[解锁]]才能展示。怎么解锁我可不知道，呼吸者；你自己琢磨吧。

English: Thanks for your help.
Chinese: 多谢帮忙。

English: Sure thing breather. Anythin' else?
Chinese: 不客气，呼吸者。还有别的吗？

English: Hail and well met, my mortal friend! How may I be of assistance today?
Chinese: 你好呀，幸会幸会，我凡人的朋友！今天我能帮上什么忙？

English: Greetings once again, mortal. How may I help?
Chinese: 再次问候，凡人。有何吩咐？

English: Aha, a mortal traveler! Unusual, to see one of your kind within the realm of the Endless! It is my pleasure to welcome you to the Castle of Ribs. Pray tell, my friend, what brings you to our kingdom?
Chinese: 啊哈，一位凡人旅者！在无尽者的国度见到你们这样的客人，真是稀罕！欢迎来到肋骨城堡，这是我的荣幸。请讲，我的朋友，是什么风把您吹到我们王国来的？

English: I'm hunting a former member of the Dark Star company.
Chinese: 我在追捕黑星佣兵团的一名前成员。

English: How exciting, aha! [I MAY KNOW SOMETHING]
Chinese: 真是激动人心，啊哈！[I MAY KNOW SOMETHING]

English: No, but [I MAY KNOW SOMETHING]
Chinese: 没有，但[I MAY KNOW SOMETHING]

English: [DARK STAR DIALOGUE 1]
Chinese: [DARK STAR DIALOGUE 1]

English: [DARK STAR DIALOGUE 2]
Chinese: [DARK STAR DIALOGUE 2]

English: How exciting, aha! I can provide some assistance, if you like? I will send word to my retinue and have them scour the land for your quarry.
Chinese: 真是激动人心，啊哈！如果你愿意，我可以帮些忙？我会传话给我的随从，让他们在国内各处搜寻你的猎物。

English: Just seeing the sights.
Chinese: 只是四处观光。

English: Aha! I am familiar with that drive to discover, that raw, unbidden ((need)) to know what lies beyond the horizon! I travelled a little in my own youth, you know. Some many hundreds of years ago, when I had a beating heart. The skyrealms were very different then, let me tell you!
Chinese: 啊哈！那种探索的冲动，那种想知道地平线之外有什么的原始而不由分说的((渴望))，我再熟悉不过了！你知道吗，我自己年轻时也游历过一些地方。那是几百年前的事了，那时我还有一颗跳动的心脏。那时候的天空领域可跟现在大不一样，让我告诉你！

English: Insatiable curiosity.
Chinese: 永不满足的好奇心。

English: I want to learn how to cheat death.
Chinese: 我想学会如何骗过死亡。

English: Oh dear. Not another one. How many mortals must we turn away before you learn your lesson? The Endless are not recruiting. And please don't burden me with another sob-story.
Chinese: 哦天哪。又来一个。我们要回绝多少凡人你们才能吸取教训？无尽者不招人。也请别再用苦情故事来烦我。

English: I am here to visit the Queen of Silver.
Chinese: 我是来拜访白银女王的。

English: Alas, the Queen isn't accepting visitors at this time. Or at any time, really. She is... Withdrawn. Most days she will speak to me, and me alone.
Chinese: 唉，女王现在不接待访客。其实什么时候都不接待。她……与世隔绝。大多数日子里，她只肯跟我说话，也只有我一个人。

English: I'll answer your questions to the best of my ability.
Chinese: 我会尽我所能回答你的问题。

English: Greetings once again, mortal. How may I help?
Chinese: 再次问候，凡人。有何吩咐？

English: Perhaps I can put her in a better mood.
Chinese: 也许我能让她心情好一点。

English: I doubt it. But I suppose I have nothing to lose by letting you try. Go ahead. If you can raise her out of her depression, I will be - without exaggeration - eternally grateful.
Chinese: 我对此表示怀疑。不过让你试试我也不亏。去吧。如果你能让她走出消沉，我会——毫不夸张地说——永远感激你。

English: Doesn't she have responsibilities, as a monarch?
Chinese: 身为君主，她难道没有职责吗？

English: In theory, yes. But if a monarch neglects her responsibilities for many hundreds of years, the state tends to adapt.
Chinese: 理论上，有。但如果一位君主数百年疏于职守，国家往往就会自己适应过来。

English: I don't see any guards. How are you going to stop me?
Chinese: 我没看见卫兵。你打算怎么拦我？

English: ...I suppose that is true. But don't expect a kind reception from the Queen.
Chinese: ……我想的确如此。但别指望女王会好好待你。

English: It's a shame. I travelled a long way see her.
Chinese: 真遗憾。我远道而来就是想见她。

English: ...Very well, go ahead. I'll pretend I didn't see you.
Chinese: ……好吧，去吧。我就当没看见你。

English: <<The Seneschal stands aside, allowing you passage deeper into the Castle of Ribs.>>
Chinese: <<总管站到一旁，放行你深入肋骨城堡。>>

English: I have already granted you access to the Queen.
Chinese: 我已经准许你觐见女王了。

English: I have other questions for you.
Chinese: 我还有别的问题要问你。

English: I'll answer to the best of my ability.
Chinese: 我会尽我所能回答。

English: Have you ever been outside the kingdom of the Endless?
Chinese: 你出过无尽者王国的门吗？

English: I travelled a little in my youth. Many hundreds of years ago. The skyrealms were very different then, let me tell you!
Chinese: 我年轻时游历过一些地方。几百年前的事了。那时候的天空领域可跟现在大不一样，让我告诉你！

English: How were they different?
Chinese: 怎么个不一样法？

English: Well, this was only a century after the World Rend. Everything was in a state of flux - every day, new kingdoms were blossoming and dying like winter roses.
Chinese: 这个嘛，那时只是世界撕裂后一个世纪。一切都处于流变之中——每天都有新王国如冬玫瑰般绽放又凋零。

English: There was no Union, of course, and you needed to have the protection of a god, or at least a powerful Wikkan, to survive a journey across the sky. I saw some wonderful things. And some horrors, too.
Chinese: 当然，那时还没有联盟，要想在跨越天空的旅途中活下来，你需要一位神的庇护，或者至少一位强大的维坎教徒。我见过一些奇妙的事物。也见过一些恐怖的东西。

English: Tell me about the wonders.
Chinese: 给我讲讲那些奇观。

English: Why, of course! Have you ever seen a god? I saw one once, drifting through the fog. As vast as a mountain. Dozens of eyes, each as bright and round as the moon.
Chinese: 哦，当然！你见过神吗？我见过一次，在雾中缓缓漂过。大如山岳。几十只眼睛，每一只都像月亮一样又圆又亮。

English: When I saw it, I opened my mouth, and the most beautiful hymn spilled out. I can't sing under normal circumstances, but my voice was like honey and thunder, that day...
Chinese: 当我看见它时，我张开嘴，最美的圣歌倾泻而出。平时我根本不会唱歌，但那天，我的嗓音如蜜糖与雷霆……

English: Tell me about the horrors.
Chinese: 给我讲讲那些恐怖。

English: I would rather not recall such things, but... I saw an entire town consumed in silver flames, while laughing priests circled above like vultures. ##I saw a conscriptor-harvester pulling screaming men into its maw and turning them into mindless engines of war.
Chinese: 我本不愿回忆这些，但是……我见过一座小镇被银色火焰吞噬，而大笑的祭司们如秃鹫般在上方盘旋。##我见过一台征召收割机把尖叫的人们拽进巨口，把他们变成没有意识的战争机器。

English: I saw a library whale pulled slowly apart by iron hooks, and butcher-archivists scrabbling through its guts for forgotten tomes...
Chinese: 我见过一头图书馆鲸被铁钩慢慢撕开，屠夫档案员们在它的内脏中翻找被遗忘的典籍……

English: Fascinating, but I wanted to ask something else...
Chinese: 真引人入胜，不过我想问点别的……

English: Of course.
Chinese: 当然。

English: Can you remember what caused the World Rend?
Chinese: 你还记得世界撕裂是什么引起的吗？

English: I never knew what caused it. But I remember the searing flash that stained the sky. I remember the impact, which shook our tombs and scattered the islands.
Chinese: 我一直不知道起因。但我记得那道染遍天空的灼目闪光。我记得那次冲击，震动了我们的坟墓，把岛屿震散四方。

English: Back then, the Endless were one of the few peoples in the skyrealms. It got a lot more crowded after that, with all the refugees.
Chinese: 那时候，无尽者是天空领域里为数不多的族群之一。那之后难民蜂拥而至，地方变得拥挤多了。

English: Your youth? Was this before you became Endless?
Chinese: 你的年轻时代？那是在你成为无尽者之前？

English: Yes, indeed. I couldn't have travelled after. The mortals had good reason to fear the Endless, in those days... I would have been killed on sight, and I would have deserved it.
Chinese: 是的，的确如此。成为无尽者之后我就没法旅行了。那时候凡人惧怕无尽者是有充分理由的……我一旦露面就会被杀，而且罪有应得。

English: A relative term; for the rot hadn't fully set in. ##Even so, it was difficult at times. The mortals had good reason to fear the Endless, in those days... I could have been killed on sight, and I would have deserved it.
Chinese: 这是个相对的说法；因为当时腐朽尚未完全侵入。##即便如此，有时也很艰难。那时候凡人惧怕无尽者是有充分理由的……我一旦露面就可能被杀，而且罪有应得。

English: I have other questions for you.
Chinese: 我还有别的问题要问你。

English: I have some questions.
Chinese: 我有几个问题。

English: Very well.
Chinese: 好的。

English: Can I ask about yourself?
Chinese: 我能问问你自己的事吗？

English: By all means, go ahead.
Chinese: 当然可以，请讲。

English: Who are you, exactly?
Chinese: 你究竟是谁？

English: I am the Seneschal. I administer the Queen of Silver's affairs, attend to her needs, and run the day-to-day business of the kingdom. Although the kingdom tends to run itself, these days, more or less.
Chinese: 我是总管。我掌管白银女王的事务，照料她的起居，打理王国的日常政务。不过如今这个王国差不多都能自己运转了。

English: Are you a follower of the Ferryman?
Chinese: 你是摆渡人的信徒吗？

English: I would say I'm agnostic. I've read the literature, and sometimes I lock my office and lie in the dark with coins over my eyes, just to see if I have any great revelation. Nothing so far.
Chinese: 要我说，我算不可知论者。相关典籍我都读过，有时我会锁上办公室，在黑暗中躺下，眼睛上盖着硬币，看看会不会有什么伟大的启示。迄今一无所获。

English: Lord Rhydder claims you were the reason the Hooded King's ritual backfired.
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵声称，兜帽王的仪式之所以弄巧成拙，就是因为你。

English: Why is Lord Rhydder speaking to you in the first place? I thought he hated your kind.
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵怎么会跟你说话来着？我还以为他恨透了你们这种人。

English: Don't change the topic.
Chinese: 别转移话题。

English: He does. But he seems to hate you more.
Chinese: 他是恨。但他似乎更恨你。

English: You were the one who doomed this kingdom, Seneschal.
Chinese: 是你毁了这个王国，总管。

English: What was I supposed to do? The princess was so young, barely a woman, and they were drowning her. Or rather... She was drowning herself.
Chinese: 我当时能怎么办？公主那么年轻，还算不上真正的妇人，而他们要把她淹死。或者说……她是在把自己淹死。

English: She walked into the mercury willingly, it seemed, and ducked her head under its silver surface. She didn't even struggle. The mercury swallowed her, and then it was so still... Like a mirror...
Chinese: 看起来她是自愿走进水银池的，把头埋进了那银色的液面之下。她甚至没有挣扎。水银吞没了她，然后一切都那么静……像一面镜子……

English: It looked like she sacrificed herself willingly?
Chinese: 看起来她是自愿献祭自己的？

English: Yes. It must have been some dark magic, twisting her mind, moving her muscles against her will. Right?
Chinese: 是啊。一定是某种黑暗魔法在扭曲她的心智，违背她的意愿驱使她的肌肉。对吧？

English: So you saved her?
Chinese: 所以你救了她？

English: I did. I ran in and pulled her to safety, and I got a sword through my chest for the trouble. But I did a good thing, didn't I? If not for me, the Queen would be dead!
Chinese: 是的。我冲进去把她拉到安全的地方，换来的却是一剑穿胸。可我做了件好事，不是吗？要不是我，女王早就死了！

English: How did you survive being stabbed?
Chinese: 被捅了一剑你是怎么活下来的？

English: I lay dying on the marble floor of the throne room for a long time. Until I realised that I was no longer dying at all. I had become Endless... And a mere stab-wound was not enough to kill me. Not any more.I
Chinese: 我躺在王座厅的大理石地板上，奄奄一息了很长时间。直到我意识到，自己根本不再是奄奄一息。我已化为无尽者……区区一处剑伤再也无法杀死我。再也不能了。

English: Can you remember anything else about the ritual?
Chinese: 关于那场仪式，你还记得别的什么吗？

English: No. Just pain and darkness.
Chinese: 没有。只有痛苦和黑暗。

English: <<He sighs deeply, rubbing his temples.>>##Please, can you leave me in peace for a moment?
Chinese: <<他深深叹息，揉着太阳穴。>>##求你了，能让我清静一会儿吗？

English: Can I ask about the Endless?
Chinese: 我能问问无尽者的事吗？

English: Our kind must seem strange to you; I'm happy to indulge your curiosity.
Chinese: 我们这种生灵在你眼里想必很怪异；我很乐意满足你的好奇心。

English: How were the Endless created?
Chinese: 无尽者是怎么被创造出来的？

English: ...It was the work of the Hooded King. My former liege.
Chinese: ……那是兜帽王的手笔。我昔日的君上。

English: Why didn't you talk him out of it?
Chinese: 你为什么不劝阻他？

English: What was I supposed to do? He was my King, and he had the backing of all the Great Lords. I was just the Seneschal, and he laughed at my warnings!
Chinese: 我能怎么办？他是我的国王，所有大勋爵都站在他那边。我不过是个总管，他听了我的警告只顾发笑！

English: What happened?
Chinese: 后来呢？

English: The Hooded King summoned Wikkans and theurges from across the skyrealms. They tried a hundred different potions and ceremonies and spells to make him immortal, but none worked...
Chinese: 兜帽王从天空领域各处召来了维坎教徒和神术师。他们试了上百种药水、仪式和咒语想让他永生，但没有一种奏效……

English: Until eventually they hit upon some kind of ritual. Dark, strange magic, like nothing I've ever witnessed. It involved striking a bargain... And a sacrifice.
Chinese: 直到他们最终想出某种仪式。黑暗而诡异的魔法，我闻所未闻、见所未见。那需要达成一桩交易……还有一场献祭。

English: A bargain?
Chinese: 交易？

English: They made a contract with a god from some forgotten corner of the world. I only saw it once, as I pressed my eye to the keyhole of the throne room... It was a twisted thing of hunger and darkness, hunched upon the marble floor like a creature from nightmares.
Chinese: 他们与一位神明订了契约，那神来自世界某个被遗忘的角落。我只见过它一次，当时我把眼睛贴在王座厅的钥匙孔上……那是一团扭曲的东西，由饥饿与黑暗构成，蜷缩在大理石地板上，像从噩梦里爬出来的怪物。

English: A sacrifice?
Chinese: 献祭？

English: His only daughter. The princess. As the ritual reached its apex, she was to be drowned in a pool of mercury.
Chinese: 他唯一的女儿。那位公主。仪式达到顶点之时，她将被溺死在水银池中。

English: But if the ritual worked, where is the Hooded King?
Chinese: 可如果仪式成功了，兜帽王在哪儿？

English: Enough of this chatter. I am a very busy man, you know! I can't just stand around talking all day!
Chinese: 别再闲聊了。你要知道，我可是个大忙人！我不能成天站在这儿说个不停！

English: Goodbye, Seneschal.
Chinese: 再见，总管。

English: Go in peace, mortal.
Chinese: 平安去吧，凡人。

English: Have you ever fed on a living person?
Chinese: 你吃过活人吗？

English: I am ashamed to say that yes, I have. But do not fear - the last mortal I ate was over two centuries ago. We have the flesh-farms now, which sustain us without the need for bloodshed.
Chinese: 我羞于承认，是的，吃过。但别害怕——我吃的最后一个凡人已经是两个多世纪前的事了。现在我们有血肉农场，无需流血就能维生。

English: Why are there so many ghosts in the kingdom of the Endless?
Chinese: 无尽者的王国里为什么有这么多幽灵？

English: Ghosts are manifestatons of trauma. Long ago, when the Endless were first created, there were still many living souls in the kingdom. The Endless, consumed by hunger, hunted them down in a mad frenzy...
Chinese: 幽灵是创伤的显形。很久以前，无尽者刚被创造出来的时候，王国里还有许多活的灵魂。无尽者被饥饿吞噬心智，陷入疯狂的暴怒，将他们逐一猎杀……

English: Over the next few years, the Great Devouring, our kingdom ate itself alive. Many ghosts were born from that bloodshed, both from the victims, and from those sated Endless who realised what they had done.
Chinese: 在接下来的几年里——大吞噬——我们的王国活活吃掉了自己。许多幽灵诞生于那场血腥，既有来自受害者的，也有来自那些餍足后惊觉自己所作所为的无尽者。

English: I am ashamed to say that some were also... created, on purpose. The abhorrent suits of armour that roam these lands were footsoldiers, once - remnants from the Cadaver Crusades.
Chinese: 我更羞于承认，还有一些幽灵是……被刻意造出来的。在这片土地上游荡的那些可憎铠甲曾是步兵——尸骸十字军的残部。

English: Did you take part in the Great Devouring?
Chinese: 你参与过大吞噬吗？

English: ...Yes. None of my family survived my hunger.
Chinese: ……是的。我的家人没有一个逃过我的饥饿。

English: So ghosts were left by both the devourers and the devoured?
Chinese: 所以吞噬者和被吞噬者都留下了幽灵？

English: Yes. I have never met my own ghost, but I am certain he is out there, still wracked by hunger and guilt.
Chinese: 是的。我从未遇见过我自己的幽灵，但我确信他就存在于某处，仍被饥饿与负罪折磨着。

English: I am so sorry that happened to you.
Chinese: 发生在你身上的这些事，我很难过。

English: It is not a time in my life I like to reflect upon. I'm sorry... Please leave me be for a moment.
Chinese: 那不是我人生中愿意回想的一段时光。抱歉……请让我一个人静一静。

English: You're nothing more than a vile killer.
Chinese: 你不过是个卑劣的凶手。

English: I... I know. ##<<The Seneschal seems lost in misery, and no longer responds to your questions.>>
Chinese: 我……我知道。##<<总管似乎陷入悲恸之中，不再回应你的问题。>>

English: I... know.
Chinese: 我……知道。

English: How can you talk about this so calmly?
Chinese: 你怎么能这么平静地谈论这些？

English: It... It was a long time ago.
Chinese: 那……那是很久以前的事了。

English: Are you technically alive? Or dead?
Chinese: 严格来说你们是活的？还是死的？

English: Oh, Endless scholars have been debating that one for centuries. We don't breathe, our hearts are still, and we rot instead of ageing. But we never actually ((died.)) And we still hunger, though not for food.
Chinese: 哦，无尽者的学者们为这个问题争了几百年。我们不呼吸，心脏静止不动，我们在腐烂而非衰老。但我们从未真正((死去))。我们仍然饥饿，只是不为食物。

English: I seek an audience with the Queen of Silver.
Chinese: 我求见白银女王。

English: Alas, the Queen isn't accepting visitors at this time. Or at any time, really. She is... Withdrawn. Most days she will speak to me, and me alone.
Chinese: 唉，女王现在不接待访客。其实什么时候都不接待。她……与世隔绝。大多数日子里，她只肯跟我说话，也只有我一个人。

English: Can you teach me how to cheat death?
Chinese: 你能教我怎么骗过死亡吗？

English: Oh dear. Not another one. How many mortals must we turn away before you learn your lesson? The Endless are not recruiting. And please don't burden me with another sob-story.
Chinese: 哦天哪。又来一个。我们要回绝多少凡人你们才能吸取教训？无尽者不招人。也请别再用苦情故事来烦我。

English: Why can't you make an exception for me?
Chinese: 为什么不能为我破个例？

English: You don't want to be like us, mortal. As time passes, your flesh will rot. Your eyes will drool from their sockets like last week's milk. You will feel hunger, ((true)) hunger, for the first time in your existence, and it will never. Go. Away.
Chinese: 你不会想变成我们这样的，凡人。时间一长，你的血肉会腐烂。你的眼珠会像馊了一周的牛奶一样从眼窝里淌出来。你将第一次感受到饥饿，((真正的))饥饿，此生从未体验过的饥饿，而且它永远。不会。消失。

English: Didn't you make Penitent Thaw into an Endless?
Chinese: 你们不是把忏悔者·索变成了无尽者吗？

English: Hmph. That wasn't my decision. And when we did that, we all vowed never to make another Endless again.
Chinese: 哼。那不是我的决定。而且做成那件事之后，我们全都发过誓，再也不造第二个无尽者。

English: Has any member of the Dark Star company visited the Castle of Ribs recently?
Chinese: 最近有黑星佣兵团的成员到访过肋骨城堡吗？

English: No, but I can help you find them if you like? I can just send word to my retinue and have them scour the land.
Chinese: 没有，不过如果你愿意，我可以帮你找？我给随从们传个话，让他们搜遍全国。

English: That would be helpful.
Chinese: 那太好了。

English: It shall be done! Can I assist you with anything else?
Chinese: 马上照办！还有别的需要帮忙的吗？

English: Don't your soldiers have something better to do?
Chinese: 你的士兵们就没有更要紧的事做吗？

English: No, the Queen relieved them of their duties long ago. Most of them have gone about their own business, or thrown their lot in with Thaw, but a few remain loyal to me.
Chinese: 没有，女王很久以前就免了他们的职务。大多数人各奔前程，或者投奔了索，但仍有少数人效忠于我。

English: No thanks. I work alone.
Chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我单打独斗。

English: Aha, we have a lone wolf, do we? A loose cannon, perhaps? Fear not! I won't cramp your style
Chinese: 啊哈，来了匹独狼，是吧？还是个不受约束的莽汉？别怕！我不会搅了你的好事

English: No luck yet in finding your Dark Star fellows. My guards have been going over the island with a fine-toothed comb. Perhaps you are better served looking elsewhere?
Chinese: 还没找到你那些黑星同伙。我的卫兵已经把全岛翻了个底朝天。或许你去别处找找更好？

English: Do you know what's causing these earthquakes?
Chinese: 你知道这些地震是怎么回事吗？

English: Hmm. It is a common belief that the Entombed One is causing the recent disturbances.
Chinese: 嗯。人们普遍认为是墓中人造成了最近的骚动。

English: Do you have any theories about the Entombed One?
Chinese: 关于墓中人你有什么推测吗？

English: Ah, yes. Have you experienced one of the recent earthquakes? A terrible business.
Chinese: 啊，对。你经历过最近的地震吗？真是可怕的事。

English: I have reason to believe that the Entombed One is the lingering spectre of the Hooded King, getting his revenge on the kingdom that left him for dead. Someone needs to find him and persuade him to abandon his vendetta... By force, if necessary.
Chinese: 我有理由相信，墓中人就是兜帽王不散的怨灵，正在向这个弃他于死地的王国复仇。得有人找到他，劝他放下这场血仇……必要时可以用强。

English: I can try.
Chinese: 我可以试试。

English: You would do that? I would be in your debt. Here, take this - it's a key to the crypt beneath the Castle. The Entombed One is somewhere down there.
Chinese: 你愿意？那我就欠你一份人情了。来，拿着这个——这是城堡地下墓穴的钥匙。墓中人就在下面某处。

English: Good luck with that.
Chinese: 祝你好运。

English: Thank you, mortal. For your sake, I hope the situation doesn't get worse while you're here.
Chinese: 谢谢你，凡人。为了你好，希望你在这儿的时候局面别变得更糟。

English: There's a fanged door in the crypts that won't let me past.
Chinese: 墓穴里有一扇长獠牙的门，不让我过去。

English: Oh, dear. That sounds like one of the Hooded King's little tests. I thought we'd found and dispelled them all...
Chinese: 哦，天哪。听起来像兜帽王的小考验之一。我以为我们已经把它们全部找出并解除了……

English: What should I do?
Chinese: 我该怎么办？

English: You'll need to find someone who's still loyal to the old King, and convince them to give you their blood. Not an easy task, I appreciate.
Chinese: 你得找一个仍然效忠老国王的人，说服他把血给你。我知道，这可不是件容易事。

English: Could I use your blood?
Chinese: 我可以用你的血吗？

English: No, I'm afraid I would definitely be considered a traitor by the spell. You're better off looking elsewhere.
Chinese: 不行，恐怕那咒文一定会把我当成叛徒。你还是另找他人吧。

English: Thanks for the help.
Chinese: 谢谢帮忙。

English: I have spoken to the Entombed One.
Chinese: 我跟墓中人谈过了。

English: Oh, you did? Was I right? Is it the Hooded King?
Chinese: 哦，是吗？我说对了吗？是兜帽王吗？

English: No. It's a ghost of the Queen's sacrifice.
Chinese: 不。那是女王献祭所化的幽灵。

English: Really? I had no idea a ghost could be so powerful... Perhaps you should talk to Penitent Thaw about that. She'd know more.
Chinese: 真的？我竟不知道幽灵能有这么强的力量……这事你或许该去找忏悔者·索谈谈。她懂得更多。

English: Did you at least persuade the Queen's ghost to stop causing earthquakes?
Chinese: 那你至少劝住女王的幽灵，让它别再引发地震了吗？

English: Yes, you were right.
Chinese: 是的，你说对了。

English: No. Not yet.
Chinese: 没有。还没有。

English: I tried, but the ghost is beyond reason.
Chinese: 我试过了，但那幽灵不可理喻。

English: Then you should speak to the Queen. She has more insight into her father's nature than I do.
Chinese: 那你该去跟女王谈谈。对于她父亲的本性，她比我看得更透。

English: I tried, but she is too far gone.
Chinese: 我试过了，但她已经病入膏肓。

English: Then you should speak to the Queen. This is her ghost, after all. Perhaps she can offer insight.
Chinese: 那你该去跟女王谈谈。毕竟那是她的幽灵。也许她能提供些见解。

English: Absolutely.
Chinese: 没问题。

English: Marvellous news! Well, in that case, we can consider this matter laid to rest, can't we?
Chinese: 太好了！那么这样一来，这件事就算了结了，不是吗？

English: There's an Endless named Myghar in a crypt who won't let me in.
Chinese: 有个叫米加尔的无尽者占着一间墓穴，不让我进去。

English: Oh, goodness, I completely forgot he was down there. Yes, that's Myghar alright. He paid a formidable sum of money to be allowed exclusive use of the castle's crypt as his 'final resting place.'
Chinese: 哦，天哪，我完全忘了他还在下面。没错，就是米加尔。他付了一大笔钱，买下了城堡墓穴的专用权，当作他的"安息之地"。

English: How long has he been down there?
Chinese: 他在下面待了多久了？

English: Oh, not long. Only about twenty years.
Chinese: 哦，不久。才二十年左右。

English: Twenty years? How has he survived that long without life-essence?
Chinese: 二十年？没有生命精华他怎么能撑这么久？

English: As I recall, he had his own small flesh-farm installed. In theory, he can survive down there indefinitely.
Chinese: 我记得，他装了个自己的小型血肉农场。理论上，他可以在下面无限期地活下去。

English: Why does he want to stay in the castle crypts?
Chinese: 他为什么想待在城堡墓穴里？

English: The prestige, I suppose. Myghar was one of the wealthiest citizens in the kingdom, and always wanted to be seen to outdo his peers. They retreated into the Mausoleums, but he wanted nothing less than the royal crypt.
Chinese: 大概是为了脸面吧。米加尔曾是王国最富有的公民之一，总想在同侪面前压人一头。别人都退进了陵墓，他却非皇家墓穴不要。

English: How can I get him to open the door?
Chinese: 我怎么才能让他开门？

English: It'll be difficult. He always was a stubborn fool. But I imagine he's been pretty bored, cooped up in that crypt - perhaps if you offered him some new reading material?
Chinese: 会很困难。他一直是个固执的蠢货。不过我猜他被关在那墓穴里也闷得慌——也许你可以给他带点新的读物？

English: Do you know where I can find a woman named Wren?
Chinese: 你知道我去哪儿能找到一个叫蕾恩的女人吗？

English: Wren... Wren... Ah, yes. Terribly sad. She was eaten by a Catacomb Wyrm about ten years ago. Did you know her?
Chinese: 蕾恩……蕾恩……啊，对。真令人难过。大约十年前她被一条地窟蠕虫吃了。你认识她？

English: No, but a friend of mine did.
Chinese: 不认识，但我有个朋友认识。

English: Ah. Well, I am sorry to be the bearer of bad news.
Chinese: 啊。唉，很抱歉由我来告诉你这个坏消息。

English: I dug her husband up recently.
Chinese: 我最近把她丈夫挖了出来。

English: Oh, you found Mermero? How marvellous! I had thought he was lost for good.
Chinese: 哦，你找到梅梅罗了？太好了！我还以为他永远找不回来了。

English: Yes, she and I were very close.
Chinese: 是的，我和她曾非常亲密。

English: Oh dear. I am so sorry. Let me know if there's anything I can do.
Chinese: 哦，天哪。我很遗憾。有什么我能做的尽管开口。

English: Any idea why a talking crow has been asking me to put its feathers in braziers around the kingdom?
Chinese: 你知道为什么一只会说话的乌鸦一直让我把它的羽毛放进全国各地的火盆里吗？

English: ...I couldn't speculate. But don't touch those braziers. The Hooded King placed those all around the Kingdom as part of the ritual to turn himself immortal. Dark magic was woven into the iron. Promise me that you won't mess around with them.
Chinese: ……我可不敢妄加猜测。但别碰那些火盆。兜帽王为了把自己变成永生的仪式，把它们布满了整个王国。黑暗魔法织进了那些铁器里。答应我，别去乱动它们。

English: I promise.
Chinese: 我答应你。

English: Thank you.
Chinese: 谢谢。

English: I will do as I please.
Chinese: 我乐意怎么做就怎么做。

English: Just be careful, I implore you.
Chinese: 只求你千万小心。

English: Was there anything else?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗？

English: <<The rotted woman advances toward you, her robes trailing along the ground. Nearby is a floating cage, inhabited by a twitching, gibbering corpse. The cage drifts closer to you, gaining momentum.>>
Chinese: <<腐烂的女人朝你走来，长袍拖曳在地上。附近悬浮着一个笼子，里面住着一具抽搐着、胡言乱语的尸体。笼子朝你漂近，越来越快。>>

English: You again, mortal. I presume you have... <<She sighs.>> ##...questions.
Chinese: 又是你，凡人。我猜你又有……<<她叹了口气。>>##……问题。

English: Hang on. Stand right there. Don't move a muscle.
Chinese: 等等。站在原地。一动也别动。

English: What?
Chinese: 什么？

English: One step closer and I'll cut your head off.
Chinese: 再靠近一步我就砍下你的脑袋。

English: <<The caged corpse opens its mouth and begins to sing a giddy melody. Your shadow lifts from the ground and wraps itself around your knees, bearing you down to the floor.>>
Chinese: <<笼中的尸体张开嘴，唱起一支令人眩晕的曲调。你的影子从地上飘起，缠住你的双膝，把你压倒在地。>>

English: Why have you come here? Are you an assassin? A thief? A rival mage, seeking to steal my secrets?
Chinese: 你为什么来这里？你是刺客？窃贼？还是想窃取我秘密的同行法师？

English: What did you do to me?
Chinese: 你对我做了什么？

English: My familiar has cast a spell to keep you from doing anything that you might regret. Now answer my questions.
Chinese: 我的使魔对你施了咒，免得你做出让自己后悔的事。现在回答我的问题。

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: My name is Penitent Thaw. Some call me the greatest living mage in the skyrealms. Personally, I'm not sure I'm truly alive, but the rest of it is right.
Chinese: 我叫忏悔者·索。有人称我是天空领域最伟大的在世法师。我个人倒不确定自己算不算"在世"，但其余的部分没错。

English: So you better answer my questions carefully.##Are you an assassin? A thief? A rival mage?
Chinese: 所以你最好仔细回答我的问题。##你是刺客？窃贼？还是同行法师？

English: None of those. Just a mortal, passing through.
Chinese: 都不是。只是个路过的凡人。

English: And what is a mortal doing in the kingdom of the Endless? Didn't you listen to all the scary stories about this place?
Chinese: 那一个凡人在无尽者的王国里做什么？你没听过关于这个地方的那些恐怖故事吗？

English: Yes. I wanted to see if they were true.
Chinese: 听过。我想看看是不是真的。

English: Aha. Someone after my own heart, I see.
Chinese: 啊哈。我看你倒是和我心意相通。

English: What stories?
Chinese: 什么故事？

English: Oh, you know. Stories about the kingdom that ate itself. The land of ghosts and corpses. Ancient, rotted armies crusading across the skies to slaughter all mortals. That sort of thing.
Chinese: 哦，你懂的。关于那个把自己吃掉的王国。鬼魂与尸骸之地。古老腐朽的军队在天空间远征，杀尽所有凡人。诸如此类。

English: Wouldn't be here if I did.
Chinese: 听过的话我就不会来了。

English: Well, perhaps you should have.
Chinese: 哦，那你也许真该听进去。

English: I'm chasing someone from the Dark Star company.
Chinese: 我在追查黑星佣兵团的某个人。

English: Dark Star, eh? I take it you're after Vela Callose.
Chinese: 黑星是吧？我猜你追的是薇拉·卡洛斯。

English: You know her?
Chinese: 你认识她？

English: Only by reputation. Unlike the rest of the Endless, I actually make an effort to keep up with affairs in the outside world. So why are you chasing the most dangerous mercenary in all the skyrealms, exactly?
Chinese: 只闻其名。不像其他无尽者，我还真的会留意外面世界的动静。所以，你究竟为什么要追查全天空领域最危险的佣兵？

English: No comment.
Chinese: 无可奉告。

English: Ha. A wise answer. But I can hear your heartbeat quicken at her name, I can see your eyes dilate a fraction. You're after her. Why?
Chinese: 哈。聪明的回答。但我听得见你听到她名字时心跳加速，看得见你的瞳孔微微放大。你在追她。为什么？

English: I've been forced into it by the Inquisition.
Chinese: 我是被迫的，宗教裁判所逼的。

English: Interesting. They must be desperate indeed, to be trying to get a pawn like you to the end of the board.
Chinese: 有意思。他们想把你这颗小卒推到棋盘尽头，看来是真的走投无路了。

English: Seemed like a good idea at the time.
Chinese: 当时觉得这是个好主意。

English: Hmm. You intrigue me, mortal.
Chinese: 嗯。你引起了我的兴趣，凡人。

English: All of the above, and more!
Chinese: 以上皆是，还有更多！

English: I ((like)) you. Very well, I'll let you hang around here. But one wrong move and I'll turn you into a blind, formless blob of open nerve endings.
Chinese: 我((喜欢))你。很好，我允许你在这儿转悠。但稍有差池，我就把你变成一团瞎眼的、没有形状的、裸露着神经末梢的烂肉。

English: <<She makes a dismissive motion with her hand. As suddenly as they came, the shadows recede, leaving you free to stand up.>>
Chinese: <<她做了个挥手打发的动作。那些影子说来也去得突然，退散而去，你可以站起来了。>>

English: I have questions. About you.
Chinese: 我有问题。关于你。

English: Well keep it brief, mortal. I'm a busy woman.
Chinese: 那就长话短说，凡人。我可是个大忙人。

English: What kind of name is 'Penitent?'
Chinese: 忏悔者是个什么名字？

English: My parents were religious to the point of madness. My full name is 'Approach-Thy-Death-With-A-Penitent-Heart.' Believe me, if you had a name like that, you'd shorten it too.
Chinese: 我父母虔诚到了疯狂的地步。我的全名是"怀忏悔之心奔赴死亡"。相信我，你要是有这么个名字，你也会把它缩短的。

English: What is this place?
Chinese: 这是什么地方？

English: This is my sanctum. Here, I peel back the layers of reality and glimpse the terrifying truths beyond. I teach myself languages that were exiled from history. I push alchemy and necrotheurgy to its limits. I am more than just a mage, mortal - I am a pioneer.
Chinese: 这里是我的圣所。在这里，我层层剥开现实，窥见背后骇人的真相。我自学被历史放逐的语言。我把炼金术和死灵神术推向极限。我不只是一个法师，凡人——我是个开拓者。

English: What's that thing in the cage?
Chinese: 笼子里那东西是什么？

English: This is my familiar. My ex-husband's soul. I turned him into an embodiment of, and amplifier for, all my spells and wards. If he ever escapes the cage, you better start running and not look back.
Chinese: 这是我的使魔。我前夫的灵魂。我把他变成了我所有咒语与结界的化身和增幅器。他要是逃出笼子，你最好拔腿就跑，头也别回。

English: @@Why did you turn your ex-husband into a familiar?
Chinese: @@你为什么把你前夫变成使魔？

English: %%I was married to my husband to secure an alliance for my family, and I never much liked him. A man whose brains were in his fists.
Chinese: %%我嫁给我丈夫是为了给家族缔结联盟，我从来就不怎么喜欢他。一个脑子长在拳头上的男人。

English: Once upon a time I promised him that one day, when I was a powerful mage, I'd come back to our pathetic village and make a Hell of my own devising, just for him.
Chinese: 曾经我向他保证过，等我成为强大的法师，总有一天会回到我们那个可怜的村子，为他量身打造一个地狱。

English: I made good on my promise.
Chinese: 我兑现了我的诺言。

English: &&My husband and I disliked each other. Let's leave it at that.
Chinese: &&我和我丈夫彼此厌恶。就说这么多吧。

English: I have questions about the Endless.
Chinese: 我有问题想问无尽者的事。

English: Ask away. Far be it from me to stand in the way of an inquiring mind.
Chinese: 问吧。我可不拦着好学之人。

English: What is your opinion of the Queen of Silver?
Chinese: 你怎么看白银女王？

English: I have a low opinion of royalty. Useless, for the most part. And the Queen isn't necessarily an exception, but she did give me this sanctum and the freedom to experiment as I please. So she suits my purposes, and if anyone challenges her, I will quite happily destroy them.
Chinese: 我对王室评价不高。大多无用。女王倒未必例外，但她的确给了我这座圣所，还有随心实验的自由。所以她合我的用，谁要是挑战她，我会非常乐意毁掉对方。

English: How did you become an Endless?
Chinese: 你是怎么变成无尽者的？

English: Unlike the rest of the walking cadavers you've no doubt met, I only arrived here two centuries ago. I was dying of some embarrassing, incurable malady that made me cough and splutter like an idiot. I requested to be made one of the Endless, but they denied me.
Chinese: 不像你无疑遇见过的其他行尸，我是两个世纪前才到这儿的。当时我染上了一种难堪的不治之症，咳个不停，像个傻瓜一样喘气。我请求成为无尽者，但他们拒绝了。

English: Well, first they tried to eat me, but I kept them at bay with magic. ((Then)) they denied me. But they were impressed by my spells, and allowed me to stay in the kingdom for a while.
Chinese: 嗯，他们起先想把我吃掉，但我用魔法把他们挡住了。((然后))他们拒绝了我。不过他们被我的咒语折服，允许我在王国里逗留一阵。

English: How did you persuade them?
Chinese: 你是怎么说服他们的？

English: What did you do?
Chinese: 你做了什么？

English: Over the next year, clinging to life by a thread, I secretly created the first of the flesh-farms. And I told the Queen that I could make more, enough to sustain the whole kingdom without need for bloodshed... But I was going to die soon, and I'd take my secrets with me.
Chinese: 接下来的一年里，我命悬一线，秘密造出了第一座血肉农场。然后我告诉女王，我还能造更多，多到无需流血就能养活整个王国……但我快要死了，会把这些秘密带进坟墓。

English: Well, I was made an Endless pretty quickly after that, I can assure you.
Chinese: 嗯，我敢向你保证，那之后我很快就成了无尽者。

English: Lord Rhydder doesn't seem to like you.
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵似乎不太喜欢你。

English: Of course he doesn't. When I came along, I promised him I'd make him magical weapons of war that could turn a whole island into a crater. He gave me all the funding and equipment I asked for.
Chinese: 他当然不喜欢。我来的时候，向他许诺会造出能把整座岛炸成弹坑的魔法战争兵器。他要多少钱和装备我都拿。

English: Instead of a weapon, I made the first flesh-farm, and destroyed the whole reason that the Endless were crusading in the first place. Lord Rhydder's power was shattered overnight.
Chinese: 结果我没造兵器，而是造了第一座血肉农场，把无尽者当初远征的根本理由连根拔掉。里德尔勋爵的权势一夜之间灰飞烟灭。

English: I want to ask about something else...
Chinese: 我想问点别的……

English: Go on, go on, but make it quick. I'm growing bored.
Chinese: 说吧说吧，但快点。我开始无聊了。

English: Hmph. Well are you going to natter about anything else?
Chinese: 哼。怎么，你还要唠叨别的吗？

English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Mmm.
Chinese: 嗯哼。

English: About those vats of flesh down there...
Chinese: 关于下面那些大槽里的肉……

English: The flesh-farms. A fine invention, if I do say so myself.
Chinese: 血肉农场。恕我自夸，确实是项了不起的发明。

English: You created the flesh-farms?
Chinese: 血肉农场是你造的？

English: Oh, yes. I've always been interested in transgressing the boundaries of the flesh. The Endless needed life-force, you see, and they were getting it through the most barbaric means...
Chinese: 哦，没错。我一直醉心于跨越血肉的界限。你看，无尽者需要生命力，而他们获取的方式极其野蛮……

English: First they ate their fellow countrymen, then when they ran out of mortals, they started attacking other islands.
Chinese: 起先他们吃自己的同胞，凡人吃光之后，就开始进攻别的岛屿。

English: Then I arrived, and I put a stop to all that. The magic was quite complex, so I won't go into it, but the flesh-farms are non-sentient, and provide enough life-force for the Endless to gorge themselves sick. And all without hurting a single soul.
Chinese: 然后我来了，我把这一切都终结了。那魔法相当复杂，我就不细说了，总之血肉农场没有知觉，却能提供充足的生命力，让无尽者吃到撑到发腻。而且不伤任何一条性命。

English: Lord Rhydder knows that the flesh-farm is sentient.
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵知道血肉农场有知觉。

English: Well, that's it, then. I was hoping we wouldn't have to do this, but... Here you go. ##<<She hands you a bundle of strange orbs.>>
Chinese: 好吧，那就这样吧。我本希望我们不必走到这一步，但是……拿去。##<<她递给你一堆奇怪的卵球。>>

English: These are phage-spider eggs. Enough of these things can skeletonize an entire village in a matter of hours. They'll destroy the flesh-farm and leave no trace, once they hatch.
Chinese: 这些是噬疫蛛卵。这些东西积累够了，几个小时就能把一整座村子啃成白骨。一旦孵化，它们会毁掉血肉农场，不留一丝痕迹。

English: Just deposit the eggs on top of the flesh-mass and leave as quickly as you can. Once they hatch, the spiders will devour the flesh in about thirty-five minutes.
Chinese: 只要把卵放在肉块顶上，然后尽快离开。一旦孵化，那些蜘蛛大约三十五分钟内就会把肉吃个精光。

English: You expect me to annihilate a totally unique life-form?
Chinese: 你指望我去灭杀一个独一无二的生命体？

English: For the good of the whole world, yes. If the Endless can't feed on flesh-farms, we'll launch a second Cadaver Crusade. Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow, but when we get hungry enough, Lord Rhydder will start to sound very convincing...
Chinese: 是的，为了整个世界的福祉。如果无尽者不能靠血肉农场进食，我们就会发动第二次尸骸十字军。也许不是今天，也许不是明天，但等我们饿得够呛，里德尔勋爵的话就会变得非常有说服力……

English: How bad would that be?
Chinese: 那会有多糟？

English: The first one killed tens of thousands of human beings. Do you want that on your conscience?
Chinese: 第一次就杀了成千上万的人。你想让这笔血债压在良心上吗？

English: There must be another way.
Chinese: 一定还有别的办法。

English: The only other way is to continue to feast on the flesh-farms. Keeping them in captivity, even though we know they feel pain. It's just a different flavour of atrocity.
Chinese: 唯一的另一条路，就是继续以血肉农场为食。把它们圈养起来，尽管我们明知它们会感到痛苦。这不过是另一种口味的暴行。

English: Fine, I'll do it.
Chinese: 好吧，我来做。

English: I'm so glad that you understand the severity of the issue. Now, off with you.
Chinese: 你能明白事态的严重性，我太欣慰了。现在，去吧。

English: I refuse to be a part of this.
Chinese: 我拒绝参与这事。

English: That's the problem with you mortals. You're not practical. Now begone.
Chinese: 这就是你们凡人的毛病。不切实际。滚吧。

English: Did you know that the flesh-farm is becoming self-aware?
Chinese: 你知道血肉农场正在产生自我意识吗？

English: Interesting. Elaborate.
Chinese: 有意思。细说。

English: I conducted a lengthy conversation with it inside my head.
Chinese: 我在脑海里跟它进行了长谈。

English: It can only speak to the living, but it can speak.
Chinese: 它只能跟活物说话，但它确实能说话。

English: No.
Chinese: 不知道。

English: ...You are the most vexing mortal I have ever met, did you know that?
Chinese: ……你是我见过最气人的凡人，你知道吗？

English: What level of intelligence are we talking about here? Did it exhibit any unusual traits or particularly alien preferences?
Chinese: 我们说的是什么程度的智慧？它有没有表现出什么异常特征或特别怪异的偏好？

English: It seems to have become obsessed with feeling pleasure... somehow.
Chinese: 它好像迷上了感受快乐……不知怎么的。

English: A hedonist. Hmmm. Not good. Anything else?
Chinese: 一个享乐主义者。嗯。不妙。还有别的吗？

English: It seems to have become obsessed with amassing power... somehow.
Chinese: 它好像迷上了积攒力量……不知怎么的。

English: A megalomaniac. Hmmm. Not good. Anything else?
Chinese: 一个权欲狂。嗯。不妙。还有别的吗？

English: It seems to have become obsessed with seeking knowledge... somehow.
Chinese: 它好像迷上了追求知识……不知怎么的。

English: A scholar. Hmmm. Well, that's not too bad. Anything else?
Chinese: 一个学者。嗯。这个倒还不坏。还有别的吗？

English: Only that it doesn't want to be used as a food source.
Chinese: 只有一样，它不想被当成食物来源。

English: I suppose that makes sense. I wouldn't either.
Chinese: 我想这也说得通。换我也不会愿意。

English: It's lonely.
Chinese: 它很孤独。

English: Understandable, I suppose. You're probably the first person it's spoken to. Ever.
Chinese: 我想这可以理解。你大概是它交谈过的第一个人。有史以来第一个。

English: It seems remarkably intelligent, for a lump of flesh.
Chinese: 对一团血肉来说，它似乎聪明得惊人。

English: That's worrying.
Chinese: 这就让人担心了。

English: Listen, mortal. What you're saying should be impossible...
Chinese: 听着，凡人。你说的这些本该是不可能的事……

English: But if you're telling the truth, we have a problem. If the flesh-farms are becoming sentient, and don't want to be eaten, then... Well, the Endless will no longer have a moral way to sustain themselves. It could mean a return to the bad old ways.
Chinese: 但如果你说的是真话，那我们就麻烦了。如果血肉农场正在产生知觉，而且不想被吃掉，那么……无尽者就再也没有合乎道德的维生方式了。这可能意味着回到过去那些坏日子里。

English: The bad old ways?
Chinese: 过去那些坏日子？

English: What do you mean?
Chinese: 你这话什么意思？

English: Oh no...
Chinese: 哦不……

English: Oh, yes.
Chinese: 哦，没错。

English: Before I came along and created the flesh-farms, the Endless sustained themselves by waging bloody war on other islands and eating their enemies. It was called the Cadaver Crusades.
Chinese: 在我到来并造出血肉农场之前，无尽者靠对其他岛屿发动血腥战争、吞食敌人来维生。那段时期被称为尸骸十字军。

English: Ever since they stopped, a few mad old bastards like Lord Rhydder have been pushing for them to return.
Chinese: 自从十字军停摆以来，里德尔勋爵那样几个疯老头子就一直在鼓吹让它重出江湖。

English: Why would anyone want to go back to that?
Chinese: 谁会想回到那种日子？

English: Bloodlust. Arrogance. Power. Take your pick.
Chinese: 嗜血。傲慢。权力。随你挑。

English: But surely the Endless have changed since then?
Chinese: 但那之后无尽者总归变了吧？

English: Circumstances change. People don't. And if circumstances go back to how they were...
Chinese: 时势会变。人不会。要是时势退回原来的样子……

English: It's still easier to eat the farmed flesh, though, right?
Chinese: 不过吃农场的肉还是更省事，对吧？

English: But is it more ethical? Lord Rhydder will argue that it's an atrocity. That it's far better to go out and hunt our food honestly, rather than keeping a sentient being in slavery and torture. And he might even be right.
Chinese: 但那样就更道德吗？里德尔勋爵会说那是暴行。说与其奴役、折磨一个有知觉的生命，不如光明正大地出门猎食。而且他甚至可能是对的。

English: What should we do, then?
Chinese: 那我们该怎么办？

English: Most importantly, we need to kill the flesh-farm that's developed sentience. It might be the only one. There are dozens of flesh-farms in the kingdom, buried under the mausoleums - and we don't want this infection to spread to any more of them.
Chinese: 最要紧的，我们得杀死那个产生了知觉的血肉农场。它可能是唯一的一个。王国里埋在陵墓底下还有几十座血肉农场——我们可不想让这种感染蔓延到更多农场。

English: But surely it has a right to life?
Chinese: 但它难道没有生存的权利吗？

English: It's a lump of inanimate flesh, we'd be doing it a favour.
Chinese: 它就是一团没有生命的肉，杀死它算帮它解脱。

English: That's murder!
Chinese: 那是谋杀！

English: What are you, a lawyer?
Chinese: 你算哪门子律师？

English: Good idea.
Chinese: 好主意。

English: In addition, we need to ensure that Lord Rhydder never hears about this. Have you told anyone else?
Chinese: 另外，我们得确保里德尔勋爵永远别听说这事。你还告诉过别人吗？

English: Only Maggotson.
Chinese: 只告诉了马戈特森。

English: You fool. You need to go check on him, at once. Go!
Chinese: 你这个蠢货。你得马上去看看他。快去！

English: No, not yet.
Chinese: 没有，还没有。

English: That's a relief. If you had, and they went around blabbing about it, they would be in terrible danger. Now, begone.
Chinese: 那就好。你要是说了，而他们又到处嚷嚷，他们就会有杀身之祸。好了，去吧。

English: So all along, you knew the identity of the Entombed One?
Chinese: 所以一直以来，你都知道墓中人的身份？

English: I am a mage, mortal. I hoard secrets like a miser hoards gold. And do you know the fastest way to run out of secrets? To tell everybody about them!
Chinese: 我是个法师，凡人。我囤积秘密，就像守财奴囤积金子。你知道秘密最快败光的方式是什么吗？逢人便讲！

English: I heard it was the Entombed One who made you into an Endless.
Chinese: 听说是墓中人把你变成无尽者的。

English: Yes, that's right. The Entombed One is the living remnants of the initial botched spell, mingled with a vengeful ghost. A particularly toxic combination.
Chinese: 没错。墓中人是那场最初搞砸的咒文残存的部分，混着一个复仇的幽灵。一份毒性极强的组合。

English: But useful for me. Since the spell had lingered, I was able to benefit from its full effects.
Chinese: 但对我有用。既然咒文经久不散，我便能享受它完整的效力。

English: Can the Entombed One be stopped?
Chinese: 墓中人拦得住吗？

English: Anything is possible. But this one's tricky. The spell-ghost is deeply unstable, and it has embedded itself so thoroughly into the magical fabric of the landscape that simply attacking it could tear the kingdom apart.
Chinese: 一切皆有可能。但这位不好对付。咒灵极不稳定，而且它已深深嵌入这片大地的魔法织物之中，贸然攻击它都可能把整个王国撕碎。

English: I recommend diplomacy. The Queen is a reasonable woman. Surely her ghost is reasonable too?
Chinese: 我建议外交手段。女王是个讲道理的人。她的幽灵想必也讲道理？

English: But what if diplomacy fails?
Chinese: 可要是外交失败了呢？

English: I have a contingency in mind. ## <<Penitent rummages around in her shelves. Finally, she returns with a slender vial in her hand.>>
Chinese: 我心里有个备手。##<<忏悔者在她的架子上翻找。终于，她手里拿着一只细长的瓶子回来了。>>

English: This is a condensed potion of the happiest memories I've harvested from mind-slurry. I'd hoped to keep it for, uh, personal use... But perhaps it will be of use in persuading the Entombed One that this place is worth saving.
Chinese: 这是一瓶浓缩药水，用我从心灵浆里收割的最幸福的记忆炼成。我本想留着，呃，自己享用……但也许它能用来劝墓中人相信，这地方值得一救。

English: Are you loyal to the Hooded King?
Chinese: 你效忠兜帽王吗？

English: Before my time. When I arrived in the kingdom of the Endless, the King had already been missing for a century. Why do you ask?
Chinese: 那早在我来之前。我到无尽者王国的时候，国王已经失踪一个世纪了。你问这个做什么？

English: A magic door is asking me for loyal blood.
Chinese: 有扇魔法门管我要效忠之血。

English: Hmm. Is that all? If you don't mind waiting a bit, I'm sure I could whip up a convincing sample of counterfeit loyalty...
Chinese: 嗯。就这点事？你要是不介意等一小会儿，我确信能给你调一份以假乱真的"效忠"样品……

English: I don't mind waiting.
Chinese: 我不介意等。

English: Give me your arm, then.
Chinese: 那就把手臂伸过来。

English: Sorry, I'd rather not risk it.
Chinese: 抱歉，我不想冒这个险。

English: Suit yourself!
Chinese: 随你便！

English: I've changed my mind. I want that counterfeit blood.
Chinese: 我改主意了。我要那份假血。

English: <<Thaw grabs your arm and sticks a needle into it. Once she's taken what feels like an entire pint of your blood, she begins bustling around her sanctum, whistling tunelessly.>>
Chinese: <<索抓住你的手臂，把一根针刺了进去。等她抽走了差不多整整一品脱的血，她便开始在圣所里忙碌起来，跑调地吹着口哨。>>

English: <<First, she pours your blood into a cauldron. Then, she mutters some spells over it. Finally, she tips in a number of extra ingredients: a blue flower, a tuft of hair, a live goldfish.>>
Chinese: <<首先，她把你的血倒进坩埚。接着，她对它念念有词地施咒。最后，她加进了好几样额外的材料：一朵蓝花、一撮头发、一条活金鱼。>>

English: ((Wait.))
<<After some time, the mixture is complete. She hands you a bottle of sloshing red liquid.>>
Chinese: <<过了一阵子，混合完成了。她递给你一瓶晃荡的红色液体。>>

English: Here you go. Blood of convincing loyalty. Should pass muster under all but the most rigorous of spells.
Chinese: 拿好了。以假乱真的效忠之血。除了最严苛的咒文，其余都验不出来。

English: Thank you, Penitent.
Chinese: 谢谢你，忏悔者。

English: Begone.
Chinese: 滚吧。

English: How can I be sure it will work?
Chinese: 我怎么确定它会管用？

English: I made it. It'll work. ##Now begone.
Chinese: 我做的。会管用。##现在滚吧。

English: How can I repay you?
Chinese: 我怎么报答你？

English: By leaving me in peace for a while.##I've wasted too much time on you already.
Chinese: 让我清静一阵子就行。##我在你身上浪费的时间已经够多了。

English: I've dealt with the... situaton.
Chinese: 那件事……我处理好了。

English: So, the flesh-farm has been destroyed? Good; it is easily replaced. You've done well, mortal.
Chinese: 那么，血肉农场被毁掉了？很好；再建一座容易。你干得不错，凡人。

English: Rhydder will need proof to start this new crusade of his... and he shall find none.
Chinese: 里德尔要发动他的新十字军就得拿出证据……而他什么也找不到。

English: I suppose I can spare a few coins, for your trouble. Take these and begone.
Chinese: 我想我可以破费几枚硬币，慰劳你的辛苦。拿着这些，滚吧。

English: You utter fool, mortal. Do you know what you have done? With this proof, Rhydder will start another crusade...
Chinese: 你这个十足的蠢货，凡人。你知道你干了什么吗？有了这个证据，里德尔会再发动一场十字军……

English: Still, in the end - it is your kind who will suffer, mortal. I hope you are satisfied with your pathetic display of short-sighted ((morality)).
Chinese: 不过，到头来——受苦的是你们这种人，凡人。我希望你对你那可悲的目光短浅的((道德))表演感到满意。

English: I destroyed the eggs. The flesh-farm will live.
Chinese: 我把卵销毁了。血肉农场能活下来。

English: Hmph, foolish mortal. By the time I can concuct another means of destroying that thing, Lord Rhydder will have gathered his allies...
Chinese: 哼，愚蠢的凡人。等我想出另一种毁掉那东西的办法，里德尔勋爵早就把他的同党纠集齐了……

English: Yes, there's no stopping it now. There'll be another Crusade. ##This will set my research back years. ((Years!))
Chinese: 是啊，如今大势已去。又一场十字军在所难免。##这会让我的研究倒退好几年。((好几年！))

English: Though, I suppose I have gained a new test subject... <<Her frown relaxes, and a thin smile spreads over her face.>> ##Yes... the flesh-farm can keep its sentience, so long as it proves useful in... other ways.
Chinese: 不过，我想我倒是多了个新的实验对象……<<她的眉头舒展开来，一抹浅笑爬上脸庞。>>##是啊……血肉农场可以留着它的知觉，只要它能在……别的方面证明有用。

English: Now begone, mortal. You've wrought enough havoc.
Chinese: 现在滚吧，凡人。你造成的破坏已经够多了。

English: <<As the Queen casts her gaze upon you, you are overcome with a wave of melancholy so profound it almost drives you to your knees.>>
Chinese: <<当女王的目光落在你身上，一阵深切的忧郁袭来，几乎让你双膝一软跪倒在地。>>

English: Oh... Hello. I am afraid I am not receiving visitors at the moment. Please talk to my Seneschal, he will attend to you faithfully.
Chinese: 哦……你好。恐怕我现在不接待访客。请去找我的总管，他会忠实地照应你。

English: @@What seems to be the matter, your Majesty?
Chinese: @@陛下，您怎么了？

English: %%<<Ragged lips peel back from long yellow teeth. She seems to be attempting a smile.>>##You are a curious one, aren't you? But I can assure you there is nothing out of the ordinary.
Chinese: %%<<褴褛的嘴唇从长长的黄牙上咧开。她似乎在努力微笑。>>##你真是个好奇的家伙，不是吗？但我向你保证，一切如常。

English: Put quite simply, I am feeling the same as I did yesterday, and the same as I will tomorrow. Two hundred years ago you would have found me in this same castle, in this same seat, feeling the same as I do now.
Chinese: 说得简单些，我今天的感受和昨天一样，也会和明天一样。两百年前你就会发现我在同一座城堡里，坐在同一个座位上，感受着我此刻的感受。

English: That's awful.
Chinese: 太可怕了。

English: I have adjusted to it. I exist now in tranquility, and have no desire for your pity.
Chinese: 我已经适应了。我如今在宁静中存在，不需要你的怜悯。

English: Sounds boring.
Chinese: 听着挺无聊的。

English: I left boredom behind a long time ago. I exist now in tranquility, and have no desire for your pity.
Chinese: 无聊这种东西我早就抛下了。我如今在宁静中存在，不需要你的怜悯。

English: Oh, how tragic, you have to live in a giant luxurious castle surrounded by generational wealth.
Chinese: 哦，真悲惨，您不得不住在一座奢华的巨堡里，被世代累积的财富包围着。

English: <<She pauses for a moment, shocked. Then something like a laugh escapes.>>
Chinese: <<她怔了一瞬，颇为震惊。随后，一声近似笑的东西溜了出来。>>

English: You are a bold one, little mortal. And you are right. I face no great hardship.
Chinese: 你是个大胆的小凡人。而且你说得对。我并未遭受什么大苦。

English: &&<<Ragged lips peel back from long yellow teeth. She seems to be attempting a smile.>>
Chinese: &&<<褴褛的嘴唇从长长的黄牙上咧开。她似乎在努力微笑。>>

English: It is not of your concern, mortal. Please understand that I mean no disrespect. But one so young, so alive, cannot understand my plight.
Chinese: 这不关你的事，凡人。请理解，我并无冒犯之意。只是如此年轻、如此鲜活的人，无法理解我的困境。

English: But I came here to talk to you, not your lackey.
Chinese: 可我是来找你谈的，不是找你的走狗。

English: <<She is still and silent for what seems like a very long time. Then she sighs.>>
Chinese: <<她静默着，仿佛过了很久很久。然后她叹了口气。>>

English: Very well, mortal. I cannot bring myself to summon my guards. In fact, I'm not even sure if I have any guards, any more. Say your piece.
Chinese: 好吧，凡人。我实在唤不来我的卫兵。事实上，我都不知道自己还有没有卫兵。说吧。

English: My apologies for disturbing you.
Chinese: 打扰了，抱歉。

English: It is quite alright.##<<She resumes gazing at nothing.>>
Chinese: 没关系。##<<她继续凝望着虚空。>>

English: ...I am sorry for calling your Seneschal a lackey.
Chinese: ……对不起，我说你的总管是走狗。

English: He would be heartbroken to hear himself described in such a fashion. The poor fellow, the only thing he has left in the world is his dignity.
Chinese: 他要是听见自己被这样形容，会心碎的。可怜的人，他在这世上仅剩的就是他的尊严了。

English: I hope we haven't gotten off on the wrong foot?
Chinese: 希望我们没有一开始就处得不愉快？

English: I take no offence. Or rather, I take some offence, but cannot muster the enthusiasm to express it.
Chinese: 我没有动气。或者说，我有些动气，但提不起劲来表达。

English: I'm so ((honoured)) that you deign to speak to me.
Chinese: 您屈尊跟我说话，我真是((荣幸))之至。

English: You mortals are so fond of sarcasm. It comes with being young. Conversation is already so exhausting to the old, the repetition of these same tired old words and phrases, that we feel no need to wrap our barbs in pretty paper.
Chinese: 你们凡人真爱挖苦。这是年轻带来的毛病。对老人来说，交谈本就令人疲惫——同样陈词滥调翻来覆去——所以我们觉得没必要把讥讽包上漂亮的包装纸。

English: It sounds like you don't exactly have a busy schedule.
Chinese: 听起来您的日程好像也不怎么忙。

English: This is true. Yet my time is my own, even if it has little value, so I ask you not to waste it.
Chinese: 这倒是真的。但我的时间是我自己的，哪怕它没什么价值，所以请你不要浪费它。

English: You'd be surprised, I think.
Chinese: 我想您会吃惊的。

English: I haven't been surprised in two centuries, mortal.
Chinese: 我已经两个世纪没吃惊过了，凡人。

English: I have many questions, your Majesty.
Chinese: 我有很多问题，陛下。

English: Oh. Good.
Chinese: 哦。好啊。

English: I will waste no more of your time.
Chinese: 我不再浪费您的时间了。

English: Greetings, mortal. Did you have more questions?
Chinese: 你好，凡人。还有别的问题吗？

English: I had other questions, your Majesty...
Chinese: 我还有别的问题，陛下……

English: I see. Well, you may go ahead.
Chinese: 明白了。好吧，你请讲。

English: Goodbye, your Majesty.
Chinese: 再见，陛下。

English: Some of my questions are of a more personal nature...
Chinese: 我有些问题比较涉及隐私……

English: If you must.
Chinese: 如果非问不可。

English: Do you have heirs?
Chinese: 您有继承人吗？

English: No need for heirs. I will be here forever. And the Endless cannot have children.
Chinese: 不需要继承人。我会永远在这里。而且无尽者无法生育。

English: When was the last time you interacted with a mortal?
Chinese: 您上一次和凡人打交道是什么时候？

English: Let me see... Some years ago, I forget how many, a mortal came to the Castle of Ribs seeking to become Endless himself. The Seneschal was not able to dissuade her; she barged into the throne-room, much like you have.
Chinese: 让我想想……几年前——我忘了多少年——一个凡人来到肋骨城堡，想让自己成为无尽者。总管劝不住她；她闯进了王座厅，跟你现在差不多。

English: I turned her away, as I turn all such pilgrims away. We will add no more to our number. Thaw must be the last.
Chinese: 我把她拒之门外，就像我拒绝所有这样的朝圣者。我们的数量不会再增加。索必须是最后一个。

English: Tell me about your father.
Chinese: 跟我说说您的父亲。

English: My earliest memory is of him sitting atop his throne, looking so grim, while I sung for him. Then as I hit a particular high note, his dour face broke into such a broad smile. It was like magic. Like the sun had risen over a cemetery.
Chinese: 我最早的记忆是他端坐王座之上，面色阴沉，而我在为他歌唱。当我唱到某个特别高的音时，他阴沉的脸绽开了无比宽的笑。那像魔法。像太阳升起在一座墓园之上。

English: In those days, I would kneel beside my bed, and pray to a goddess whose name I have now forgotten that my father would never die. I was too young to know that gods pay no attention to the prayers of their people.
Chinese: 那些日子里，我常常跪在床边，向一位如今我已忘记名字的女神祈祷，求我父亲永远不死。我那时太年轻，不知道神明从不理会子民的祈祷。

English: The Seneschal saved your life, didn't he?
Chinese: 总管救了您的命，不是吗？

English: <<She casts a piercing gaze upon you, then the passion melts from her like snow in spring. She resumes gazing dully into the distance.>>##That's right. Against my wishes.
Chinese: <<她向你投来锐利的目光，随即那份激情如春雪般从她身上消融。她重又开始呆呆地凝望远方。>>##没错。违背我的心愿。

English: So you sacrificed yourself willingly?
Chinese: 所以您是自愿献祭的？

English: My father persuaded me to do it, for the good of the kingdom. He told me that I couldn't hope to rule as strongly or as wisely as him, but I could at least ensure he remained on the throne. He told me that what I was doing was noble.
Chinese: 我父亲说服了我，说是为了王国的利益。他告诉我，我不可能像他那样强势、英明地统治，但我至少能确保他继续坐在王位上。他告诉我，我所做的是高尚的事。

English: Surely you're glad he saved you?
Chinese: 您应该庆幸他救了您吧？

English: I know the Seneschal meant well, and I never had the heart to admonish him for it. But he brought a terrible curse upon the kingdom.
Chinese: 我知道总管是好意，我也始终不忍心为这事责备他。但他给王国带来了一场可怕的诅咒。

English: Your father sounds like a monster.
Chinese: 您父亲听起来像个怪物。

English: I don't think he was a monster. I think he was terribly, terribly afraid.
Chinese: 我不认为他是怪物。我认为他只是怕得要命，怕得要命。

English: It's a shame the ritual didn't succeed.
Chinese: 可惜仪式没成功。

English: Yes.
Chinese: 是啊。

English: I would have done the same, in the Seneschal's shoes.
Chinese: 我要是处在总管的位置，也会那么做。

English: I'd hope you would have intervened earlier, when you could have done some good. The Seneschal truly left it to the last possible moment before he dared to defy my father.
Chinese: 我倒希望你能在更早的时候出手，那时候还来得及做点什么。总管真是拖到最后一刻才敢违逆我父亲。

English: Can I ask you about the Endless?
Chinese: 我能问问无尽者的事吗？

English: My kingdom? I will oblige.
Chinese: 我的王国？我乐意奉告。

English: Where are your attendants? Your court?
Chinese: 您的侍从呢？您的宫廷呢？

English: No attendants. No court. I sent them away long ago.
Chinese: 没有侍从。没有宫廷。我很久以前就把他们遣散了。

English: How long have you ruled over the Endless?
Chinese: 您统治无尽者多久了？

English: Hundreds of years. I forget the exact number. Those earliest days were all fire and war.
Chinese: 几百年了。确切数字我忘了。最早那些年月只有烈火与战争。

English: Blood-red grins in the black of night. Hushed meetings over crudely-drawn maps. We were young, then. We did not call ourselves the Endless... All we knew was that we were hungry.
Chinese: 漆黑夜里血红的狞笑。围着潦草的地图密语低声。那时我们还年轻。我们还不叫自己无尽者……我们只知道一件事：我们饿了。

English: Are you a follower of the Ferryman?
Chinese: 您是摆渡人的信徒吗？

English: No. I don't trust this upstart god. Where did he come from? Why don't we have any records of him from before the Endless were created? Where was he during the God War?
Chinese: 不。我不信任这个暴发的神。他从哪儿来？为什么无尽者诞生之前没有任何关于他的记载？神之战的时候他又在哪儿？

English: Something is deeply wrong here, but my citizens are desperate enough to blindly worship any entity that promises them salvation.
Chinese: 这里面大有蹊跷，可我的臣民们已经绝望到愿意盲目崇拜任何一个许诺救赎的存有。

English: Is it true that Lord Rhydder used to be the power behind your throne?
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵曾经是您王座背后的实权人物，是真的吗？

English: Power. Hmph. Yes, I used to let him sally forth to other islands and fight his little Cadaver Crusades as he pleased. No doubt he thought himself quite the puppetmaster, but the truth is that I just didn't care.
Chinese: 实权。哼。是的，我以前随他出征别的岛屿，随他打他那点尸骸十字军，随他的便。毫无疑问他自以为是个了不起的提线人，但真相是我根本不在乎。

English: That's all for now.
Chinese: 暂时先到这儿。

English: I should hope so.
Chinese: 最好如此。

English: How were the Endless created?
Chinese: 无尽者是怎么被创造出来的？

English: A ritual, masterminded by my father. Ancient history. I wouldn't want to bore you with it.
Chinese: 一场仪式，我父亲主谋。陈年旧事了。我不想讲得让你无聊。

English: @@No, please. Tell me everything.
Chinese: @@不，请讲。全部告诉我。

English: Perhaps another time, then.
Chinese: 那也许改天再听。

English: Yes. Perhaps.
Chinese: 是啊。也许吧。

English: %%My father was a healthy man. Never ill. Never tired. He seemed to shrug off accidents that would leave a lesser man with broken bones.
Chinese: %%我父亲是个健壮的人。从不生病。从不疲倦。那些会让普通人骨折的意外，他似乎都能毫发无伤地挺过去。

English: So it was strange, how terrified he was of death. The very idea shook him to his core.
Chinese: 所以他的怕死才显得那么奇怪。光是"死"这个念头就让他从骨子里发抖。

English: As I was nearing adulthood, he gathered a legion of mages and theurges and priests from across the skyrealms, and tasked them to find the secret of immortality.
Chinese: 就在我快成年的时候，他从天空领域各处召集了一大群法师、神术师和祭司，命他们找出永生的秘密。

English: That old chestnut.
Chinese: 老掉牙的追求。

English: Indeed.
Chinese: 确实。

English: Judging by the fact you're still around today, it seems to have worked.
Chinese: 看您如今还坐在这儿，看来是成功了。

English: And did they?
Chinese: 那他们找到了吗？

English: In a manner of speaking, yes.
Chinese: 某种意义上，是的。

English: After numerous failed efforts, they devised a solution. It would require dozens of mages casting a spell simultaneously; extensive construction of ceremonial shrines, braziers and idols across the kingdom; a bargain struck with an ancient god; and a sacrifice.
Chinese: 在无数次失败之后，他们想出了一个方案。那需要几十名法师同时施咒；需要在全国大建仪式神龛、火盆和神像；需要与一位远古之神立约；还需要一场献祭。

English: Can you tell me about the sacrifice?
Chinese: 您能跟我说说那场献祭吗？

English: I... don't feel like getting into that now.
Chinese: 我……现在不想谈这个。

English: What was the name of the god?
Chinese: 那位神叫什么名字？

English: I do not know. Once I heard my father refer to it as a shadow of a dream, or the dream of a shadow. I forget which.
Chinese: 我不知道。有一次我听见父亲说它是"梦的影子"，或是"影子的梦"。我忘了哪个。

English: Long story short, the ritual failed. It created a twisted parody of immortality, afflicted with hunger and decay. And instead of affecting just my father, it cursed half the kingdom.
Chinese: 长话短说，仪式失败了。它造出一种扭曲的永生仿品，饱受饥饿与腐朽的折磨。而且诅咒没有只落在我父亲身上，它诅咒了半个王国。

English: Only half?
Chinese: 只有一半？

English: Half of the kingdom were Endless, and hungry. The other half did not last long. ##The Great Devouring commenced.
Chinese: 王国的一半成了无尽者，而且饿着肚子。另一半没能撑多久。##大吞噬就此开始。

English: What happened after that?
Chinese: 那之后发生了什么？

English: The Great Devouring commenced.
Chinese: 大吞噬就此开始。

English: And what happened to your father?
Chinese: 那您父亲呢？

English: I don't know. Perhaps he was one of those who remained mortal. The universe is cruel that way.
Chinese: 我不知道。也许他是保持凡人之躯的那批人中的一个。宇宙就是这样残忍。

English: &&I'm sorry, but it's not a tale I am fond of telling. Ask me something else.
Chinese: &&抱歉，这不是我乐意讲的故事。问点别的吧。

English: What do you know about the Entombed One?
Chinese: 关于墓中人您知道些什么？

English: I believe it is my father. After the ritual to grant him immortality went wrong, he fled beneath the castle, and got lost within the twisting passages.
Chinese: 我相信那就是我父亲。授予他永生的仪式出了差错之后，他逃到城堡底下，在盘绕的通道里迷失了。

English: Shouldn't you do something?
Chinese: 您不该做点什么吗？

English: Do what? Send guards down there? I have done so; they do not return. Go down there myself? Never. I cannot bear to see him again.
Chinese: 做什么？派卫兵下去？我派过了；他们没有回来。我自己下去？绝不。我受不了再见到他。

English: Are you sure it's him?
Chinese: 您确定那是他吗？

English: I know it in my bones.
Chinese: 我骨子里知道。

English: What if I went down there and tried to stop him from shaking the island apart?
Chinese: 要是我下去试着阻止他把这座岛摇散呢？

English: You are welcome to try; I believe my Seneschal has the key. But I don't expect you to succeed.
Chinese: 你尽管去试；我记得我的总管有钥匙。但我并不指望你成功。

English: The Entombed One is a ghost created by your sacrifice, your Majesty.
Chinese: 墓中人是由您的献祭产生的幽灵，陛下。

English: Yes. I know.
Chinese: 是的。我知道。

English: You knew this already?
Chinese: 您早就知道？

English: I did.
Chinese: 是的。

English: But you told me the Entombed One was your father.
Chinese: 可您告诉我墓中人是您父亲。

English: I was not lying. I see more of my father in that ghost than I see of myself.
Chinese: 我没有说谎。在那个幽灵身上，我看到的我父亲，比我自己还多。

English: How did you find out?
Chinese: 您是怎么发现的？

English: I have known that she was there from the very beginning of my reign.
Chinese: 从我登基的最开始，我就知道她在那儿。

English: Why didn't you tell me?
Chinese: 您为什么不告诉我？

English: For obvious reasons, I keep my ghost's existence a secret. If my subjects ever found out that a shade of their own Queen was trying to destroy them...
Chinese: 原因显而易见，我幽灵的存在是机密。要是我的臣民发现，他们女王自己的阴魂正试图毁灭他们……

English: When was the last time you saw the Entombed One yourself?
Chinese: 您自己最后一次见到墓中人是什么时候？

English: I last saw her two centuries ago, when I took Penitent Thaw down there to become one of the Endless.
Chinese: 我最后一次见到她是两个世纪前，我带忏悔者·索下去让她成为无尽者的时候。

English: Penitent knew about this too?
Chinese: 忏悔者也知道这事？

English: She is the only other who knows. It was unavoidable - the only way that I could grant her request to become an Endless.
