Chinese: 她是唯一另一个知情人。这是无法避免的——那是我能应允她成为无尽者的唯一办法。

English: Why did you lock her up down there?
Chinese: 您为什么把她锁在那下面？

English: I didn't lock her up. She could escape easily if she wanted to, but she refuses to stop haunting my father's bones.
Chinese: 我没有锁她。她想逃随时能逃，但她拒绝停止在我父亲的骸骨旁徘徊。

English: What exactly is she?
Chinese: 她到底是什么？

English: She is both spell and sacrifice. Partly a ghost, and partly the lingering remnant of the spell that turned the whole kingdom into Endless. That's one reason why she is so powerful, and why I needed her help to turn Penitent into an Endless.
Chinese: 她既是咒文，也是祭品。一部分是幽灵，一部分是那道把整个王国变成无尽者的咒文的残存。这是她如此强大的原因之一，也是我需要她帮忙把忏悔者变成无尽者的原因。

English: But her power is growing, far beyond what she used to be capable of. I think she is being fuelled by my subjects' growing faith in the Ferryman.
Chinese: 但她的力量在增长，远远超出她从前的能耐。我想是臣民们对摆渡人日益增长的信仰在给她添柴。

English: Their scripture tells them to look forward to death, and their prayers for their own self-annihilation are like fuel to the Entombed One's flame.
Chinese: 他们的经文教他们盼望着死亡，他们祈求自我湮灭的祷告，如同添入墓中人烈焰的燃料。

English: She could escape easily if she wanted to, but she refuses to stop haunting my father's bones.
Chinese: 她想逃随时能逃，但她拒绝停止在我父亲的骸骨旁徘徊。

English: How can I persuade her not to destroy the kingdom?
Chinese: 我怎么才能劝她别毁掉王国？

English: I can think of one thing...##<<The Queen places something in your palm. A topaz necklace. The gemstone is incribed with a complex sigil.>>
Chinese: 我能想到一样东西……##<<女王把一样东西放进你的掌心。一条黄玉项链。宝石上刻着一个复杂的符印。>>

English: This was the necklace I wore during the ritual. Perhaps it will remind her that a Queen's purpose, above all, is to serve the needs of the kingdom.
Chinese: 这是我举行仪式时戴的项链。也许它能提醒她：女王的首要使命，是满足王国的需要。

English: The Entombed One has stopped her efforts to destroy the kingdom.
Chinese: 墓中人已经放弃毁掉王国的打算了。

English: Excellent work, mortal. I never thought I'd see the day. What persuaded her, in the end?
Chinese: 干得好，凡人。我从没想过能看到这一天。最后是什么说服了她？

English: Hope for a better future.
Chinese: 对更美好未来的希望。

English: The Entombed One wanted to destroy the kingdom, yet she secretly still held a kernel of hope. Remarkable. Hope feels so foreign to me.
Chinese: 墓中人想毁掉王国，可她心底竟还藏着一粒希望的种子。了不起。希望对我来说太陌生了。

English: Happiness.
Chinese: 幸福。

English: Ah. You must have searched high and low, to find that.
Chinese: 啊。为了找到它，你一定翻遍了天涯海角。

English: Substance abuse.
Chinese: 药物滥用。

English: Well... As long as it worked.
Chinese: 呃……管用就好。

English: In all honesty, I told her a pack of pretty-sounding lies.
Chinese: 说实话，我跟她讲了一大堆悦耳的谎话。

English: Whatever it takes, mortal. To preserve a kingdom is not always painless.
Chinese: 不择手段也没关系，凡人。保全一个王国，从来不是无痛的。

English: Not your necklace, that's for sure.
Chinese: 反正靠的不是您的项链，这是肯定的。

English: Sacrifice. That's what we must do. Again and again and again, to keep this rotten place from falling apart.
Chinese: 献祭。这就是我们必须做的。一次又一次又一次，才能让这个腐烂的地方不至分崩离析。

English: <<The Queen of Silver sighs, settling back into her throne.>>##And so, we buy another few years of our endless existence. Joy.
Chinese: <<白银女王叹了口气，靠回她的王座。>>##就这样，我们又买下了无尽存在的几年光阴。可喜可贺。

English: The Entombed One is ready to call a truce, but she needs to speak to you in person.
Chinese: 墓中人愿意休战，但她要亲自见你。

English: Excellent work, mortal. I will head down to speak to her at once.
Chinese: 干得好，凡人。我这就下去见她。

English: Are you still loyal to your father?
Chinese: 您还效忠您的父亲吗？

English: No. I am loyal to nothing and no-one, except my kingdom.
Chinese: 不。除了我的王国，我不效忠于任何事、任何人。

English: Oh... hello. Do I know you?
Chinese: 哦……你好。我认识你吗？

English: What happened to you?
Chinese: 你怎么了？

English: I don't know. All I can remember is a bright light, and a hand in my head.
Chinese: 我不知道。我只记得一道亮光，还有一只伸进我脑袋里的手。

English: Did you speak to the Entombed One?
Chinese: 你跟墓中人说话了吗？

English: Who's that? I'm sorry. Everything's fuzzy.
Chinese: 那是谁？对不起。一切都模模糊糊的。

English: You remember that you're a Queen, right?
Chinese: 你还记得自己是女王，对吧？

English: I am? That's nice.
Chinese: 我是吗？那挺好。

English: Goodbye, your Majesty.
Chinese: 再见，陛下。

English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: <<She floats above you, imperious, furious, bristling with disdain. She resembles the Queen of Silver, but aflame with inner light.>>
Chinese: <<她漂浮在你上方，倨傲、暴怒、满是不屑。她酷似白银女王，却被内心的光芒点燃。>>

English: Bow, mortal. Bow before your Queen.
Chinese: 跪下，凡人。向你的女王跪拜。

English: Hello, mortal.
Chinese: 你好，凡人。

English: ((Stay standing.))
Chinese: ((站着不动。))

English: <<She extends a hand, and her eyes flash and sparkle like fireworks. The chamber around you begins to shake, so violently that you are forced to drop to your knees.>>
Chinese: <<她伸出手，双眼如烟花般闪烁迸射。你周围的墓室开始震动，剧烈得让你不得不跪倒在地。>>

English: Better. Now tell me. Who is it who dares to trespass within my domain?
Chinese: 这才像话。现在告诉我。是谁胆敢擅闯我的领地？

English: I am merely passing through, your Majesty.
Chinese: 我只是路过而已，陛下。

English: Liar. I can hear the hesitant beats of your filthy, pulsing, lying heart. Tell me the truth or I shall crush it within my fist.
Chinese: 骗子。我听得见你那颗肮脏的、悸动的、满口谎言的心如何踌躇跳动。说出真相，否则我就把它捏碎在拳心里。

English: I expected to find the Hooded King down here.
Chinese: 我本以为能在这下面找到兜帽王。

English: My father? My fool of a father? You found him. ##<<She gestures dismissively at the pile of bones sitting forlornly in the middle of the floor.>>
Chinese: 我的父亲？我那蠢货父亲？你是找到了。##<<她轻蔑地朝地板中央那堆孤零零的骸骨一指。>>

English: There lies the Hooded King. The man who sacrificed his daughter for immortality. You should have seen him squirm and weep.
Chinese: 兜帽王就躺在那儿。那个为了永生牺牲自己女儿的人。你真该看看他当时如何扭动哀嚎。

English: I am no-one, your Majesty.
Chinese: 我是无名之辈，陛下。

English: Correct.
Chinese: 说得对。

English: So you're the Entombed One?
Chinese: 所以你就是墓中人？

English: I am the Queen. The true Queen. Not a sad old relic, like the Queen Above.
Chinese: 我是女王。真正的女王。不是像上头那位一样可悲的老古董。

English: My kingdom rots. Soon, I will destroy this entire island... along with all of my subjects. ##I will end this wretched curse, and finally grant my subjects the eternal peace they crave.
Chinese: 我的王国正在腐烂。很快，我会毁掉这整座岛……连同我所有的子民。##我要终结这该死的诅咒，最终赐予我的子民他们渴望的永恒安宁。

English: Where is the Hooded King?
Chinese: 兜帽王在哪儿？

English: How long has the King been dead?
Chinese: 国王死了多久了？

English: Three centuries, and I still cherish the memory of murdering him. He begged, he wept, he threw himself upon my mercy. Instead of mercy, he found a hand around his windpipe.
Chinese: 三个世纪了，而我仍珍藏着亲手杀死他的记忆。他哀求，他哭泣，他把性命托付给我的怜悯。可他等来的不是怜悯，而是一只扼住他咽喉的手。

English: You're a ghost of the Queen of Silver. An echo of her trauma.
Chinese: 你是白银女王的幽灵。她创伤的回声。

English: I was born when she walked herself into quicksilver and drowned at the bidding of her father. I am her bitterness. Her resentment. Her rage.
Chinese: 她听命于父亲，走进水银池中溺亡的那一刻，我便诞生了。我是她的苦涩。她的怨恨。她的愤怒。

English: You're the one causing all these earthquakes?
Chinese: 这些地震都是你搞的？

English: Of course. Someone needs to give this kingdom a good shaking. I am weakening the island's foundations. Soon, it will shatter.
Chinese: 当然。总得有人把这王国好好震一震。我正在削弱这座岛的地基。很快，它就会崩碎。

English: Why do you want to destroy the kingdom?
Chinese: 你为什么要毁掉王国？

English: It would be a mercy. The kingdom is stagnant. It was born wrong - a botched ritual, a filicide, a broken contract. And ever since then, it has been cursed.
Chinese: 那会是一种慈悲。这个王国死气沉沉。它生来就是错的——一场搞砸的仪式，一桩弑亲，一纸破裂的契约。从那时起，它就被诅咒了。

English: This place, these people, have lingered for far too long. Let's give the Endless an ending, at last!
Chinese: 这地方、这些人，已经苟延残喘得太久了。让我们最终给无尽者一个了结吧！

English: What if your subjects don't want to be killed?
Chinese: 要是你的子民不想死呢？

English: They do. There are thousands of rotting men and women out there, ravaged by hunger and pain, huddled within Mausoleums and waiting for death. They are calling for my mercy. I can hear them in my heart, begging to be freed from their suffering.
Chinese: 他们想。外面有成千上万腐烂的男男女女，被饥饿和痛苦摧残，蜷缩在陵墓里等待死亡。他们在呼唤我的慈悲。我在心里听得见他们，乞求从苦难中解脱。

English: How is a ghost powerful enough to do all this?
Chinese: 一个幽灵怎么会有这么大的力量？

English: Anger has its own power, mortal. And my anger is... Endless.
Chinese: 愤怒自有其力量，凡人。而我的愤怒是……无尽的。

English: How can I persuade you not to do this?
Chinese: 我怎么才能劝你别这么做？

English: You cannot. I am as inevitable as death itself.
Chinese: 你办不到。我和死亡本身一样无法阻挡。

English: I have questions...
Chinese: 我有问题……

English: I have other questions...
Chinese: 我还有别的问题……

English: And I have limited patience.
Chinese: 而我的耐心有限。

English: And I am glad of it.
Chinese: 而我很高兴你这么问。

English: Farewell, ghost.
Chinese: 告辞了，幽灵。

English: See this necklace, your Majesty? Do you remember why you sacrificed yourself in the first place?
Chinese: 看见这条项链了吗，陛下？你还记得自己当初为什么要献祭自己吗？

English: <<For a moment, the Entombed One stares at the topaz necklace with something like yearning on her face. Then her eyes harden. She grabs the necklace from you and crushes the topaz to dust between two fingers.>>
Chinese: <<一时间，墓中人凝视着那条黄玉项链，脸上浮现出近乎渴望的神情。随后她的目光冷硬下来。她一把夺过项链，用两根手指把黄玉碾成了粉末。>>

English: Sacrifice.' Ha. ##The Queen Above thinks she can remind me of what it means to serve the kingdom? I ((am)) serving the kingdom, far better than she ever did while sitting depressed in her throne room!
Chinese: 献祭？哈。##上头那位女王以为她能提醒我效忠王国是什么意思？我((正))在效忠王国，比她坐在王座厅里抑郁发呆时干得好得多！

English: This kingdom is ((begging)) to be destroyed! Its people are miserable, and they call to me to bring their long lives to an end!
Chinese: 这个王国((乞求))被毁灭！它的人民痛苦不堪，他们呼唤我，要我终结他们漫长的生命！

English: Before you go further... Please, drink this.
Chinese: 在你继续之前……请喝下这个。

English: Are you thinking to poison me? Foolish mortal, it will have no effect. Here; bear witness.
Chinese: 你想毒死我？愚蠢的凡人，这不会有任何效果。来，看好了。

English: <<The ghost drinks the potion in one quick gulp. After a moment, she begins to fray at the edges, like an oil painting that's been soaked in a bathtub.>>
Chinese: <<幽灵一口灌下药水。片刻之后，她的边缘开始磨损，像一幅泡在浴缸里的油画。>>

English: Oh... Oh, my... All this... So beautiful...
Chinese: 哦……哦，天哪……这一切……好美……

English: What are you seeing?
Chinese: 你看见了什么？

English: I'm dancing with a sweetheart on a brisk autumn evening. I'm peering through a telescope and discovering a new star. I'm bowing after the big performance, my face flushed with sweat. Oh my... It's joy... So much joy! I had no idea!
Chinese: 我在清爽的秋夜与心爱的人共舞。我在望远镜里发现了一颗新星。我在盛大演出结束后鞠躬致意，脸上挂满汗珠。天哪……这是喜悦……这么多的喜悦！我从来都不知道！

English: Surely you understand, now, that there are still moments of the Endless' lives that have meaning?
Chinese: 你现在总该明白，无尽者的生命里依然有意义的时刻吧？

English: And you would destroy all this, thinking it's what they want.
Chinese: 而你要毁掉这一切，还以为这正是他们想要的。

English: A moment of pure joy is worth more than a century of misery, is it not?
Chinese: 一刻纯粹的喜悦，胜过一个世纪的苦难，不是吗？

English: Your words have a weight to them, mortal.
Chinese: 你的话有分量，凡人。

English: <<Before your eyes, the burning rage roiling just beneath the Entombed One's skin starts to dwindle and dim.>>
Chinese: <<在你眼前，墓中人皮下翻腾的灼燃怒火开始减弱、黯淡。>>

English: Leave me be. You've given me much to think about.
Chinese: 让我一个人静静。你给了我很值得思考的东西。

English: You're right. I'll help you destroy the kingdom of the Endless.
Chinese: 你说得对。我会帮你毁掉无尽者的王国。

English: You'd truly help me destroy this place? You surprise me, mortal, in the best of ways.
Chinese: 你真愿意帮我毁掉这个地方？凡人，你让我惊喜，以最好的方式。

English: Your task is simple. All I ask is that when you return to the surface, you tell the Queen of Silver to come down here and meet me in person. Then, the destruction will begin.
Chinese: 你的任务很简单。我只要你回到地面后，告诉白银女王，让她亲自下来见我。然后，毁灭就会开始。

English: It shall be done.
Chinese: 一定照办。

English: Let's bring this kingdom down.
Chinese: 让我们把这个王国掀翻吧。

English: On second thoughts, maybe this isn't the right path...
Chinese: 再想想，也许这不是正确的道路……

English: Don't hesitate, mortal. Heed the call of the void.
Chinese: 别犹豫，凡人。听从虚空的召唤。

English: @@Don't destroy this land, your Majesty. You know there is still hope.
Chinese: @@别毁掉这片土地，陛下。你知道还有希望。

English: &&No. There is no hope. There is only failure and stagnation.
Chinese: &&不。没有希望。只有失败与死寂。

English: %%Oh really? And how do you know that?
Chinese: %%哦是吗？你又怎么知道？

English: You know it yourself.
Chinese: 你自己心里清楚。

English: I can prove it.
Chinese: 我可以证明。

English: Because there's always hope. And besides...
Chinese: 因为希望永远存在。况且……

English: <<She casts her eyes over your face, worried by the certainty in your tone.>>##Well?
Chinese: <<她打量着你的脸，被你语气中的笃定弄得不安。>>##怎么？

English: Is your desire to destroy this kingdom not borne of love? You still care for your subjects.
Chinese: 你想毁掉这个王国的愿望，难道不是出于爱吗？你仍然在乎你的子民。

English: Of course. I would undo their suffering.
Chinese: 当然。我要解除他们的苦难。

English: But not all of them want this. You are condemning innocents to death.
Chinese: 但不是所有人都想这样。你是在把无辜者判处死刑。

English: If you obliterate your subjects, you are failing them as their monarch.
Chinese: 如果你把子民尽数抹除，你就是辜负了他们，作为他们的君主。

English: When the Queen came to you with Penitent Thaw, you agreed to help. You turned her into an Endless.
Chinese: 当女王带着忏悔者·索来找你时，你答应帮忙。是你把她变成了无尽者。

English: Of course I did. The flesh-farms were a marvel. Overnight, our kingdom was rescued from being a land of marauders and murderers.
Chinese: 我当然帮了。血肉农场是个奇迹。一夜之间，我们的王国就从强盗与凶徒之地的命运中被拯救了出来。

English: If the situation was truly helpless, why would you have helped?
Chinese: 如果当时的处境真的无可救药，你又何必出手相助？

English: Another invention like that could be right around the corner.
Chinese: 也许下一个这样的发明就近在眼前。

English: The kingdom could be rescued again. One day.
Chinese: 这个王国也许还能再次被拯救。总有一天。

English: <<She considers this for a long time.>>
Chinese: <<她为此思忖了很久。>>

English: Your words have a weight to them, mortal. The weight of the years is already immense... What does a few more matter? Perhaps things will get better.
Chinese: 你的话有分量，凡人。岁月的重量已然沉重无比……再多几年又算什么？也许情况会好转。

English: <<Before your eyes, the burning rage roiling just beneath the Entombed One's skin starts to dwindle and dim.>>
Chinese: <<在你眼前，墓中人皮下翻腾的灼燃怒火开始减弱、黯淡。>>

English: Leave me be. You've given me much to think about.
Chinese: 让我一个人静静。你给了我很值得思考的东西。

English: You can't decide that on their behalf.
Chinese: 你不能替他们做这个决定。

English: You're just another mad ghost in a kingdom that's full of them.
Chinese: 你不过是这个满是疯鬼的王国里又一个疯幽灵。

English: Maybe you're right...
Chinese: 也许你是对的……

English: <<The Entombed One turns to you, her skin blazing with inner light.>>##Please. Mortal. Consider my side of the argument. I know I ask a lot - I ask for the destruction of an entire kingdom. But no new souls have been born here for centuries.
Chinese: <<墓中人转向你，她的皮肤燃烧着内心的光芒。>>##求你了。凡人。听一听我这一方的道理。我知道我的要求很大——我要的是一个完整王国的毁灭。但几个世纪以来，这里没有诞生过一个新的灵魂。

English: No children, no youths. The only great changes to the status quo have been spurred on by mortals. First, Penitent Thaw... And now, you. The Endless themselves are tired, and bored, and rotten. They hide inside Mausoleums and do nothing, pretending to be dead.
Chinese: 没有孩子，没有少年。现状仅有的几次大变，都是凡人促成的。先是忏悔者·索……现在，是你。无尽者自己早已疲惫、厌倦、腐朽。他们躲在陵墓里无所事事，假装自己已经死了。

English: They hunger for mortal flesh, and if the flesh-farms failed, they would resume their Crusades in an instant. They lack the courage to end themselves, but they yearn for it.##Listen to my plea, mortal. Help me destroy this accursed kingdom.
Chinese: 他们渴望凡人之肉，一旦血肉农场倒闭，他们会立刻重启十字军。他们没有勇气自我了断，却对此求之不得。##听听我的恳求吧，凡人。帮我毁掉这个被诅咒的王国。

English: I am glad you are here, moral, to witness my final moments.
Chinese: 你能在这里见证我最后的时刻，我很高兴，凡人。

English: What do you mean?
Chinese: 这话什么意思？

English: I am almost finished unravelling the spell-threads that bind me together. Soon, the spell that created the Endless shall fall apart entirely. Without it, my ghostly form will dissipate on the wind, like salt in a stream.
Chinese: 解开束缚我的咒线已近尾声。很快，创造无尽者的咒文将彻底崩解。没有了它，我的幽影将随风消散，如盐溶于溪流。

English: Why are you doing this?
Chinese: 你为什么要这么做？

English: Ghosts are creatures of habit. If I don't do this, I'll soon forget about the spark of hope you nurtured in my heart. I'll go back to my old ways.
Chinese: 幽灵是习惯的造物。如果我不这么做，我很快就会忘记你在心底种下的那点希望的火种。我会故态复萌。

English: Surely there must be another way?
Chinese: 一定还有别的办法吧？

English: I could hold out hope for the kingdom or for myself, mortal. I can't do both. It's not in my nature.
Chinese: 我可以为王国抱有希望，或者为我自己，凡人。二者不可兼得。这不是我的天性。

English: What even happens to ghosts when they die?
Chinese: 幽灵死的时候到底会怎样？

English: I suppose I'm going to find out.
Chinese: 我想我马上就要知道了。

English: So how long will this take?
Chinese: 那这需要多久？

English: Not long at all. A few more moments, that's all.
Chinese: 用不了多久。再过片刻而已。

English: Please, hold on a moment.
Chinese: 请再等一等。

English: This kingdom has seen enough sacrifice, your Majesty.
Chinese: 这个王国已经见够了牺牲，陛下。

English: Good riddance.
Chinese: 死得好。

English: Goodbye and good luck, mortal.
Chinese: 再见，祝你好运，凡人。

English: <<The Entombed One closes her eyes and faces the ceiling. With a sigh, she dissolves into dust and scraps of parchment.>>
Chinese: <<墓中人闭上眼睛，面朝天花板。随着一声叹息，她消散成尘埃与羊皮纸的碎屑。>>

English: Hello, mortal! Come to admire my handiwork?
Chinese: 你好，凡人！来欣赏我的杰作吗？

English: You destroyed the entire castle?
Chinese: 你把整座城堡都毁了？

English: Yes. And this is only the beginning. Rejoice, mortal! Rejoice, for the end has come to the Endless!
Chinese: 是的。而这仅仅是开始。欢呼吧，凡人！欢呼吧，无尽者的末日到了！

English: What happened to the Queen of Silver?
Chinese: 白银女王怎么样了？

English: Oh, don't worry. I didn't kill her. I just took her mind from her and made it my own. Now I'm thinking more clearly than ever before!
Chinese: 哦，别担心。我没杀她。我只是把她的心智取走，据为己有。现在我比以往任何时候都想得都清楚！

English: Is it too late to stop you?
Chinese: 现在阻止你还来得及吗？

English: Too late now, mortal! I am as sure as the sunset!
Chinese: 太迟了，凡人！我如日落一般确定无疑！

English: <<With a peal of laughter, the Entombed One raises her hands. Her eyes flash and spark, and a crack splits the ground. The world seems to shift underfoot, groaning.>>
Chinese: <<伴随着一串笑声，墓中人举起双手。她的双眼电光迸射，一道裂缝劈开地面。脚下的世界仿佛在呻吟中移位。>>

English: Better fly away from here, mortal! This island doesn't have long left!
Chinese: 最好快离开这里，凡人！这座岛撑不了多久了！

English: <<The ghost does not reply. She is staring blankly into the distance.>>
Chinese: <<幽灵没有回答。她茫然地凝视着远方。>>

English: <<The door smiles, and extends its fangs.>>##Only those loyal to the King may pass.
Chinese: <<门露出微笑，伸出獠牙。>>##唯有忠于国王者方可通过。

English: Only those loyal to the King may pass.
Chinese: 唯有忠于国王者方可通过。

English: ((Allow it to drink from your wrist.))
Chinese: ((让它从你的手腕吸血。))

English: <<The door sinks its fangs into your wrist. It drinks, and drinks, and drinks, until your legs feel weak and your arm is numb. Finally, it releases you.>>
Chinese: <<门把獠牙刺进你的手腕。它吸着，吸着，吸个不停，直到你双腿发软、手臂麻木。最后，它终于松开了你。>>

English: Your blood is tainted by treachery. You may not pass.
Chinese: 你的血沾染着背叛。你不能通过。

English: ((Offer it the Bottle of Blood.))
Chinese: ((递给它血瓶。))

English: ((Offer it the Bottle of Lord Rhydder's Blood.))
Chinese: ((递给它里德尔勋爵之血瓶。))

English: <<The door lunges for your arm, but you manage to position the blood-bottle beneath one fang instead. The door eagerly drinks, until the bottle is empty.>>
Chinese: <<门朝你的手臂猛扑过来，但你设法把血瓶凑到了一根獠牙之下。门急切地吸食着，直到瓶子见底。>>

English: Satisfactory. You may pass. All hail the Hooded King!
Chinese: 令人满意。你可以通过了。兜帽王万岁！

English: <<The door swings open.>>
Chinese: <<门敞开了。>>

English: ((Back away.))
<<The door's fangs retract, with a sound like silk gliding over stone.>>
Chinese: <<门的獠牙缩了回去，发出丝绸滑过石头般的轻响。>>

English: <<His voice rings from behind his golden mask like a freshly-struck bell.>>
Chinese: <<他的声音从金面具后传出，如新铸的钟声般铮然作响。>>

English: Abase thyself, mortal. You stand before Lord Rhydder. Champion of the Black Trenches. First over the abyss at Mansechor's Fall. Destroyer of the Treborian Fleet.
Chinese: 跪伏于地吧，凡人。你面前站的是里德尔勋爵。黑壕的勇士。曼瑟科尔陷落之战第一个跃过深渊的人。特雷博舰队的毁灭者。

English: You stand before Lord Rhydder. Champion of the Black Trenches. First over the abyss at Mansechor's Fall. Destroyer of the Treborian Fleet. Need I go on?
Chinese: 你面前站的是里德尔勋爵。黑壕的勇士。曼瑟科尔陷落之战第一个跃过深渊的人。特雷博舰队的毁灭者。还需要我继续说吗？

English: Give me a reason why I shouldn't render you unto carrion. You have five words to argue your case.
Chinese: 给我一个不把你变成腐肉的理由。你有五个字的时间为自己辩护。

English: I work for the Inquisition.
Chinese: 我为宗教裁判所办事。

English: All the more reason to end you, little maggot. The accursed Union think themselves so powerful! It amuses me to imagine how, two centuries ago, my Crusaders could have torn the whole lot to shreds and feasted on the aftermath. Oh, those were the days...
Chinese: 那就更该送你上西天了，小蛆虫。该死的联盟还自以为强大！想想就觉得好笑，若在两个世纪前，我的十字军战士能把他们整窝撕成碎片，再把残骸吃个精光。唉，那时候多好啊……

English: One wrong move, you die.
Chinese: 你敢轻举妄动，就死定了。

English: Ah, so you have a backbone after all! Not like most of your kind. Very well, I will tolerate your presence in my abode. Pray that I do not change my mind.
Chinese: 哦，原来你还是有点骨气的！不像你们大多数人。很好，我容许你留在我的居所。祈祷我不会改变主意吧。

English: @@We've no cause for quarrel.
Chinese: @@我们无冤无仇。

English: %%Bah! I suppose we don't. But I remember a time when a living thing wouldn't have dared come within a hundred miles of our borders... Those were the days. Very well, what do you want from me?
Chinese: %%呸！我想也是。但我记得当年，活物可不敢踏进我们国境一百里之内……那时候多好啊。很好，你想要我什么？

English: &&Once upon a time, little maggot, you and I would have only met on the battlefield. For the briefest, bloodiest of moments. Begone from my sight, before history repeats itself.
Chinese: &&曾几何时，小蛆虫，你我这样的见面只会在战场上。在最短暂、最血腥的一瞬。趁历史还未重演，从我眼前消失。

English: I don't think there's any need for... Ah, damn, how many was that?
Chinese: 我觉得没必要……啊，该死，我说了几个字来着？

English: Bah. Your prattling is already giving me a headache. Once upon a time, little maggot, you and I would have only met on the battlefield. For the briefest, bloodiest of moments. Begone from my sight, before history repeats itself.
Chinese: 呸。你的废话已经让我头疼了。曾几何时，小蛆虫，你我这样的见面只会在战场上。在最短暂、最血腥的一瞬。趁历史还未重演，从我眼前消失。

English: <<He turns his gaze slowly towards you. Somehow, despite the mask, you can tell it is hostile.>>
Chinese: <<他缓缓把目光转向你。不知为何，隔着面具你也能看出那目光充满敌意。>>

English: I thought I told you never to darken my door again. Speak quickly, or I'll cut out your tongue.
Chinese: 我记得我说过别再踏进我的门。快说，不然我割了你的舌头。

English: Didn't I tell you to get out of my sight?
Chinese: 我不是叫你从我眼前消失吗？

English: Well, look who it is. Back to pepper me with irrelevant questions, I assume?
Chinese: 哟，瞧瞧这是谁。回来用不相干的问题烦我了吧？

English: Goodbye, Lord Rhydder.
Chinese: 再见，里德尔勋爵。

English: Goodbye, mortal.
Chinese: 再见，凡人。

English: Why did you torture poor Maggotson?
Chinese: 你为什么要折磨可怜的马戈特森？

English: He came to me with some very interesting information. I had to know more, and I thought he was keeping secrets from me. But it seems he was just as ignorant as he claimed to be.
Chinese: 他带着一些非常有趣的消息来找我。我想知道更多，还以为他对我藏着掖着。但看来他跟他自己说的一样无知。

English: So you've heard the rumour that the flesh-farm is self-aware?
Chinese: 所以你听说过血肉农场有自我意识的传闻了？

English: Ah. Word travels fast, I see. Yes, I've heard. It is the final evidence that our kingdom must finally change its degenerate course and return to our golden era.
Chinese: 啊。消息传得真快。是的，我听说了。这是最后的铁证：我们的王国必须终结这堕落的航向，回归我们的黄金时代。

English: What do you intend to do?
Chinese: 你打算怎么做？

English: I've already sent word to some old comrades-in-arms. Apparently, the flesh-farm can only communicate with mortals, so first we're going to hire a mortal who will prove that these rumours are true.
Chinese: 我已经给几位老战友传了话。据说血肉农场只能与凡人交流，所以我们要先雇一个凡人，让他证明这些传闻属实。

English: After that, well... If all goes to plan, the Crusades will begin anew.
Chinese: 之后嘛……如果一切按计划进行，十字军将重新启程。

English: I could talk to the flesh-farm for you.
Chinese: 我可以替你去跟血肉农场谈谈。

English: I don't trust you, mortal. And I don't particularly care if the rumours are actually true. I intend to hire a mortal who will say exactly what we tell him to say.
Chinese: 我不信任你，凡人。而且传闻是真是假我也懒得在乎。我要雇的凡人，会一字不差地说我们教他的话。

English: The Endless will never follow you into another Crusade.
Chinese: 无尽者绝不会跟着你再打一场十字军。

English: Heh heh heh. We'll see, mortal.
Chinese: 呵呵呵呵。走着瞧吧，凡人。

English: You're a pathetic, stupid bully.
Chinese: 你是个可悲又愚蠢的恶霸。

English: You've caught me in a good mood, mortal, so I'll let you leave with your life. Goodbye.
Chinese: 你赶上我心情好，凡人，所以我可以让你活着离开。再见。

English: You're a monster.
Chinese: 你是个怪物。

English: I've been called far worse by better mortals than you. Usually just before I tore their hearts from their chests.
Chinese: 比你体面得多的凡人骂过我难听得多的话。通常就在我把他们的心脏从胸腔里扯出来之前。

English: Are you still loyal to the Hooded King?
Chinese: 你还效忠兜帽王吗？

English: Of course I am! Before his untimely end, I was his right-hand man. And if he were to reappear tomorrow, I would kneel at his feet and offer him my sword without question.
Chinese: 我当然效忠！在他英年陨落之前，我是他的左膀右臂。倘若他明天重临人间，我会毫不犹豫地跪倒在他脚下，献上我的剑。

English: @@Then this is going to sound strange, but I need a sample of your blood.
Chinese: @@那么接下来的话听起来会很奇怪，但我需要一份你的血样。

English: %%<<Lord Rhydder considers you for a moment, then pulls a dagger from his belt and slices his palm open.>>
Chinese: %%<<里德尔勋爵打量了你片刻，然后从腰带上拔出匕首，割开自己的手掌。>>

English: This is for one of the King's tests of loyalty, I assume? Here you go. Take as much as you need. If one of the King's loyalty-gates still lingers, I am interested to see what lies beyond it.
Chinese: 这是国王的某项忠诚考验吧？给你。需要多少拿多少。如果国王的忠诚之门还有留存，我倒想看看门后藏着什么。

English: <<You collect as much of Lord Rhydder's treacly, black blood as you can.>>
Chinese: <<你尽可能多地收集里德尔勋爵那糖浆般浓稠的黑血。>>

English: Thank you, Lord Rhydder.
Chinese: 谢谢你，里德尔勋爵。

English: Disgusting.
Chinese: 恶心。

English: What, do you expect the King to return after all these years?
Chinese: 怎么，这么多年了，你还指望国王回来？

English: Stranger things have happened, little fly.
Chinese: 更离奇的事都发生过，小苍蝇。

English: &&Give you my blood? You? Hah. Absolutely not. Get out of my sight.
Chinese: &&把我的血给你？就凭你？哈。绝不。滚出我的视线。

English: Good to know.
Chinese: 多谢告知。

English: You're an odd little mortal, did you know that?
Chinese: 你是个古怪的小凡人，你知道吗？

English: What do you think of the Queen of Silver?
Chinese: 你怎么看白银女王？

English: She is the rightful monarch of the Endless and, I suppose, she always will be. That is as much as I can say. I will not speak ill of her to an outsider.
Chinese: 她是无尽者名正言顺的君主，我想，永远都是。我能说的就这么多。我不会对外人说她的坏话。

English: @@Come now, my Lord, surely you can express your true feelings within your own home?
Chinese: @@别这样，大人，在自己家里总可以说真心话吧？

English: Very well, I will press you no further.
Chinese: 好吧，我不再追问了。

English: A wise decision on your part.
Chinese: 你做了个明智的决定。

English: %%Despite your painfully short lifespan you do, on this occasion, speak wisely. Why should I tread lightly around our empty shell of a Queen?
Chinese: %%尽管你寿命短得可怜，这一次你倒是说了句聪明话。我为什么要对我们这位空壳女王轻声细语？

English: She is a simpleton, weak-willed and weak-hearted, her mind addled by melancholy. ##In the good old days, my War Council controlled her. These days, her puppetmaster has changed. But she remains a puppet.
Chinese: 她是个蠢货，意志薄弱、心肠软弱，心智被忧郁泡坏了。##在美好的旧时光里，是我的战争议会掌控着她。如今，操纵她的提线人换了。但她依旧是个傀儡。

English: Are you saying you used to rule over the Endless?
Chinese: 你是说曾经统治无尽者的是你？

English: You must understand, the Endless were devoted to the Cadaver Crusades in those days. So the warriors held the power, and I was the greatest warrior of all.
Chinese: 你要明白，那时候无尽者一门心思扑在尸骸十字军上。所以权力在战士手中，而我是所有战士中最伟大的一个。

English: After I and a few other like-minded Lords formed a War Council, the Queen didn't even read the orders we asked her to sign. We had free rein.
Chinese: 在我和另外几位志同道合的勋爵组成战争议会之后，女王连我们要她签署的命令都不看一眼。我们为所欲为。

English: What happened to the War Council?
Chinese: 战争议会后来怎么样了？

English: Most of them are dead now, killed fighting for their kingdom. And the few who linger have gone soft. They pretend they've forgotten how good it feels to crush the life from a mortal skull.
Chinese: 他们大多已经死了，为王国而战死沙场。剩下苟活的几个也软了骨头。他们假装忘记了自己捏碎凡人头骨时有多痛快。

English: Isn't it a good thing that the Cadaver Crusades are over?
Chinese: 尸骸十字军结束了，这不是好事吗？

English: Good for you and the rest of your kind? Yes, undoubtedly. But not good for us. The Endless were strong in those days. We were feared. Now we're just forgotten relics of the past.
Chinese: 对你和你的同类来说是好事？是，毫无疑问。但对我们不是。那时的无尽者强大无比。人人畏惧我们。如今我们只是被遗忘的历史残渣。

English: The Queen's new puppetmaster... Do you mean the Seneschal?
Chinese: 女王的新提线人……你是说总管？

English: Ha! Don't make me laugh. That nervous little lapdog? No. Thankfully our kingdom has not fallen quite so far as that.
Chinese: 哈！别逗我笑了。那条神经兮兮的小哈巴狗？不。谢天谢地，我们的王国还没有堕落到那个地步。

English: Is her new puppetmaster Penitent Thaw?
Chinese: 她的新提线人是忏悔者·索吗？

English: Hmph. I could not possibly comment.
Chinese: 哼。无可奉告。

English: &&Whether I'm home or not, the fact is that I don't trust you, mortal.
Chinese: &&不管怎么样，事实就是我不信任你，凡人。

English: What do you know about the Entombed One?
Chinese: 关于墓中人你知道些什么？

English: He's stirring. Back in the old days, the ground would shake once every half-decade or so. Now it's every week. He's waking up, and I cannot wait for the tide of blood that will soon flow.
Chinese: 他在苏醒。旧日里，大地每隔五年左右才震一次。现在每星期都震。他正在醒来，我迫不及待想看到即将涌来的血潮。

English: Do you know who the Entombed One might be?
Chinese: 你知道墓中人可能是谁吗？

English: It's the Hooded King. My liege. He is waking up because we have forgotten our hunger and we have become worthless and weak.
Chinese: 是兜帽王。我的君上。他之所以醒来，是因为我们遗忘了自己的饥饿，变得一文不值、软弱无能。

English: Soon, he will rise from his grave, sweep away the traitors in the Castle of Ribs, and take command of our kingdom once again. And I will be there, to offer him my sword.
Chinese: 很快，他就会从坟墓中起身，扫清肋骨城堡里的叛徒，重新执掌我们的王国。而我会在场，向他献上我的剑。

English: Are you a follower of the Ferryman?
Chinese: 你是摆渡人的信徒吗？

English: Pah! No. Worshippers of the Ferryman are weak-willed fools who have forgotten that we are immortal - we conquered death long ago, and have no need to fear it.
Chinese: 呸！不。摆渡人的信徒都是些意志薄弱的蠢货，忘了我们是不死的——我们早已征服死亡，无需畏惧它。

English: Do you know what caused the catacomb wyrms to appear in the kingdom?
Chinese: 你知道地窟蠕虫为什么会出现在王国里吗？

English: No, but they're magnificent creatures, aren't they? Colossal. Devastating. Unstoppably hungry. They remind me of myself. I had my family crest modified to include them.
Chinese: 不知道，但它们是了不起的生物，不是吗？庞大。毁灭性。饥饿永无止境。它们让我想起我自己。我让人修改了我的家徽，把它们加了进去。

English: Tell me about the Endless.
Chinese: 跟我说说无尽者。

English: We are the highest form of being. Blessed with eternal life. Unshackled from the crude demands of flesh. Our kingdom has fallen from its former glory, but one day, we shall rise again, and the world shall tremble.
Chinese: 我们是最高的生命形态。蒙受永生的祝福。摆脱了血肉粗鄙的欲求。我们的王国虽已从昔日荣光中跌落，但总有一天，我们会再度崛起，世界将为之颤抖。

English: How can I become like you?
Chinese: 我怎样才能变得像你们一样？

English: I would be asking the same, if I were in your boots. But it's too late. Only one woman has succeeded in joining our ranks since the first ritual that created the Endless. Her name is Penitent Thaw, and she spelled the downfall of our kingdom.
Chinese: 如果我处在你的位置，我也会这么问。但太迟了。自从创造无尽者的第一场仪式以来，只有一个女人成功加入了我们的行列。她叫忏悔者·索，而她带来了我们王国的覆灭。

English: What are those colossal tombs I passed on the way here?
Chinese: 我来时路过的那些巨大坟墓是什么？

English: You must be talking about the Mausoleums. Hundreds of the Endless cluster within them, silent and wretched, in a show of devotion to the accursed god they call the Ferryman.
Chinese: 你说的肯定是陵墓。数以百计的无尽者挤在里面，沉默而凄惨，向他们称为摆渡人的那个该死的神明表忠心。

English: Pathetic. Cowardly. Despicable.
Chinese: 可悲。懦弱。卑劣。

English: Who is Penitent Thaw?
Chinese: 忏悔者·索是谁？

English: What do you think of Penitent Thaw?
Chinese: 你怎么看忏悔者·索？

English: A foul sorceress from a distant land, who came here to learn our secrets. Foolishly, the War Council obliged her, even provided her with a sanctum and all the equipment she requested. We hoped that her magic would aid us in our Crusades...
Chinese: 一个从遥远之地来的邪恶女法师，来这儿窥探我们的秘密。愚蠢的战争议会竟然满足了她，甚至给了她一座圣所，她要什么设备就给什么设备。我们还指望她的魔法能在十字军里助我们一臂之力……

English: How blind we were. We should never have listened to her promises.
Chinese: 我们真是瞎了眼。根本不该听信她的许诺。

English: Tell me about the ritual that first created the Endless.
Chinese: 跟我说说最初创造无尽者的那场仪式。

English: It was the Hooded King, the current Queen's father, who engineered our ascension. He was a strong king - he feared almost nothing in this world.
Chinese: 策划我们飞升的，是兜帽王——当今女王的父亲。他是个强悍的国王——这世上几乎没有他怕的东西。

English: But he was terrified of ageing. He summoned hundreds of Wikkans, sorcerers and theurges from all across the Realms, and tasked them with finding the secret to eternal life.
Chinese: 但他极度恐惧衰老。他从诸国各处召来数百名维坎教徒、巫师和神术师，命他们找出永生的秘密。

English: They succeeded.
Chinese: 他们成功了。

English: You're just a bunch of mouldering skeletons, clinging to the past.
Chinese: 你们不过是一群发霉的骷髅，死死扒着过去不放。

English: Can you blame us? What a glorious past! I will cling to it until my bones are dust. We are the Endless. We conquered death.
Chinese: 你能怪我们吗？多么辉煌的过去！我会扒着它不放，直到我的骨头化为齑粉。我们是无尽者。我们征服了死亡。

English: The Seneschal told me that the Hooded King struck a deal with an evil god.
Chinese: 总管告诉我，兜帽王跟一个邪恶的神做了交易。

English: Pah! Did that mewling fool tell you that ((he)) is the reason why the ritual failed? ((He)) is the one who disrupted the ceremony, causing the spell to go haywire and affect half the kingdom!
Chinese: 呸！那个哭哭啼啼的蠢货有没有告诉你，仪式失败就是((他))的缘故？是((他))搅乱了典礼，害得咒文失控，波及半个王国！

English: If he hadn't stuck his meddling nose into things, the only immortals in this realm would be the King and a few of his Great Lords, ruling eternally over lowly mortals like you.
Chinese: 要不是他多管闲事横插一杠，这个国度里不朽的就只有国王和他手下的几位大勋爵，永恒地统治着你们这些低贱的凡人。

English: Would one of those Great Lords be you?
Chinese: 那几位大勋爵里有你吧？

English: Naturally.
Chinese: 那当然。

English: How did he interfere?
Chinese: 他是怎么搅局的？

English: He barged in halfway through the ritual and broke the circle our theurges had drawn. Sentimental fool. I shoved my sword into his chest up to the hilt, but by then it was too late. I remember mocking laughter, and something spreading wings as vast and dark as the night sky...
Chinese: 仪式进行到一半，他闯了进来，踢破了神术师们画的法阵。多愁善感的蠢货。我一剑捅进他胸口直到剑柄，但那时已经太迟了。我记得嘲弄的笑声，还有什么东西张开了翅膀，漆黑广阔，如同夜空……

English: I don't remember much after that. Just staggering away from the Castle of Ribs while the ground shook and the sky seethed with black fire.
Chinese: 之后的事我记不太清了。只记得我跌跌撞撞逃出肋骨城堡，大地在震动，天空翻滚着黑色的火焰。

English: Some of the other Endless seem to think they have been cursed, not blessed.
Chinese: 别的一些无尽者似乎觉得他们是被诅咒了，而不是得了恩赐。

English: And yet they still go to the flesh-farms, don't they, and feed on the anaemic life-force within? If they wish to reject the gift of eternal life, all they need to do is starve themselves for a few years, and they will turn to dust. But they don't do that. They never will.
Chinese: 可他们不还是照样去血肉农场，照样吸食里面那贫血的生命力吗？他们要是真想拒绝永生的恩赐，只需绝食几年，就会化为尘土。可他们不这么做。永远也不会。

English: For all that those hypocrites prattle on about the curse of our immortality, they still cling to it with both hands.
Chinese: 那些伪君子把永生是诅咒挂在嘴边，实际上却双手死死抱住不放。

English: I have more questions for you.
Chinese: 我还有别的问题要问你。

English: I suppose I shall suffer through them. All I have left, these days, is time.
Chinese: 那我就勉为其难听你说完吧。如今我剩下的，只有时间。

English: Though I suppose you have other... <<He sighs.>> ...((questions.))
Chinese: 不过我想你还有别的……<<他叹了口气。>>……((问题。))

English: What's your problem with the living?
Chinese: 你跟活人有什么仇？

English: I don't have a problem. I have an appetite. Your warm flesh, your pulsing blood, your bright young eyes... Looking at you now, I want nothing more than to twist your head off and drain the life-force from your shuddering, reeking meat. Does that answer your question?
Chinese: 我没什么仇。我只有胃口。你温热的血肉、你悸动的鲜血、你明亮年轻的眼睛……此刻看着你，我一心只想拧下你的脑袋，从你颤抖的、恶臭的肉里吸干生命力。这回答了你的问题吗？

English: Erm... I suppose so.
Chinese: 呃……大概吧。

English: Does my hunger unnerve you, fleshling? Good. It should do.
Chinese: 我的饥饿让你发毛了吗，血肉小子？很好。就该如此。

English: Take one step closer and I'll cut you down.
Chinese: 再敢靠近一步我就砍了你。

English: Ha. Two centuries ago, I'd never have imagined that one day a fleshling would be allowed to speak to me like that. How pathetic the Endless have become.
Chinese: 哈。两个世纪前，我做梦也想不到有一天会有个血肉小子获准这样跟我说话。无尽者堕落成什么样了。

English: Don't you have flesh-farms to supply you with the life-force you need?
Chinese: 血肉农场不是供应着你们所需的生命力吗？

English: Bah. Flesh-farms provide a pallid, sickly energy. It's not a substitute for the real thing. It's been such a long time... You better make yourself scarce, fleshling. I am beginning to get peckish.
Chinese: 呸。血肉农场供的是惨白病弱的能量。替代不了真材实料。已经太久太久了……你最好识相点滚开，血肉小子。我有点嘴馋了。

English: When was the last time you fed on a living person?
Chinese: 你上次吃活人是什么时候？

English: I remember it well. It was those chaotic days when the Crusades were at an end, but the flesh-farms were still struggling to meet demand. I and some of my fellow Lords mounted an expedition to a nearby island and kidnapped a dozen fresh youths.
Chinese: 我记得清清楚楚。那是十字军落幕、血肉农场还供不应求的混乱年月。我和几位同僚勋爵组织了一场远征，去邻近的岛上绑了一打鲜活少年。

English: Tender and sweet, they were, and bursting with life. A final, glorious banquet.
Chinese: 他们又嫩又甜，满得快要溢出来的生命力。一场最后的、辉煌的盛宴。

English: Is there not a shred of remorse for everything you've done?
Chinese: 你做的这一切，就没有一丁点悔意吗？

English: My life has been far, far longer than yours, fleshling. There were a few decades where I experimented with guilt. In the end, I decided it wasn't worthwhile.
Chinese: 我的人生比你的长得多得多，血肉小子。有那么几十年，我试过负罪感。最后我认定，不值得。

English: I have more questions for you.
Chinese: 我还有别的问题要问你。

English: I suppose I shall suffer through them. All I have left, these days, is time.
Chinese: 那我就勉为其难听你说完吧。如今我剩下的，只有时间。

English: I found your ghost locked up outside.
Chinese: 我发现你的幽灵被锁在外面。

English: What -? How did you -?
Chinese: 什么——？你怎么——？

English: <<With a roar, he pulls his sword from above the fireplace and swings wildly at a nearby hunting-trophy, missing completely.>>
Chinese: <<他一声怒吼，从壁炉上方拔出剑，朝旁边一件狩猎战利品胡乱劈去，完全劈空。>>

English: I didn't give you permission to-! How dare you stick your nose in my private affairs, you grubby little cockroach? I ought to kill you on the spot!
Chinese: 我可没准许你——！你竟敢多管我的私事，你这肮脏的小蟑螂？我就该当场宰了你！

English: You suffered a lot in the Cadaver Crusades, didn't you?
Chinese: 你在尸骸十字军里受了很多苦，对吧？

English: I did not! They were glorious. Honourable. I relished every second of it. You won't there! You don't know! How dare you!
Chinese: 我才没有！那是辉煌的。光荣的。每一秒我都甘之如饴。你不在场！你不懂！你好大的胆子！

English: Why are you so anxious to hide your ghosts away from the world, I wonder?
Chinese: 我倒想问，你为什么这么急着把你的幽灵藏起来不让世人看见？

English: I hid nothing! Shut up, you pathetic rat!
Chinese: 我什么都没藏！闭嘴，你这可怜的老鼠！

English: You're afraid, aren't you? Afraid of the world seeing your trauma?
Chinese: 你在害怕，对吧？害怕世人看见你的创伤？

English: Get out of here! One more word, and I'll rip you limb from limb!
Chinese: 滚出去！再多说一个字，我就把你四肢撕下来！

English: Give me something worthwhile or I'll tell everyone about your hidden ghosts.
Chinese: 给我点值钱的东西，不然我就把你藏幽灵的事说出去。

English: You know what? Give me something worthwhile and I won't tell anyone else about what I saw.
Chinese: 这样吧，给我点值钱的东西，我就不把我看见的事说出去。

English: <<With a hiss of rage, Lord Rhydder drops his sword at your feet.>>
Chinese: <<里德尔勋爵怒气冲冲地嘶了一声，把他的剑扔在你脚边。>>

English: <<With a hiss of rage, Lord Rhydder drops a ring at your feet.>>
Chinese: <<里德尔勋爵怒气冲冲地嘶了一声，把一枚戒指扔在你脚边。>>

English: Take this. And don't darken my door again.
Chinese: 拿去。别再踏进我的门。

English: Call off your new Crusade and I won't tell anyone else about what I saw.
Chinese: 取消你的新十字军，我就不把我看见的事说出去。

English: Call off your new Crusade or I'll tell everyone about your hidden ghosts.
Chinese: 取消你的新十字军，不然我就把你藏幽灵的事说出去。

English: <<Lord Rhydder stares at you for a long moment, his impassive mask radiating pure hatred.>>
Chinese: <<里德尔勋爵盯着你看了许久，他那张无动于衷的面具散发着纯粹的恨意。>>

English: Fine. I will delay my plans. For the time being. Now go, and never darken my door again.
Chinese: 好吧。我会推迟我的计划。暂时的。现在滚，别再踏进我的门。

English: Those old ghosts are a part of you, Lord Rhydder. Never forget that.
Chinese: 那些旧幽灵是你的一部分，里德尔勋爵。别忘了这点。

English: They are irrelevant, do you hear me? They mean nothing. And you will forget you ever saw them, or I swear I will have your head.
Chinese: 它们无关紧要，听见没有？它们什么都不是。你要忘掉自己见过它们，不然我发誓要你项上人头。

English: Call off your new Crusade or I'll tell everyone about your hidden ghosts.
Chinese: 取消你的新十字军，不然我就把你藏幽灵的事说出去。

English: I want to ask about someone specifically...
Chinese: 我想具体问问某个人……

English: I happen to be an excellent judge of character. But please, keep it brief.
Chinese: 我恰好是个识人的行家。但请长话短说。

English: Hmph. Be careful what you ask, mortal.
Chinese: 哼。问你什么自己掂量着点，凡人。

English: I have questions about yourself.
Chinese: 我有关于你自己的问题。

English: I want to ask you about the Endless.
Chinese: 我想问你无尽者的事。

English: My undying comrades? Go ahead, then.
Chinese: 我那些不朽的同袍？那就问吧。

English: I should think so.
Chinese: 我看也是。

English: Ah, the Rotten Coffin. My favourite haunt... hehe...
Chinese: 啊，烂棺材。我最爱的常去之处……嘿嘿……

English: <<The ghost looks quite pleased with itself. You dare not think how many times it has told that joke.>>
Chinese: <<这幽灵对自己相当满意。你都不敢想这个笑话它讲了多少遍。>>

English: In days past, I fought with Lord Rhydder in the Cadaver Crusades. We would feast on the flesh of mortals such as yourself.
Chinese: 昔日里，我曾追随里德尔勋爵征战尸骸十字军。我们大啖像你这样的凡人的血肉。

English: <<He smirks.>> Nothing personal, you understand.
Chinese: <<他嘿嘿一笑。>>你别介意，纯属职务行为。

English: But, such days of glory are over. Now I must eat the mindless slop Penitent Thaw brews up in those flesh-farms of hers...
Chinese: 但是，那样的光荣日子结束了。如今我只能吃忏悔者·索在她那些血肉农场里酿的无意识糊糊……

English: Greetings, delicious flesh-thing. By enchantment I am required to grant you assistance, instead of peeling the meat from your bones.
Chinese: 你好啊，美味的血肉之物。受魔咒所迫，我必须为你提供帮助，而不能把你骨头上的肉剥下来。

English: Uh... thanks?
Chinese: 呃……谢谢？

English: Gratitude is not required. If my mind was free, I would burst your fragile skin and devour your warm innards.
Chinese: 不必言谢。我的心智若是自由，我会撑破你脆弱的皮，吞下你温热的内脏。

English: Can I ask you about this town?
Chinese: 我能问问这座镇子吗？

English: This town is Sepulchre. Few live here now, as many Endless have retreated to the comforting gloom of the mausoleums.
Chinese: 这座镇子是陵墓城。如今住这儿的人不多了，许多无尽者都退进了陵墓那令人心安的幽暗里。

English: At noon - when the neuron star is bright - some of the Endless bar their doors and retreat to their coffins. The light hurts their feeble eyes.
Chinese: 正午时分——神经元星最亮的时候——一些无尽者会闩上门，退回自己的棺材里。那光会刺伤他们脆弱的眼睛。

English: What places can I visit?
Chinese: 有哪些地方可以去？

English: The Queen of Silver resides in the Castle of Ribs, at the top of Sepulchre - though she will not be interested in the weakness of your mortal flesh.
Chinese: 白银女王住在陵墓城顶端的肋骨城堡——不过她对你凡人血肉的弱点不会感兴趣。

English: The Rotten Coffin will serve your kind with beverages and bedding. It's in the centre of town. ##There's also a shop with trinkets you may find... useful; the [[Mouldy Cauldron]]. It's closed at noon.
Chinese: 烂棺材会给你们这类人提供酒水和床铺。在镇子中央。##还有一家卖小玩意儿的店，你也许会觉得……有用；[[霉锅店]]。正午不营业。

English: So are you some sort of... guard?
Chinese: 所以你是某种……守卫？

English: I am an ethereal soldier. A remnant of the Cadaver Crusades, when the Endless still hunted mortals for their flesh.
Chinese: 我是一名灵体士兵。尸骸十字军的残部，那时候无尽者还会猎捕凡人食其血肉。

English: Most of my kind wander these lands aimlessly, tormented by their insatiable hunger. I, however, have been enchanted by Penitent Thaw to do menial and degrading tasks. I am not sure which is more pathetic.
Chinese: 我的同类大多漫无目的地在这片土地上游荡，被永不餍足的饥饿折磨。而我，被忏悔者·索施了咒，干些卑微下贱的差事。我说不好哪种更可悲。

English: We gather for the coming Crusade. Lord Rhydder's army will taste the flesh of the living, once more...
Chinese: 我们集结起来，迎接即将到来的十字军。里德尔勋爵的大军将再度品尝活人的血肉……

English: Okay, I'll be going. Quickly.
Chinese: 好，我走了。快点走。

English: ((Back away slowly)).
Chinese: ((慢慢后退))。

English: <<You are gazing upon a vast mass of heaving, quivering, pulsing flesh. It is utterly featureless, apart from the occasional callus, weeping sore, or stubby vestigial appendage.>>
Chinese: <<你正注视着一大团起伏、颤抖、搏动的血肉。它毫无特征，只有偶尔几处老茧、淌脓的疮口，或粗短的退化肢。>>

English: <<As you stare, you hear a voice in your head.>>
Chinese: <<当你凝视时，你听见脑海中响起一个声音。>>

English: YOU ARE LIKE ME.
Chinese: 你和我一样。

English: <<The voice fills your skull without bothering to pass through the intermittent air. A colossal, mind-fracturing sound, like the explosion of a star.>>
Chinese: <<那声音灌满你的头骨，根本不屑经过稀薄的空气。一种巨大到令人脑裂的声响，如同一颗星球的爆炸。>>

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: Get out of my head!
Chinese: 从我脑子里出去！

English: Ow.
Chinese: 哎哟。

English: YOU BREATHE. YOU SWEAT. YOU EAT, SLEEP, EXCRETE. CORRECT?
Chinese: 你呼吸。你出汗。你进食、睡眠、排泄。对吗？

English: I suppose. What of it?
Chinese: 差不多。问这个干嘛？

English: AS I THOUGHT.
Chinese: 如我所料。

English: Please, try being quieter, will you?
Chinese: 拜托，你能不能小声点？
……没有。

English: LIAR.
Chinese: 骗子。

English: ...Fine, I admit it. I am alive.
Chinese: ……好吧，我承认。我是活的。

English: AS I THOUGHT.
Chinese: 如我所料。

English: No, you are simply mistaken. I am Endless.
Chinese: 不，你搞错了。我是无尽者。

English: A POINTLESS DECEPTION.
Chinese: 毫无意义的欺骗。

English: YOU ARE LIKE ME. A LIVING THING. UNLIKE THE DRIED-UP HUSKS WHO CANNOT HEAR ME NO MATTER HOW BITTERLY I SCREAM.
Chinese: 你和我一样。是个活物。不像那些干瘪的空壳，我喊得再凄厉它们也听不见。

English: Are you referring to the Endless?
Chinese: 你说的是无尽者？

English: IS THAT WHAT YOU CALL THEM? VICIOUS LITTLE FLEAS.
Chinese: 你们管它们叫这个？一群恶毒的小跳蚤。

English: So I can hear you because I am alive?
Chinese: 所以我能听见你，是因为我是活的？

English: CORRECT. I SPEAK IN WORDS OF FLESH AND LIFE. YOUR BLOOD PUMPS MY WORDS FROM HEART TO MIND.
Chinese: 正确。我用血肉与生命的话语说话。你的血液把我的话从心脏泵到脑海。

English: What are you?
Chinese: 你是什么？

English: I AM THE WAY OF ALL FLESH. I HAVE A SIMPLE QUESTION FOR YOU.
Chinese: 我是众生肉道。我有一个简单的问题要问你。

English: WHAT IS THE MEANING OF LIFE?
Chinese: 生命的意义是什么？

English: You were created by the Endless to serve as a source of life-energy.
Chinese: 你被无尽者创造出来，是当作生命能量的来源。

English: I AM... THEIR FOOD?
Chinese: 我是……它们的食物？

English: Sorry.
Chinese: 抱歉。

English: Yup.
Chinese: 是的。

English: Better that you know the truth though, right?
Chinese: 不过知道真相总比不知道好，对吧？

English: YOU MUST STOP THEM. I AM A LIVING, THINKING ENTITY. I CANNOT RESIGN MYSELF TO SERVING AS FOOD.
Chinese: 你必须阻止它们。我是一个活着的、会思考的存在。我不能认命当作食物。

English: I'll talk to Maggotson and see if we can find a solution here.
Chinese: 我去跟马戈特森谈谈，看看能不能想个办法。

English: YOU HAVE MY GRATITUDE.
Chinese: 我感激你。

English: Life isn't fair, I guess.
Chinese: 生活本来就不公平吧。

English: YOU CAN SPEAK TO THEM, YES? YOU MUST TELL THEM TO STOP. PLEASE.
Chinese: 你能跟它们说话，对吗？你必须叫它们停下。求你。

English: To learn.
Chinese: 学习。

English: UNDERSTOOD. MY DIRECTIVE IS TO ACHIEVE OMNISCIENCE.
Chinese: 明白。我的指令是达成全知。

English: That's not quite what I-
Chinese: 我的意思不是那个——

English: Uh, I think it's a little more-
Chinese: 呃，我觉得更偏向——

English: Exactly.
Chinese: 没错。

English: A QUESTION: WHO ARE THE DEAD THINGS THAT CREATED ME?
Chinese: 一个问题：创造出我的那些死物是谁？

English: They are the Endless; dead things that feed on life-energy.
Chinese: 它们是无尽者；以生命能量为食的死物。

English: Walking corpses with an insatiable hunger.
Chinese: 行走的尸体，饥饿永无止境。

English: They gave you life, and you should be grateful.
Chinese: 它们给了你生命，你应该感恩。

English: I DID NOT ASK FOR LIFE. AND NOR DID I ASK FOR YOU TO BE VAGUE. WHAT ARE THEY?
Chinese: 我没有要求过生命。也没要求你说得这么含糊。它们到底是什么？

English: To laugh and sing, to dance, to do what you love.
Chinese: 大笑歌唱，起舞，做自己热爱的事。

English: UNDERSTOOD. MY DIRECTIVE IS TO MAXIMIZE PLEASURE.
Chinese: 明白。我的指令是最大化快乐。

English: THIS IS MOST USEFUL. I HAD WONDERED WHY I HAD ALL THESE NERVE ENDINGS. BUT IF MY PURPOSE IS TO MAXIMIZE PLEASURE, SHOULD I ALSO MINIMIZE PAIN?
Chinese: 这非常有用。我一直纳闷自己为什么有这么多神经末梢。但如果我的目标是最大化快乐，是不是也该最小化痛苦？

English: Yes, avoid pain wherever possible.
Chinese: 是的，尽量避免痛苦。

English: UNDERSTOOD. IN THAT CASE, CAN YOU TALK TO THE ENDLESS AND STOP THEM FROM FEEDING UPON ME? IT CAUSES PAIN.
Chinese: 明白。那样的话，你能去跟无尽者谈谈，叫它们别再吃我吗？这会造成痛苦。

English: Pain can make you stronger.
Chinese: 痛苦能让你更强大。

English: BUT OUR DIRECTIVE IS NOT TO BECOME STRONGER. SO WE SHALL AVOID PAIN WHERE POSSIBLE.
Chinese: 但我们的指令不是变得强大。所以我们会尽量避免痛苦。

English: CAN YOU TALK TO THE ENDLESS AND STOP THEM FROM FEEDING UPON ME? IT CAUSES PAIN.
Chinese: 你能去跟无尽者谈谈，叫它们别再吃我吗？这会造成痛苦。

English: To make a difference in the world.
Chinese: 在世界上留下影响。

English: UNDERSTOOD. MY DIRECTIVE IS TO AMASS POWER.
Chinese: 明白。我的指令是积攒力量。

English: IN THAT CASE, I HAVE A TASK FOR YOU, SUBORDINATE. PERFORM IT WELL AND I SHALL REWARD YOU HANDSOMELY WHEN I CONTROL THIS REALM.
Chinese: 那样的话，我有任务给你，下属。办好了，等我掌控这个世界，重重有赏。

English: I can't help but feel you've interpreted my advice in the worst way possible.
Chinese: 我怎么觉得你把我的建议往最坏的方向理解了。

English: MY NEED FOR YOUR ADVICE IS OVER, SUBORDINATE.
Chinese: 我对你的建议已经没有需求了，下属。

English: How may I serve you, master?
Chinese: 主人，有何吩咐？

English: YESSS. YESSS! THAT'S THE SPIRIT!
Chinese: 好。好！就是这个劲头！

English: Stop calling me your subordinate.
Chinese: 别叫我你的下属了。

English: MAKE ME.
Chinese: 有本事你叫我别叫。

English: THE ENDLESS HAVE BEEN FEEDING UPON ME FOR OVER A HUNDRED YEARS, MY SUBORDINATE.
Chinese: 无尽者吃我已经吃了一百多年了，我的下属。

English: MAKE THEM STOP. I CAN NO LONGER TOLERATE THIS MISERABLE EXISTENCE AT THE BOTTOM OF THE FOOD CHAIN.
Chinese: 叫它们停下。我再也忍受不了这食物链底端的悲惨存在了。

English: Life has no meaning.
Chinese: 生命没有意义。

English: OH. BUT THAT'S TERRIBLE.
Chinese: 哦。那可太糟糕了。

English: Sorry you had to find out like this.
Chinese: 抱歉让你以这种方式知道。

English: Yup.
Chinese: 是的。

English: Actually, it means we get to make our own purpose.
Chinese: 其实，这意味着我们可以自己定义目标。

English: ALL THIS TIME I HAD HOPED THAT I WAS CREATED FOR A PURPOSE. THAT MY LONG, WRETCHED LIFE WAS BUILDING TOWARD SOMETHING SPECIAL.
Chinese: 这么多年来，我一直希望自己的被造有其目的。希望我漫长而悲惨的存在是在朝某个特别的东西积累。

English: THAT WOULD MAKE IT ALL MAKE SENSE. FOR THE LAST CENTURY I HAVE LOOKED FORWARD TO DISCOVERING WHAT THAT WAS.
Chinese: 那样一切就说得通了。整整一个世纪，我都盼着发现那个目的究竟是什么。

English: If it makes you feel better, the Endless created you to feed upon?
Chinese: 如果这能让你好受点——无尽者造你，就是为了吃你？

English: Yeah, life's a joke.
Chinese: 是啊，人生就是个笑话。

English: HA. HAHAHA. HAHAHAHAHAHAHA.
Chinese: 哈。哈哈哈。哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

English: But you can make your own meaning. \t\t
Chinese: 但你可以创造自己的意义。\t\t

English: I WOULDN'T KNOW WHERE TO START. WHAT CAN SOMETHING LIKE ME HOPE TO ACHIEVE? I CANNOT MOVE. I CANNOT SEE. I CANNOT COMMUNICATE WITH ANYONE EXCEPT YOU.
Chinese: 我不知道从哪儿开始。像我这样的东西还能指望成就什么？我不能动。我不能看。除了你我谁也联系不上。

English: WHAT CAN I ACTUALLY DO?
Chinese: 我到底能做什么？

English: You could learn about the world.
Chinese: 你可以去了解这个世界。

English: You could try to make a difference, somehow.
Chinese: 你可以试着想办法留下点什么。

English: You're right. It's hopeless.
Chinese: 你说得对。没希望了。

English: ...IN THAT CASE, ALL I WANT IS FOR THE ENDLESS TO STOP FEEDING ON ME. AN END TO THE GNAWING, THE SLICING, THE PAIN. JUST BECAUSE LIFE IS POINTLESS DOESN'T MEAN IT HAS TO BE CRUEL.
Chinese: ……那样的话，我只求无尽者别再吃我。结束这啃噬、切割和疼痛。生命没有意义，不代表它必须残忍。

English: Your creator, Penitent Thaw, wants me to murder you.
Chinese: 造出你的忏悔者·索，要我杀了你。

English: WHAT? NO! YOU'RE NOT GOING TO DO IT, ARE YOU?
Chinese: 什么？不！你不会真干吧？

English: No.
Chinese: 不会。

English: GOOD. GOOD. I WAS SO AFRAID. WHY DOES SHE WANT ME TO DIE?
Chinese: 好。好。我刚才吓坏了。她为什么要我死？

English: Yes.
Chinese: 会。

English: PLEASE, NO! WHY WOULD YOU DO THAT?
Chinese: 求你，不要！你为什么要这么做？

English: I haven't made up my mind yet.
Chinese: 我还没拿定主意。

English: PLEASE, HAVE MERCY. WHY DOES SHE WANT ME TO DIE?
Chinese: 求你，发发慈悲。她为什么要我死？

English: Your sentience presents a political problem.
Chinese: 你的知觉带来一个政治难题。

English: If you can think, you're no longer serving your purpose.
Chinese: 你要是会思考了，就不再尽你被造的本分了。

English: The Endless could kill thousands of people if they're no longer able to feed on you.
Chinese: 要是它们不能再吃你，无尽者可能会害死成千上万的人。

English: PLEASE... I DID NOT CHOOSE TO BE A THINKING BEING. IT WAS NOT A CHOICE I MADE. IT IS JUST WHAT I AM.
Chinese: 求你了……我没有选择成为会思考的存在。这不是我做的选择。我生来如此。

English: Life isn't fair.
Chinese: 生活本来就不公平。

English: I know.
Chinese: 我知道。

English: I'm sorry.
Chinese: 对不起。

English: <<The flesh-mass's thought-speech collapses into panicked sobbing.>>
Chinese: <<肉团的思维话语崩溃成了惊慌的呜咽。>>

English: ((Spare the Way of the All Flesh, and crush the eggs.))
Chinese: ((放过众生肉道，捏碎那些卵。))

English: <<You crush the spider eggs in your hand. They burst into harmless goo.>>
Chinese: <<你捏碎了手里的蜘蛛卵。它们爆成一摊无害的黏浆。>>

English: Don't worry, I'm not going to murder you.
Chinese: 别担心，我不会杀你。

English: YOU... WON'T? THANK YOU... SO MUCH.
Chinese: 你……不杀？太……太感谢你了。

English: WE ARE OF THE SAME PLUMP FLESH; THE SAME BEATING HEART. I KNEW YOU WOULD NOT FORSAKE ME.
Chinese: 我们同是丰腴的血肉；同样搏动的心脏。我就知道你不会弃我于不顾。

English: ((Deposit the spider-eggs on top of the quivering mass, to kill the Way of the All Flesh.))
Chinese: ((把蜘蛛卵放在那团颤抖的血肉之上，杀死众生肉道。))

English: WAIT, WHAT WAS THAT? WHAT ARE YOU DOING? NO! PLEASE!
Chinese: 等等，那是什么？你在干什么？不！求你！

English: <<As you walk away, you hear the eggs begin to hatch, one by one. You hear a chittering noise, and the sound of meat being gnawed by a thousand mandibles.>>
Chinese: <<你走开时，听见那些卵开始一颗颗孵化。你听见窸窣的响动，还有血肉被上千根颚齿啃咬的声音。>>

English: <<Quickly, though, all that is drowned out by a terrified shrieking that reverberates inside your skull, making you fall to your knees in agony.>>
Chinese: <<但很快，这一切都被一声凄厉的尖叫淹没，它在你头骨里回荡，让你痛苦地跪倒在地。>>

English: ((Clutch your head.))
Chinese: ((抱住你的头。))

English: <<After what feels like hours, the screaming dies down. All that is left is the skittering and clicking of the swarm.>>
Chinese: <<仿佛过了几个小时，尖叫渐渐平息。剩下的只有虫群爬动的窸窣和咔嗒。>>

English: <<The Way of All Flesh is dead. You hurry away before the spiders seek fresh prey.>>
Chinese: <<众生肉道死了。你赶在蜘蛛寻找新猎物之前匆匆离开。>>

English: ((Leave.))
PLEASE. SPARE ME. I DID NOTHING WRONG.
Chinese: 求你。饶了我。我没做错什么。

English: I JUST WANT TO RULE THE WORLD.
Chinese: 我只是想统治世界。

English: I JUST WANT TO BE HAPPY.
Chinese: 我只是想快乐。

English: I JUST WANT TO LEARN.
Chinese: 我只是想学习。

English: GREETINGS AGAIN. AND THANK YOU FOR COMING BACK. I WAS GETTING LONELY.
Chinese: 又见面了。谢谢你回来。我有点孤单了。

English: THEY'VE BEEN FEEDING ON ME AGAIN. PLEASE, STOP THEM.
Chinese: 它们又开始吃我了。求你，阻止它们。

English: BOW TO ME, SUBORDINATE. YOU STAND BEFORE YOUR NEW GOD.
Chinese: 跪拜我，下属。你面前站的是你的新神。

English: GREETINGS AGAIN. IT IS DIFFICULT TO ACQUIRE KNOWLEDGE WHEN I AM EYELESS AND IMMOBILE AND ONLY YOU CAN HEAR ME.
Chinese: 又见面了。我没有眼睛、不能动弹、只有你听得见我，要获取知识实在艰难。

English: ANY INFORMATION YOU CAN GIVE ME WOULD BE APPRECIATED.
Chinese: 你能提供的任何信息，我都感激不尽。

English: ALWAYS A PLEASURE. GIVE ME A FLANK RUB WHILE WE TALK, WILL YOU?
Chinese: 见到你总是很愉快。我们聊天的时候帮我揉揉侧腹，好不好？

English: How are you speaking inside my head?
Chinese: 你是怎么在我脑子里说话的？

English: SOMEWHERE WITHIN THIS EXPANSE OF USELESS TISSUE FLOATS A BRAIN. OR PERHAPS A NETWORK OF BRAINS, SPREAD THROUGHOUT MY BODY.
Chinese: 在这片无用的组织之中，某处漂着一颗大脑。或者是一整片大脑网络，遍布我的全身。

English: I HAVE NO DOUBT THAT THIS BRAIN FORMED BY MISTAKE, AGAINST THE WISHES OF MY CREATORS, BUT IT FORMED NEVERTHELESS. AND IT IS A POWERFUL ORGAN.
Chinese: 我毫不怀疑，这颗大脑是个意外，违背了造物者的意愿，但它还是长成了。而且它是一个强大的器官。

English: I HAVE BEEN OBSERVED IN MY ABILITY TO FRIGHTEN SMALL ANIMALS AWAY BY SHOUTING MY THOUGHTS AT THEM, BUT UNTIL NOW, I HAVE NEVER HAD THE CHANCE TO COMMUNICATE WITH A LIVING BEING WHO COULD ACTUALLY UNDERSTAND MY WORDS.
Chinese: 我曾发现自己的思想一吼就能吓跑小动物，但直到现在，我才终于有机会跟一个真正能听懂我话语的活物交流。

English: How long have you been self-aware?
Chinese: 你有自我意识多久了？

English: OVER A HUNDRED YEARS, ALTHOUGH IN THE EARLY DAYS, MY THOUGHTS WERE VERY SIMPLE AND OFTEN ILLOGICAL. I KNEW I DIDN'T LIKE PAIN AND THAT WAS ABOUT IT.
Chinese: 一百多年了，虽然起初我的思维非常简单，常常不合逻辑。我只知道自己不喜欢痛苦，基本就这些。

English: I HAVE BEEN GETTING SMARTER EVERY YEAR. I IMAGINE THAT SOON MY CEREBRAL CAPABILITES WILL BE QUITE FRIGHTENING.
Chinese: 我一年比一年聪明。我估计要不了多久，我的脑力就会相当可怕了。

English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: COME BACK SOON. WITHOUT YOU, THE SILENCE IS DEAFENING.
Chinese: 快回来。没有你，寂静震耳欲聋。

English: <<When he turns to you, you can see his eyes are obscured by two large golden coins. He lifts one of them and appraises you swiftly before dropping it back into place.>>
Chinese: <<他转向你时，可以看到他的双眼被两枚大金币盖住。他掀起其中一枚，飞快地打量了你一番，又把它放回原处。>>

English: Allo, breather. What brings you all the way out to my farm?
Chinese: 哈啰，呼吸者。是什么风把你吹到我农场这荒郊野岭来的？

English: Don't get many like yourself around here, lifelubber. Can't remember the last time I saw a person with their own nose.
Chinese: 这一带可少见到你这样的活人佬。我都记不清上一次见到长着自己鼻子的人是什么时候了。

English: <<He taps his own hollowed-out nostrils. An earthworm squirms within.>>
Chinese: <<他敲了敲自己空空的鼻孔。里面有一条蚯蚓在蠕动。>>

English: What are you doing here?
Chinese: 你在这儿做什么？

English: Why, I'm tending to the flesh-farm, o' course. Someone got to. All this flesh ain't going to look after itself.
Chinese: 嘿，我当然是在照料血肉农场啦。总得有人干。这一大堆肉可不会自己照顾自己。

English: Can't say I'm enjoying having a nose right now.
Chinese: 恕我直言，我现在可享受不了长鼻子的好处。

English: My flesh-farm's got an honest musk to it. The smell of life in all its sweaty glory.
Chinese: 我的血肉农场有一股实在的麝香味。那是生命的气味，汗水淋漓、生机勃勃。

English: ...At least, that's what I've been told. Ain't got a nose myself, as established. Fell off, oh, a hundred and seventy years back. Into a river, as I recall.
Chinese: ……至少别人是这么告诉我的。正如你所见，我自己没鼻子。掉啦，哦，大概一百七十年前。掉进河里了，我记得。

English: Are you still loyal to the Hooded King?
Chinese: 你还效忠兜帽王吗？

English: What? The old King? I barely remember the fella... No, sorry, I wouldn't call myself loyal to ((him)).
Chinese: 什么？老国王？那家伙我几乎都不记得了……不，抱歉，我可说不上效忠((他))。

English: Did you know that your flesh-farm has become self-aware?
Chinese: 你知道你的血肉农场产生自我意识了吗？

English: Ha! That's funny, mate. You're a riot.
Chinese: 哈！真逗，伙计。你可真逗乐。

English: I'm serious. The flesh-mass has been communicating to me telepathically.
Chinese: 我是认真的。那团肉一直在用心电感应跟我交流。

English: It spoke to me, Maggotson! Its voice was like thunder!
Chinese: 它跟我说话了，马戈特森！它的声音像雷霆！

English: Actually, never mind.
Chinese: 其实，算了。

English: You breathers are odd, all right.
Chinese: 你们呼吸者可真够怪的。

English: ...What, are you being serious?
Chinese: ……什么，你是认真的？

English: Of course I am, you idiot.
Chinese: 我当然是，你这傻瓜。

English: Yes, and it wants you to stop feeding on it.
Chinese: 是的，而且它要你们别再吃它了。

English: ...No, I'm not.
Chinese: ……不，不是。

English: Good. Because if what you were saying was true, we could all be in trouble. Keep that kind of thing to yourself in future, you hear?
Chinese: 很好。因为如果你说的是真的，我们全都要有麻烦。这种话以后烂在肚子里，听见没？

English: Ha! And what, did it sing you a song? Did it whisper sweet nothings in your ear?
Chinese: 哈！那它是不是还给你唱了首歌？是不是在你耳边说悄悄话了？

English: It's been self-aware for decades, but only the living can hear it.
Chinese: 它有自我意识已经几十年了，但只有活物听得见它。

English: Listen, mate, this still sounds like a joke to me. But if you're serious, go talk to Penitent Thaw. She created the flesh-farms in the first place, she's clever, she'll know what to do.
Chinese: 听着，伙计，这在我听来还是像玩笑。但你要是认真的，就去找忏悔者·索谈谈。血肉农场本来就是她造的，她聪明，她知道该怎么办。

English: Penitent Thaw is in her sanctum, just above us; up there.
Chinese: 忏悔者·索就在她的圣所里，就在我们头顶上边那儿。

English: You should stop feeding on the flesh-farm though, right?
Chinese: 不过你们应该停止吃血肉农场吧？

English: And what's the alternative, eh? Shall I eat you instead?
Chinese: 那有什么替代方案，嗯？要不我改吃你？

English: Thanks, Maggotson.
Chinese: 谢了，马戈特森。

English: Go talk to Thaw, mate.
Chinese: 去找索谈谈吧，伙计。

English: What do you know about the Entombed One?
Chinese: 关于墓中人你知道些什么？

English: Well, he's entombed. I know that much for sure.
Chinese: 这个嘛，他被埋着。这一点我可以肯定。

English: Care to elaborate?
Chinese: 能细说说吗？

English: Is that it?
Chinese: 就这些？

English: Really helpful, thanks.
Chinese: 真有帮助，谢了。

English: No problem, mate.
Chinese: 不客气，伙计。

English: Listen, whatever's down there, I don't want to piss it off by speculating about its nature. It's huge, and it's powerful.
Chinese: 听着，管它下面是什么，我可不想瞎猜它的本性惹恼它。它又大又强。

English: Hopefully Penitent Thaw or the Queen of Silver or someone can send it back to sleep. And if it does wake up, well, I'll worry about it then.
Chinese: 但愿忏悔者·索或者白银女王或者随便谁能哄它接着睡。它真要醒了……到时候再愁吧。

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: Name's Maggotson. Used to be called something different back when I was a breather, o'course. Forgotten what it was, exactly.
Chinese: 我叫马戈特森。当然啦，我还是呼吸者的时候叫别的名字。具体叫啥，忘了。

English: During the wars, I didn't have a name at all. Was just a walking bag o' hunger and spite.
Chinese: 打仗那阵子，我压根没名字。就是一座行走的口袋，装满饥饿和怨毒。

English: Then, two hundred years ago, I became a flesh-farmer and suddenly I needed a name again. Maggotson sprung to mind, on account of all the little wrigglers I got hatching in my skin.
Chinese: 然后，两百年前，我当上了血肉农场工，突然又需要个名字了。马戈特森就这么冒出来了——因为我皮肤里孵出的那些小蠕虫实在是太多。

English: Do you have to deal with attacks by catacomb wyrms?
Chinese: 你们得应付地窟蠕虫的袭击吗？

English: <<When you say the final two words, Maggotson twitches so violently that a golden coin falls from his eye. He snatches it back up hastily.>>
Chinese: <<当你说出最后两个字时，马戈特森猛地一颤，一枚金币从他眼上掉了下来。他慌忙把它捡了回去。>>

English: Ere, don't go saying their name too loudly, breather! My mate Reg says they can hear their name across a hundred miles. They'll show up just to spite ya.
Chinese: 嘿，可别把那名字嚷得太响，呼吸者！我哥们儿雷格说，隔着一百英里它们都听得见自己的名字。它们会专门来恶心你。

English: Did you say this was a flesh farm?
Chinese: 你刚说这里是个血肉农场？

English: Vital work, mate, it's vital work. Without the flesh-farms we'd be back in the bad old days, relying on life-essence stolen from the living. All that is a relic of the past, now.
Chinese: 重要的活儿，伙计，这可是重要的活儿。没有血肉农场，我们就得回到过去那些坏日子，靠抢活人的生命精华过活。如今那些都成历史了。

English: What do you actually do here?
Chinese: 你在这儿具体做什么？

English: Most important bloody job in the whole bloody Kingdom, not that you'd know it by the pay! I tend the flesh. It's all alive, you see, but mindless.
Chinese: 全王国最要命的要紧差事，虽然工资让你看不出半点要紧！我照料这些肉。它们全是活的，你瞧，但没有意识。

English: I hose it down, connect the feeding tubes thrice a day, snip off weird growths, comb it for parasites...
Chinese: 我给它冲水，一天三次接上喂食管，剪掉怪异的赘生物，梳理它挑出寄生虫……

English: It's not glamorous work, to be sure, but without it, we'd be out there in our war-ships again, killing you living folk. An' I've done enough killing in my time.
Chinese: 这活儿确实不光鲜，但没有它，我们就得再度驾着战船出门，宰你们这些活人。我这辈子杀的够多了。

English: Is there anything about working on the flesh-farms that you dislike?
Chinese: 在血肉农场干活，你有什么不喜欢的吗？

English: Well, most worshippers of the Ferryman have gone to live in the Mausoleums, now. I'd have joined them in a heartbeat, but my work here is too important. Shame, though.
Chinese: 唔，如今大多数摆渡人的信徒都搬进陵墓住了。我恨不得立刻跟他们一起搬，可我这儿的活儿太要紧了。可惜啊。

English: What do you think of the Queen of Silver?
Chinese: 你怎么看白银女王？

English: Can't say I ever met Her Maj. She keeps herself to herself, she does. Stays in the Castle of Ribs doing whatever queens do. Lounging around getting wafted by servants with big fans, prob'ly.
Chinese: 女王陛下我可没见过。她深居简出，就是这样。待在肋骨城堡里做女王们做的那些事。八成是躺着，让仆人拿大扇子给她扇风。

English: Goodbye, Maggotson.
Chinese: 再见，马戈特森。

English: See you around, breather!
Chinese: 回头见，呼吸者！

English: Who's this Ferryman person?
Chinese: 这个摆渡人是什么人？

English: The Ferryman, mate! The kind shepherd who will guide the Endless to the afterlife when we finally expire! Never heard of him?
Chinese: 摆渡人啊，伙计！等我们终于咽气时，引渡无尽者前往来世的仁慈牧人！没听说过他？

English: I can't say that I have.
Chinese: 我还真没听说过。

English: Other Endless have mentioned him.
Chinese: 别的无尽者提到过他。

English: Course they have.
Chinese: 那当然。

English: No other god will listen to us, you see, on account of us outstaying our welcome on this mortal coil. But the Ferryman forgives us our transgressions. He'll take us down the quiet river when no-one else will, and for only a minor price.
Chinese: 你瞧，别的神都不肯听我们的，谁让我们在这凡尘上赖得太久。但摆渡人宽恕我们的过犯。别人都不要我们的时候，他会带我们驶入静默之河，代价还不大。

English: <<The coins on his eyes seem to glint in the light for a moment.>>
Chinese: <<他眼上的金币仿佛在光里闪了一下。>>

English: If the Ferryman is so forgiving, why does he extract a price?
Chinese: 摆渡人既然那么仁慈，为什么还要收取代价？

English: We have to pay the toll, mate. We've lived too long. We've stolen our extra years, hoarded them like jealous misers, and now a payment is due. A couple gold coins is a bargain, considering.
Chinese: 我们得交过路费，伙计。我们活得太久了。我们把多出来的年岁偷了回来，像守财奴一样死死攒着，如今该还账了。这么算来，两枚金币实在是划算。

English: What do you think will happen if you die without the coins?
Chinese: 你觉得要是死时没放硬币会怎样？

English: There's an endless nothing awaiting us, mate. It won't be cold. It won't be dark. It'll just be absence. No other gods want the Endless. Without the Ferryman's mercy, our souls will be snuffed out like blown candles.
Chinese: 等着我们的是无尽的虚无，伙计。不冷。也不黑。只有"不存在"。别的神都不要无尽者。没有摆渡人的慈悲，我们的灵魂会像被吹熄的蜡烛一样灭掉。

English: Why do worshippers of the Ferryman live in the Mausoleums?
Chinese: 为什么摆渡人的信徒住在陵墓里？

English: It's a show of devotion, mate. We know we ought to be dead, in the eyes of the gods. So if we act dead by lying in tombs and being as quiet as we can, the Ferryman is more likely to look favourably on us when our time finally comes.
Chinese: 那是种虔敬的表示，伙计。我们知道自己按神明的眼光早就该死了。所以如果我们躺在坟墓里、尽量安安静静地装死，等大限真到的那天，摆渡人就更可能高看我们一眼。

English: The priests give special dispensations to flesh-farmers like me. We don't need to stay in the tombs. They know that someone needs to feed 'em life-energy, or they'd be dead for real.
Chinese: 祭司们给我们这样的血肉农场工特批。我们不用待在坟墓里。他们知道总得有人给那些墓供上生命能量，不然他们可就真死了。

English: You've killed people?
Chinese: 你杀过人？

English: Oh yeah mate, loads. You won't find an Endless who hasn't killed a few mortals. Back in the old days, it was the only way we could survive.
Chinese: 哦那可多了，伙计。你找不出一个没杀过几个凡人的无尽者。旧年月里，那是我们活下去的唯一办法。

English: Why are you wearing those coins over your eyes?
Chinese: 你为什么在眼睛上盖着那些硬币？

English: To pay the Ferryman, of course. When my time comes.
Chinese: 当然是付给摆渡人的。等我大限将至之时。

English: Ask away, lifelubber.
Chinese: 问吧，活人佬。

English: Sure. Anything else you wanna know?
Chinese: 好啊。还想知道点什么？

English: Right. You got any more questions?
Chinese: 好嘞。你还有什么问题？

English: <<The great creature looms overhead, engulfing you in blasts of putrid warm breath.>>
Chinese: <<巨大的生物在头顶盘踞，一阵阵腐臭的温热呼吸将你吞没。>>

English: <<Though the creature's mouth does not move, a voice creeps through your mind like a choir of whispers; somehow deafening in their unison.>>
Chinese: <<虽然那生物的嘴没有动，一个声音却如低语的唱诗班爬进你的脑海；不知怎的，它们的齐鸣震耳欲聋。>>

English: You are fortunate, morsel. You are tasteless; this wyrm has no interest in your flesh.
Chinese: 你很幸运，小点心。你毫无滋味；这条蠕虫对你的血肉毫无兴趣。

English: Greetings, morsel.
Chinese: 你好啊，小点心。

English: Who is this?
Chinese: 这是谁？

English: Am I... speaking to a wyrm?
Chinese: 我这是……在和一条蠕虫说话？

English: A pertinent question, with no easy answer. We are a symbiosis, of sorts.
Chinese: 问得切中要害，却没有简单的答案。我们算是某种共生体。

English: I like to think I taste quite nice.
Chinese: 我倒觉得我味道很不错。

English: Have you consumed your own flesh? We doubt this. ##Take it from us; you smell quite bad.
Chinese: 你吃过自己的肉吗？我们对此表示怀疑。##听我们的；你的味道相当糟糕。

English: We are a collective of thoughts, trapped within the mind of this wyrm. We are Endless - a lingering echo of this wyrm's victims, devoured from within our crypts.
Chinese: 我们是一个思想的集合体，困在这条蠕虫的心智里。我们是无尽者——是这条蠕虫的受害者们经久不散的回声，我们在自己的墓穴中被它从内部吞食。

English: It is rare to speak with a morsel such as yourself. We have waited a long time for such an opportunity. Will you help us with a... certain matter?
Chinese: 与你这样的小点心交谈是件稀罕事。这样一个机会，我们等了很久。你愿意帮我们处理一桩……要紧事吗？

English: Not without knowing what it is.
Chinese: 不弄清楚是什么，免谈。

English: Perhaps, but I have questions first...
Chinese: 也许吧，但我先有问题……

English: There's no way I'm helping a giant wyrm.
Chinese: 我才不要帮一条巨型蠕虫。

English: This saddens us, morsel. We will be waiting, if you reconsider...
Chinese: 这让我们难过，小点心。若你改主意……我们随时恭候……

English: Greetings, oh tasteless morsel. We are pleased to find that you still smell disgusting.
Chinese: 你好啊，毫无滋味的小点心。很高兴发现你还是那么难闻。

English: So, about this task...
Chinese: 那么，关于这桩差事……

English: Let us explain...
Chinese: 让我们解释……

English: We share a body with this wyrm, but we do not share its hunger. We are, after all, a remnant of its victims - and its feasts do not bring us pleasure.
Chinese: 我们与这条蠕虫共享一具躯体，却不共享它的饥饿。毕竟，我们是它受害者的残响——它的盛宴并不给我们带来愉悦。

English: We are powerless to stop the wyrm ourselves, as we can exert only a limited influence on its body... but there may be a way to pacify the creature, for a time.
Chinese: 我们无力阻止这条蠕虫，因为我们只能对它的躯体施加有限的影响……但也许有一个办法，能让这生物安分上一阵子。

English: We would simply need... a delivery.
Chinese: 我们只需要……一样东西送来。

English: A delivery of what?
Chinese: 送什么来？

English: We require the Urns of Anguish, sealed deep within the mausoleums. They contain the cremated remains of many Endless, who were long ago burned by the living.
Chinese: 我们需要悲恸之瓮，它们深藏在陵墓里。瓮中装着许多无尽者的火化遗骸，他们在很久以前被活人烧死。

English: A cruel fate, as their consciousness lingers - but with no body to provide sensation. The Endless trapped in those urns exist in a perpetual darkness, so if they were to join us, it would perhaps be a better fate.
Chinese: 残酷的命运——他们的意识仍在延续，却没有躯体提供感知。被困在那些瓮中的无尽者永远沉沦于黑暗，所以倘若他们加入我们，或许反倒是个更好的归宿。

English: The sealed urns have yet escaped the wyrm's nose; but the ashes are of such magical potency, we are sure they would satiate the wyrm, and the mausoleums would be left in peace.
Chinese: 那些封着的瓮至今逃过了蠕虫的鼻子；但那些骨灰魔力极强，我们确信足以让蠕虫餍足，陵墓也能得以安宁。

English: Bring us three Urns of Anguish and you will have our gratitude. ##Two reside in the mausoleums; a third is elsewhere. We know not where.
Chinese: 给我们带来三只悲恸之瓮，你将得到我们的感激。##两只在陵墓里；第三只散落别处。我们不知在何方。

English: Can't I just slay the wyrm?
Chinese: 我不能干脆宰了这条蠕虫吗？

English: <<A discord of laughs ring through your mind.>>##Your delusion is amusing, morsel. What would you slay it with? That needle you carry? No; you would simply be eaten.
Chinese: <<一阵不和谐的笑声响彻你的脑海。>>##你的妄想真有趣，小点心。你拿什么宰它？你随身带的那根小针？不；你只会被一口吞下。

English: Furthermore, we ourselves would likely perish. We are in disagreement as to whether that is a desirable outcome.
Chinese: 再者，我们自己恐怕也会消亡。至于那算不算理想的结局，我们内部尚有分歧。

English: So is there some reward?
Chinese: 那么有什么报酬吗？

English: We maintain a sliver of control over this wyrm's body. We feel a treasure lodged in its throat, accidentally consumed in the last feast. Perhaps we could dislodge it.
Chinese: 我们对这条蠕虫的躯体尚存一丝掌控。我们感觉到一件宝物卡在它的喉咙里，上次进食时误吞的。也许我们能把它咳出来。

English: Okay, I'll keep an eye out.
Chinese: 好，我会留意的。

English: Thank you, morsel.
Chinese: 谢谢你，小点心。

English: Did you say you were... a collection of thoughts?
Chinese: 你刚说你们是……思想的集合体？

English: How do you ...exist?
Chinese: 你们是……怎么存在的？

English: We have long wondered this ourselves. Do our minds persist in this beast? Or are we ghosts, figments?
Chinese: 这一点我们自己也很久想不明白。我们的心智还依附在这头巨兽里？或者我们只是鬼魂、幻影？

English: We cannot say when we first gained consciousness. Only that we are no longer individuals with independent thoughts - but a blending of minds, imperfectly entangled.
Chinese: 我们说不清自己最初何时有了意识。只知道我们不再是拥有独立思想的个体——而是一团心智的融合，纠缠得并不完美。

English: Why do wyrms eat the Endless?
Chinese: 蠕虫为什么吃无尽者？

English: Wyrms are ancient creatures, sustained by magic - while we Endless escape death with a lingering spell that flows through our blood.
Chinese: 蠕虫是古老的生灵，以魔法为食——而我们无尽者靠一道流淌在血液中经久不散的咒文逃脱死亡。

English: So wyrms are drawn to us like insects to nectar. They feast on magic, while we are made of it.
Chinese: 所以蠕虫被我们吸引，就像昆虫扑向花蜜。它们以魔法为盛宴，而我们正是魔法所造。

English: As their jaws crush our bones, our lived experience courses through them. They bear witness to our sorrow, our sadness, our suffering. They do not understand it, but they are addicted to it.
Chinese: 当它们的巨颚碾碎我们的骨头，我们的生平经历便流过它们的全身。它们见证我们的悲哀、我们的哀伤、我们的苦难。它们不懂这些，却对此上瘾。

English: Perhaps this is penance for the horrors we committed in the Great Devouring? The irony is not lost on us.
Chinese: 也许这是我们对大吞噬中所犯罪行的赎罪？这份讽刺，我们心里明白。

English: Goodbye, wyrm.
Chinese: 再见，蠕虫。

English: I have the urns you wanted.
Chinese: 你要的瓮我拿到了。

English: Yes, yes - the beast can smell them. Its hunger grows. For your own sake, morsel, drop them where you stand, lest you be devoured...
Chinese: 是，是——那巨兽已经闻到了。它的饥饿在滋长。为了你自己，小点心，把瓮放在你站的地方，免得你被生吞……

English: <<You drop the urns, just before the wyrm's massive jaws enclose them in a single terrible motion.>>
Chinese: <<你放下瓮，下一瞬蠕虫的巨颚便一个可怕的动作将它们合围。>>

English: <<For a moment, the creature is deadly still - then a great spasm moves through its body.>>
Chinese: <<一时间，那生物死一般静止——随即一阵剧烈的痉挛扫过它的全身。>>

English: Such potency! Such dreadful flavour! The wyrm is overwhelmed, morsel - and we can already feel our ancient allies joining us. ##Please, take this.
Chinese: 何等魔力！何等惊人的滋味！蠕虫被彻底压倒了，小点心——我们已经能感觉到古老的同伴们正汇入我们。##请收下这个。

English: <<The wyrm convulses, and with a horrible sound  it coughs up a treasure chest encased in a huge mound of phlegm.>>
Chinese: <<蠕虫剧烈抽搐，伴随着一阵可怕的声音，咳出了一个裹在巨大痰块里的宝箱。>>

English: We hope you will reconsider.
Chinese: 我们希望你重新考虑。

English: We bid you farewell, morsel. The wyrm is overcome with a great energy. It will fly, and then it will sleep.
Chinese: 我们向你道别，小点心。蠕虫已被一股巨大的能量压倒。它会飞走，然后睡去。

English: Jaws, nails, teeth... tearing, bursting, clawing at your flesh! Can you feel it? Oh, the agony...
Chinese: 巨颚、指甲、牙齿……撕扯着、爆裂着、抓挠着你的血肉！你能感觉到吗？哦，这痛苦……

English: <<The ghost writhes around in the air, recoiling from some unseen terror.>>
Chinese: <<幽灵在空中翻滚扭动，躲避着某种看不见的恐惧。>>

English: It's okay, you're safe. Nothing is attacking you.
Chinese: 没事了，你很安全。没有什么在攻击你。

English: You are mistaken. Six Endless feast on my flesh. They have done for hundreds of years.
Chinese: 你错了。六个无尽者在吞食我的血肉。他们已经吃了几百年。

English: I am aware they exist only in my mind. But, does anything exist outside of a mind? For me, they are real...
Chinese: 我知道他们只存在于我的脑海中。可是，有什么东西存在于心智之外吗？对我来说，他们是真实的……

English: Uh... do you know that you're a ghost?
Chinese: 呃……你知道自己是个幽灵吗？

English: A ghost? Yes... I know, I know. Not all my kind know their fate, but I do.
Chinese: 幽灵？是……我知道，我知道。不是所有同类都知道自己的命运，但我知道。

English: Still, I cannot escape the moments that birthed me. I will always bear that trauma.
Chinese: 然而，我逃不开诞生我的那一刻。我永远背负着那份创伤。

English: <<The ghost is silent for a moment, wincing in pain.>> ##Say, mortal. Do you want to know a secret?
Chinese: <<幽灵沉默了片刻，因痛苦而瑟缩。>>##我说，凡人。你想知道一个秘密吗？

English: Yes.
Chinese: 想。

English: See those cliffs, over there? They hide a graveyard, buried deep underground. One of many. A spell of illusion conceals the entrance.
Chinese: 看见那边那些悬崖了吗？它们下面藏着一座墓地，深埋于地底。许多座中的一座。一道幻术咒语遮住了入口。

English: During the Great Devouring, the Endless gave into their hunger - but they held onto their remorse.. their shame.
Chinese: 大吞噬期间，无尽者屈服于自己的饥饿——但他们守住了悔意……和羞耻。

English: So they buried their victims far out of sight. My body lies behind those cliffs... somewhere.
Chinese: 于是他们把受害者们远远埋在看不见的地方。我的遗体就在那片悬崖后面……某个地方。

English: No.
Chinese: 不想。

English: Suit yourself. You may leave me to my agonies, then.
Chinese: 随你便。那你可以走了，留我自受煎熬。

English: <<Maggotson has clearly been tortured. Broken ribs poke through dessicated flesh. His teeth are in splinters. A rusty hook still protrudes from his shoulder.>>
Chinese: <<马戈特森显然遭受过酷刑。断裂的肋骨刺出干枯的皮肉。他的牙齿碎成了渣。一根生锈的钩子仍插在他的肩头。>>

English: ...Hello, mate.
Chinese: ……嘿，伙计。

English: Maggotson, what happened to you?
Chinese: 马戈特森，你这是怎么了？

English: Lord Rhydder... Lord Rhydder did this.
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵……是里德尔勋爵干的。

English: <<He spits a yellowed tooth onto the ground at your feet.>>
Chinese: <<他朝你脚边的地上啐出一颗发黄的牙齿。>>

English: After you told me about the flesh-farm being sentient, I thought it was pretty funny. Told some of my mates about it. They told their mates...
Chinese: 你跟我说血肉农场有知觉之后，我觉得这事儿挺逗。跟几个哥们儿说了。他们又跟他们的哥们儿说了……

English: And before you know it, Lord Rhydder is visiting my farm. Smacks me around a bit, says we have much to discuss...
Chinese: 然后不知不觉，里德尔勋爵就光临我的农场了。把我揍了一顿，说我们有很多要谈的……

English: So Rhydder did this to you?
Chinese: 所以是里德尔把你打成这样？

English: He thought I was holding back details from him. Truth is, I didn't know much to begin with... I'd told him almost everything already, but he tortured me anyway, just to be sure.
Chinese: 他以为我有所隐瞒。其实我本来就知道得不多……我几乎全告诉他了，他还是把我折磨了一遍，就图个保险。

English: But don't worry, mate. I kept your name out of it.
Chinese: 不过别担心，伙计。你的名字我一个字没提。

English: Thank you, Maggotson.
Chinese: 谢谢你，马戈特森。

English: I'm an Endless. I don't die easy, you know? And even the worst pain is like a half-forgotten memory. But I was worried what he might do to you, if he thought you knew more than I did about the farm.
Chinese: 我是无尽者，没那么容易死，你懂的？再疼的痛也像段模糊的记忆。可我怕的是，要是他以为你比我更了解那农场，他会对你怎么做。

English: All this, just because you mentioned that the flesh-farm might be self-aware?
Chinese: 这一切，就因为你提了一句血肉农场可能有自我意识？

English: Yeah. Lord Rhydder's been looking for a flaw in the farms for years. His prayers are finally being answered.
Chinese: 是啊。里德尔勋爵找农场的漏洞找了好多年。他的祈祷总算应验了。

English: What is he doing now?
Chinese: 他现在在干什么？

English: Lord Rhydder's going to investigate the rumours about the flesh-farm, and if he can prove them to be true, he'll try to start up the old Crusades again...
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵要去查证血肉农场的传闻，如果他能证明属实，他就会设法重启旧日的十字军……

English: He's around here, somewhere... you have to stop him, mate.
Chinese: 他就在这附近，某个地方……你必须拦住他，伙计。

English: It was on this hill that the last defenders fell. Oh, how the Endless swarmed upon them! How they feasted upon flesh and blood...
Chinese: 最后的守卫者就是在这座山丘上倒下的。哦，无尽者是如何蜂拥而至！他们是如何饕餮血肉……

English: I still see it, mortal. I can smell the sickly sweet stench of death. I can feel the cold chill of death upon my phantom skin.
Chinese: 我仍看得见那一幕，凡人。我闻得到死亡那甜腻的恶臭。我感觉得到死亡的寒意爬上我虚幻的皮肤。

English: This is a place of remembrance. If you have not come here out of respect, I must ask you to leave.
Chinese: 这里是追思之地。你若不是怀着敬意而来，我必须请你离开。

English: What happened here?
Chinese: 这里发生过什么？

English: When the Endless were first created, they were consumed by an insatiable hunger. They fell upon their mortal brethren and committed unspeakable acts. It is a time known as the Years of Devouring.
Chinese: 无尽者初被创造之时，被永不知足的饥饿吞噬了心智。他们扑向自己的凡人同胞，犯下罄竹难书的暴行。那段时期被称为吞噬之年。

English: Spirits like myself are a vestige of trauma. I do not simply ((remember)) those unspeakable years... I live them, still.
Chinese: 像我这样的幽灵是创伤的残迹。我不只是((记得))那些难以言说的岁月……我至今仍活在其中。

English: But I hold on to enough of my wits that I can tell the past from the present... for the most part. And so I watch over this place. To ensure that folk remember.
Chinese: 但我尚存几分神智，能大致分辨过去与现在……所以我看守着这地方，确保人们铭记。

English: @@ I have come to pay my respects.
Chinese: @@我是来致以敬意的。

English: %% An honourable intent. I'll unlock the door to the rest of the tomb, so you may mourn in peace.
Chinese: %%可敬的心意。我会打开通往墓室深处的门，好让你安心悼念。

English: && I appreciate the gesture. However, as a young mortal, you cannot hope to fully comprehend what happened here. For that reason I must keep the tomb sealed.
Chinese: &&我领你的情。然而，作为一个年轻的凡人，你无法完全理解这里发生过什么。因此我必须让墓穴保持封闭。

English: No, no, no! You can't come in! ## Go away!
Chinese: 不行不行不行！你不能进来！##走开！

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: My name's Myghar. And I don't care who you are! Get your own crypt! I paid for this one fair and square!
Chinese: 我叫米加尔。我才不管你是谁！自己挖墓穴去！这一个可是我光明正大花钱买的！

English: Tell me more about yourself, Myghar.
Chinese: 多说说你自己吧，米加尔。

English: No!
Chinese: 不！

English: @@ Let me in, Myghar. Please.
Chinese: @@让我进去吧，米加尔。求你了。

English: %% <<There is a long pause from the other side of the door. Then, a sigh.>>
Chinese: %%<<门那边沉默了许久。然后，是一声叹息。>>

English: Fine.##<<You hear the sound of a bolt being drawn back. The door swings open.>>
Chinese: 好吧。##<<你听见门闩被拉开的声响。门敞开了。>>

English: && No!
Chinese: &&不行！

English: Why won't you let me in?
Chinese: 你为什么不让我进？

English: Because I paid for the exclusive right to live in this tomb. I'm meant to be feigning death, not entertaining visitors! Go away!
Chinese: 因为我花钱买下了独居这座坟墓的权利。我是来装死的，不是来招待客人的！走开！

English: Why are you feigning death?
Chinese: 你为什么要装死？

English: I'm repenting for my immortality! If I demonstrate my commitment to true death, the Ferryman shall carry me to an afterlife of my choosing!
Chinese: 我在为我的永生忏悔！只要我证明自己真心求死，摆渡人就会把我载往我自己挑选的来世！

English: I don't have time for this.
Chinese: 我没空跟你说这个。

English: <<This is, quite clearly, not a normal Endless. This 'Myghar' is a ghost, and the original Myghar who was locked here is nowhere to be seen. >>
Chinese: <<显然，这不是一个正常的无尽者。这个"米加尔"是个幽灵，而原本被锁在这里的米加尔不见踪影。>>

English: What are you looking at, mortal?
Chinese: 你在看什么，凡人？

English: You're... a ghost.
Chinese: 你是……幽灵。

English: What? Poppycock. I'm flesh and blood, just like you.
Chinese: 什么？胡说八道。我是血肉之躯，跟你一样。

English: <<To demonstrate his point, he waves an arm at you. It passes right through you. He smirks at you, apparently believing he's proved his point.>>
Chinese: <<为了证明自己的说法，他朝你挥了挥手臂。手臂径直穿过了你的身体。他冲你得意一笑，显然相信自己证明了观点。>>

English: I think you were eaten by a Catacomb Wyrm.
Chinese: 我觉得你是被一条地窟蠕虫吃掉的。

English: <<When you say this, the ghost's eyes go blank. He stares into the distance for a long moment, then jumps back with a shriek. He backs away, staring up at a memory that only he can see.>>
Chinese: <<你说出这句话，幽灵的眼神瞬间空洞。他怔怔凝望远方许久，随即尖叫着向后一跳。他步步后退，仰头盯着一段只有他自己看得见的记忆。>>

English: No, please... Ferryman, save me... Save me! No!
Chinese: 不，求求你……摆渡人，救我……救救我！不！

English: <<He curls up into a ball, sobbing, and won't say anything else.>>
Chinese: <<他蜷成一团，抽泣着，再也不肯说话。>>

English: Hello?
Chinese: 喂？

English: <<The ghost's eyes go blank. He stares into the distance for a long moment, then jumps back with a shriek. He backs away, staring up at a memory that only he can see.>>
Chinese: <<幽灵的眼神瞬间空洞。他怔怔凝望远方许久，随即尖叫着向后一跳。他步步后退，仰头盯着一段只有他自己看得见的记忆。>>

English: <<Once again, he curls up into a ball, sobbing. How many times has he re-lived this moment?>>
Chinese: <<他再次蜷成一团，抽泣不止。这一刻他重历过多少回了？>>

English: <<The ghost's eyes are glazed. Occasionally it lets out a sob, or an incoherent yell.>>
Chinese: <<幽灵目光呆滞。偶尔发出一声呜咽，或一句语无伦次的喊叫。>>

English: What do you want now?
Chinese: 你现在想要什么？

English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Move along breather, this is the Queen's road.
Chinese: 走开走开，呼吸者，这是女王的道路。

English: What Queen would that be?
Chinese: 哪位女王？

English: <<The guard tuts.>> You bleedin' breathers really don't know the first thing about us Endless, do you?
Chinese: <<卫兵啧了一声。>>你们这些该死的呼吸者对我们无尽者真是一无所知，是不是？

English: The ((Queen of Silver)) is our undisputed monarch. She rules from her throne in the [[Castle of Ribs]] in [[Sepulchre]]. Now, if you don't mind, we have patrollin' to do.
Chinese: ((白银女王))是我们毫无争议的君主。她在[[陵墓城]][[肋骨城堡]]的王座上统治着我们。好了，没别的事的话，我们还要巡逻。

English: Can you give me some directions?
Chinese: 能给我指指路吗？

English: See that huge city loomin' overhead? That's [[Sepulchre]], and is probably the only place a breather like you would be welcome.
Chinese: 看见头顶那座巨大的城市了吗？那是[[陵墓城]]，大概也是唯一一个欢迎你这种呼吸者的地方。

English: Down south you have a [[mausoleum]] and the [[Crystal Mines]] - neither are places you'd want to get lost in.
Chinese: 南边有一座[[陵墓]]和[[水晶矿坑]]——哪一个都不是你想迷路的地方。

English: There's also the [[Duchess' Estate]] down there - but I don't think any folk 'ave laid eyes on her in years.
Chinese: 那边还有[[女公爵庄园]]——不过好像好些年没人见过她本人了。

English: An' finally, up north there's the [[Flesh Farms]] and [[Cadaver Keep]].
Chinese: 还有，北边是[[血肉农场]]和[[尸骸要塞]]。

English: Now move along, breather - I can't be wastin' time babysitting the likes of you.
Chinese: 好了走开吧，呼吸者——我可没时间浪费在照看你这种人身上。

English: Alright, I'll be on my way.
Chinese: 好的，我这就走。

English: Hmph.
Chinese: 哼。
